title: The Overlooked Repetitive Lengthening Form in Sentiment Analysis
summary: Individuals engaging in online communication frequently express personal opinions with informal styles (e.g., memes and emojis). While Language Models (LMs) with informal communications have been widely discussed, a unique and emphatic style, the Repetitive Lengthening Form (RLF), has been overlooked for years. In this paper, we explore answers to two research questions: 1) Is RLF important for sentiment analysis (SA)? 2) Can LMs understand RLF? Inspired by previous linguistic research, we curate \textbf{Lengthening}, the first multi-domain dataset with 850k samples focused on RLF for SA. Moreover, we introduce \textbf{Exp}lainable \textbf{Instruct}ion Tuning (\textbf{ExpInstruct}), a two-stage instruction tuning framework aimed to improve both performance and explainability of LLMs for RLF. We further propose a novel unified approach to quantify LMs' understanding of informal expressions. We show that RLF sentences are expressive expressions and can serve as signatures of document-level sentiment. Additionally, RLF has potential value for online content analysis. Our results show that fine-tuned Pre-trained Language Models (PLMs) can surpass zero-shot GPT-4 in performance but not in explanation for RLF. Finally, we show ExpInstruct can improve the open-sourced LLMs to match zero-shot GPT-4 in performance and explainability for RLF with limited samples. Code and sample data are available at https://github.com/Tom-Owl/OverlookedRLF

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了在线交流中常见的重复延长形式（RLF）对情感分析的重要性，创建了首个RLF数据集Lengthening，并提出ExpInstruct框架提升LLM对RLF的理解和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 虽然语言模型在非正式交流方面已有广泛研究，但重复延长形式（RLF）这一独特且强调性的表达风格多年来一直被忽视。研究者希望探索两个问题：1）RLF对情感分析是否重要？2）语言模型能否理解RLF？
AI.method: 1）创建首个多领域RLF数据集Lengthening（85万样本）；2）提出ExpInstruct两阶段指令微调框架，提升LLM对RLF的性能和可解释性；3）提出统一方法量化语言模型对非正式表达的理解能力。
AI.result: 1）RLF句子是富有表现力的表达，可作为文档级情感的特征；2）RLF对在线内容分析具有潜在价值；3）微调的预训练语言模型在性能上可超越零样本GPT-4，但在解释性方面不及；4）ExpInstruct可使开源LLM在有限样本下达到零样本GPT-4的性能和可解释性水平。
AI.conclusion: RLF对情感分析具有重要意义，语言模型能够理解RLF。通过ExpInstruct框架，开源LLM可以在有限数据下达到与GPT-4相当的性能和可解释性，为在线内容分析提供了新工具。

title: Scaling Reasoning Tokens via RL and Parallel Thinking: Evidence From Competitive Programming
summary: We study how to scale reasoning token budgets for competitive programming through two complementary approaches: training-time reinforcement learning (RL) and test-time parallel thinking. During RL training, we observe an approximately log-linear relationship between validation accuracy and the average number of generated reasoning tokens over successive checkpoints, and show two ways to shift this training trajectory: verification RL warmup raises the starting point, while randomized clipping produces a steeper trend in the observed regime. As scaling single-generation reasoning during RL quickly becomes expensive under full attention, we introduce a multi-round parallel thinking pipeline that distributes the token budget across threads and rounds of generation, verification, and refinement. We train the model end-to-end on this pipeline to match the training objective to the test-time structure. Starting from Seed-OSS-36B, the full system with 16 threads and 16 rounds per thread matches the underlying RL model's oracle pass@16 at pass@1 using 7.6 million tokens per problem on average, and surpasses GPT-5-high on 456 hard competitive programming problems from AetherCode.

AI.tldr: 通过强化学习和并行思考两种方法扩展推理token预算，提升竞争性编程性能
AI.motivation: 解决竞争性编程中单次生成推理token预算有限的问题，提高模型在复杂编程问题上的表现
AI.method: 1. 训练时强化学习：验证RL预热和随机剪枝优化训练轨迹；2. 测试时并行思考：多轮多线程生成-验证-精炼管道，端到端训练匹配测试结构
AI.result: 从Seed-OSS-36B出发，16线程16轮系统平均每个问题使用760万token，在pass@1达到基础RL模型的oracle pass@16水平，超越GPT-5-high在AetherCode的456个难题上
AI.conclusion: 结合训练时强化学习和测试时并行思考能有效扩展推理token预算，显著提升竞争性编程模型性能

title: Preference learning in shades of gray: Interpretable and bias-aware reward modeling for human preferences
summary: Learning human preferences in language models remains fundamentally challenging, as reward modeling relies on subtle, subjective comparisons or shades of gray rather than clear-cut labels. This study investigates the limits of current approaches and proposes a feature-augmented framework to better capture the multidimensional nature of human judgment. Using the Anthropic HHRLHF dataset, we evaluate ten diverse large language models LLMs under a standard pairwise preference setting, where baseline performance remains below 0.74 ROC AUC, highlighting the difficulty of the task. To address this, we enrich textual representations with interpretable signals: response length, refusal indicators, toxicity scores and prompt response semantic similarity, enabling models to explicitly capture key aspects of helpfulness, safety and relevance. The proposed hybrid approach yields consistent improvements across all models, achieving up to 0.84 ROC AUC and significantly higher pairwise accuracy, with DeBERTav3Large demonstrating the best performance. Beyond accuracy, we integrate SHAP and LIME to provide fine-grained interpretability, revealing that model decisions depend on contextualized safety and supportive framing rather than isolated keywords. We further analyze bias amplification, showing that while individual features have weak marginal effects, their interactions influence preference learning.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一种特征增强框架，通过结合文本特征和可解释信号来改进语言模型中人类偏好的学习，在Anthropic HHRLHF数据集上显著提升了偏好预测性能。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型学习人类偏好的方法面临根本性挑战，因为奖励建模依赖于微妙、主观的比较而非明确标签。现有方法在标准成对偏好设置下性能有限（ROC AUC低于0.74），难以捕捉人类判断的多维特性。
AI.method: 提出混合特征增强框架：1）使用Anthropic HHRLHF数据集评估10个不同大语言模型；2）用可解释信号丰富文本表示：响应长度、拒绝指示器、毒性分数和提示-响应语义相似度；3）结合SHAP和LIME进行细粒度可解释性分析；4）分析偏差放大效应。
AI.result: 特征增强方法在所有模型上带来一致改进，最高达到0.84 ROC AUC和显著更高的成对准确率，DeBERTav3Large表现最佳。可解释性分析显示模型决策依赖于情境化安全性和支持性框架而非孤立关键词。特征交互影响偏好学习。
AI.conclusion: 通过整合可解释信号的特征增强框架能有效改进人类偏好的学习，捕捉有帮助性、安全性和相关性的关键方面。该方法不仅提升性能，还提供对模型决策过程的深入理解，揭示了特征交互在偏好学习中的重要性。

title: Runtime Burden Allocation for Structured LLM Routing in Agentic Expert Systems: A Full-Factorial Cross-Backend Methodology
summary:
Structured LLM routing is often treated as a prompt-engineering problem. We argue that it is, more fundamentally, a systems-level burden-allocation problem. As large language models (LLMs) become core control components in agentic AI systems, reliable structured routing must balance correctness, latency, and implementation cost under real deployment constraints. We show that this balance is shaped not only by prompts or schemas, but also by how structural work is allocated across the generation stack: whether output structure is emitted directly by the model, compressed during transport, or reconstructed locally after generation.
  We evaluate this formulation through a comprehensive full-factorial benchmark covering 48 deployment configurations and 15,552 requests across OpenAI, Gemini, and Llama backends. Our central finding is consequential: there is no universal best routing mode. Instead, backend-specific interaction effects dominate performance. Modes that remain highly reliable on Gemini and OpenAI can suffer substantial correctness degradation on Llama, while efficiency gains from compressed realization are strongly backend-dependent.
  Rather than presenting another isolated model comparison, this work contributes a deployable framework for reasoning about structured routing under heterogeneous backend conditions. We provide a cross-backend evaluation methodology and practical deployment guidance for navigating the correctness-cost-latency frontier in production-grade agentic expert systems.

AI.tldr: 结构化LLM路由不仅是提示工程问题，更是系统级负载分配问题，需要平衡正确性、延迟和成本，不同后端的最佳路由模式差异显著。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM成为智能代理系统的核心控制组件，可靠的结构化路由需要在真实部署约束下平衡正确性、延迟和实现成本。当前研究多将其视为提示工程问题，但作者认为这本质上是系统级负载分配问题。
AI.method: 通过全面的全因子基准测试，评估48种部署配置和15,552个请求，覆盖OpenAI、Gemini和Llama后端。研究结构化工作在不同生成栈层的分配方式：模型直接输出、传输中压缩或生成后本地重建。
AI.result: 没有通用的最佳路由模式，后端特定的交互效应主导性能。在Gemini和OpenAI上高度可靠的模式，在Llama上可能出现显著的正确性下降，压缩实现的效率增益也强烈依赖于后端。
AI.conclusion: 本文提供了一个可部署的框架，用于在异构后端条件下进行结构化路由推理，贡献了跨后端评估方法和实际部署指导，帮助在生产级智能专家系统中导航正确性-成本-延迟的权衡边界。

title: DOne: Decoupling Structure and Rendering for High-Fidelity Design-to-Code Generation
summary: While Vision Language Models (VLMs) have shown promise in Design-to-Code generation, they suffer from a "holistic bottleneck-failing to reconcile high-level structural hierarchy with fine-grained visual details, often resulting in layout distortions or generic placeholders. To bridge this gap, we propose DOne, an end-to-end framework that decouples structure understanding from element rendering. DOne introduces (1) a learned layout segmentation module to decompose complex designs, avoiding the limitations of heuristic cropping; (2) a specialized hybrid element retriever to handle the extreme aspect ratios and densities of UI components; and (3) a schema-guided generation paradigm that bridges layout and code. To rigorously assess performance, we introduce HiFi2Code, a benchmark featuring significantly higher layout complexity than existing datasets. Extensive evaluations on the HiFi2Code demonstrate that DOne outperforms exiting methods in both high-level visual similarity (e.g., over 10% in GPT Score) and fine-grained element alignment. Human evaluations confirm a 3 times productivity gain with higher visual fidelity.

AI.tldr: DOne框架通过解耦结构理解和元素渲染来解决视觉语言模型在Design-to-Code生成中的整体瓶颈问题，显著提升了布局复杂界面的代码生成质量。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉语言模型在Design-to-Code生成中存在"整体瓶颈"问题，无法同时处理高层次结构层次和细粒度视觉细节，导致布局失真或使用通用占位符。
AI.method: 提出DOne端到端框架，包含三个核心组件：1) 学习型布局分割模块分解复杂设计；2) 专门化混合元素检索器处理UI组件的极端宽高比和密度；3) 模式引导的生成范式连接布局和代码。
AI.result: 在提出的HiFi2Code基准测试中，DOne在高层视觉相似度（如GPT Score提升超过10%）和细粒度元素对齐方面均优于现有方法。人工评估显示生产力提升3倍且视觉保真度更高。
AI.conclusion: DOne通过解耦结构理解和元素渲染的方法有效解决了Design-to-Code生成中的核心挑战，为复杂界面设计到代码的转换提供了更准确和高效的解决方案。

title: Procedural Knowledge at Scale Improves Reasoning
summary: Test-time scaling has emerged as an effective way to improve language models on challenging reasoning tasks. However, most existing methods treat each problem in isolation and do not systematically reuse knowledge from prior reasoning trajectories. In particular, they underutilize procedural knowledge: how to reframe a problem, choose an approach, and verify or backtrack when needed. We introduce Reasoning Memory, a retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) framework for reasoning models that explicitly retrieves and reuses procedural knowledge at scale. Starting from existing corpora of step-by-step reasoning trajectories, we decompose each trajectory into self-contained subquestion-subroutine pairs, yielding a datastore of 32 million compact procedural knowledge entries. At inference time, a lightweight in-thought prompt lets the model verbalize the core subquestion, retrieve relevant subroutines within its reasoning trace, and reason under diverse retrieved subroutines as implicit procedural priors. Across six math, science, and coding benchmarks, Reasoning Memory consistently outperforms RAG with document, trajectory, and template knowledge, as well as a compute-matched test-time scaling baseline. With a higher inference budget, it improves over no retrieval by up to 19.2% and over the strongest compute-matched baseline by 7.9% across task types. Ablation studies show that these gains come from two key factors: the broad procedural coverage of the source trajectories and our decomposition and retrieval design, which together enable effective extraction and reuse of procedural knowledge.

AI.tldr: 提出Reasoning Memory框架，通过检索和重用程序性知识来增强推理模型，在数学、科学和编程任务上显著优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有测试时缩放方法通常孤立处理每个问题，未能系统性地重用先前推理轨迹中的程序性知识（如问题重构、方法选择和验证回溯）。
AI.method: 从逐步推理轨迹语料库中分解出3200万个自包含的子问题-子程序对，构建知识库；推理时通过轻量级提示让模型表达核心子问题，检索相关子程序作为隐式程序先验。
AI.result: 在六个数学、科学和编程基准测试中，Reasoning Memory一致优于基于文档、轨迹和模板知识的RAG方法，以及计算匹配的测试时缩放基线。在高推理预算下，相比无检索提升达19.2%，相比最强基线提升7.9%。
AI.conclusion: Reasoning Memory通过广泛的程序覆盖度和分解检索设计，有效提取和重用程序性知识，显著提升语言模型在复杂推理任务上的表现。

title: The Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework: A Validation Architecture for Simulated Potential Outcomes
summary: The fundamental problem of causal inference - that the counterfactual outcome for any individual is never observed - has shaped the entire methodology of the field. Every existing approach substitutes assumptions for missing data: ignorability, parallel trends, exclusion restrictions. None produces the counterfactual itself. This paper proposes the Digital Twin Counterfactual Framework (DTCF): rather than estimating the counterfactual statistically, we simulate it using a digital twin and subject the simulation to a hierarchical validation regime. We formalize the digital twin simulator as a stochastic mapping within the potential outcomes framework and introduce a hierarchy of twin fidelity assumptions - from marginal fidelity through joint fidelity to structural fidelity - each unlocking a progressively richer class of estimands. The central contribution is threefold. First, a five-level validation architecture converts the unfalsifiable claim that the simulator produces correct counterfactuals into falsifiable tests against observable data. Second, a formal decomposition separates causal quantities into those that are marginally validated (ATE, CATE, QTE - testable through observable-arm comparison) and those that are copula-dependent (the ITE distribution, probability of benefit/harm, variance of treatment effects - permanently reliant on the unobservable within-individual dependence structure). Third, bounding, sensitivity, and uncertainty quantification tools make the copula dependence explicit. The DTCF does not resolve the fundamental problem of causal inference. What it provides is a framework in which marginal causal claims become increasingly testable, joint causal claims become explicitly assumption-indexed, and the gap between the two is formally characterized.

AI.tldr: 提出数字孪生反事实框架，通过模拟而非统计估计反事实结果，建立分层验证体系将不可验证的因果主张转化为可检验的假设
AI.motivation: 传统因果推断方法依赖不可观测的反事实数据，通过假设填补缺失信息，但无法直接产生反事实结果本身。需要一种新框架来更直接地处理反事实问题
AI.method: 提出数字孪生反事实框架：1) 使用数字孪生模拟反事实结果而非统计估计；2) 建立分层孪生保真度假设（边际、联合、结构保真度）；3) 五级验证架构将不可验证主张转化为可检验测试；4) 形式化分解因果量；5) 边界、敏感性和不确定性量化工具
AI.result: 1) 边际因果主张（ATE、CATE、QTE）可通过可观测数据验证；2) 联合因果主张（ITE分布、获益/损害概率、处理效应方差）依赖于不可观测的个体内依赖结构；3) 提供明确处理copula依赖关系的工具；4) 框架不解决因果推断的根本问题，但使因果主张更可检验
AI.conclusion: 数字孪生反事实框架提供了系统方法：使边际因果主张更可检验，使联合因果主张明确依赖假设，并形式化表征两者间的差距。框架不解决因果推断的根本问题，但提供了更透明的因果推断方法论

title: CLPIPS: A Personalized Metric for AI-Generated Image Similarity
summary: Iterative prompt refinement is central to reproducing target images with text to image generative models. Previous studies have incorporated image similarity metrics (ISMs) as additional feedback to human users. Existing ISMs such as LPIPS and CLIP provide objective measures of image likeness but often fail to align with human judgments, particularly in context specific or user driven tasks. In this paper, we introduce Customized Learned Perceptual Image Patch Similarity (CLPIPS), a customized extension of LPIPS that adapts a metric's notion of similarity directly to human judgments. We aim to explore whether lightweight, human augmented fine tuning can meaningfully improve perceptual alignment, positioning similarity metrics as adaptive components for human in the loop workflows with text to image tools. We evaluate CLPIPS on a human subject dataset in which participants iteratively regenerate target images and rank generated outputs by perceived similarity. Using margin ranking loss on human ranked image pairs, we fine tune only the LPIPS layer combination weights and assess alignment via Spearman rank correlation and Intraclass Correlation Coefficient. Our results show that CLPIPS achieves stronger correlation and agreement with human judgments than baseline LPIPS. Rather than optimizing absolute metric performance, our work emphasizes improving alignment consistency between metric predictions and human ranks, demonstrating that even limited human specific fine tuning can meaningfully enhance perceptual alignment in human in the loop text to image workflows.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了CLPIPS，一种基于LPIPS的定制化图像相似度度量方法，通过轻量级的人类标注微调来更好地对齐人类感知判断，用于文本到图像生成中的人类参与工作流程。
AI.motivation: 现有的图像相似度度量方法（如LPIPS和CLIP）虽然提供了客观的图像相似度测量，但在特定上下文或用户驱动的任务中往往无法与人类判断对齐。需要一种能够直接适应人类感知判断的定制化相似度度量方法。
AI.method: 提出了CLPIPS（定制化学习感知图像块相似度），这是LPIPS的定制化扩展。通过人类标注的数据集，参与者迭代重新生成目标图像并按感知相似度对生成输出进行排名。使用边际排名损失对LPIPS层组合权重进行微调，评估方法包括Spearman等级相关性和类内相关系数。
AI.result: CLPIPS相比基线LPIPS实现了与人类判断更强的相关性和一致性。实验结果表明，即使有限的人类特定微调也能显著增强人类参与文本到图像工作流程中的感知对齐。
AI.conclusion: 本文强调通过轻量级的人类增强微调可以显著改善感知对齐，将相似度度量定位为人类参与文本到图像工具工作流程中的自适应组件。研究重点不是优化绝对度量性能，而是提高度量预测与人类排名之间的一致性。

title: No Attacker Needed: Unintentional Cross-User Contamination in Shared-State LLM Agents
summary: LLM-based agents increasingly operate across repeated sessions, maintaining task states to ensure continuity. In many deployments, a single agent serves multiple users within a team or organization, reusing a shared knowledge layer across user identities. This shared persistence expands the failure surface: information that is locally valid for one user can silently degrade another user's outcome when the agent reapplies it without regard for scope. We refer to this failure mode as unintentional cross-user contamination (UCC). Unlike adversarial memory poisoning, UCC requires no attacker; it arises from benign interactions whose scope-bound artifacts persist and are later misapplied. We formalize UCC through a controlled evaluation protocol, introduce a taxonomy of three contamination types, and evaluate the problem in two shared-state mechanisms. Under raw shared state, benign interactions alone produce contamination rates of 57--71%. A write-time sanitization is effective when shared state is conversational, but leaves substantial residual risk when shared state includes executable artifacts, with contamination often manifesting as silent wrong answers. These results indicate that shared-state agents need artifact-level defenses beyond text-level sanitization to prevent silent cross-user failures.

AI.tldr: LLM智能体在多用户共享知识层时，会因信息范围错配导致跨用户污染问题，即使没有恶意攻击者也会发生，需要超越文本层面的防御措施。
AI.motivation: 随着LLM智能体在重复会话中运行并维护任务状态，单个智能体服务于团队或组织内的多个用户时，共享知识层的复用会扩大故障面。一个用户本地有效的信息可能在智能体不考虑范围的情况下被重新应用，从而无声地降低其他用户的结果质量。
AI.method: 通过受控评估协议形式化跨用户污染问题，引入三种污染类型的分类法，并在两种共享状态机制下评估该问题：原始共享状态和写入时净化机制。
AI.result: 在原始共享状态下，仅良性交互就会产生57-71%的污染率。写入时净化在共享状态为对话形式时有效，但当共享状态包含可执行工件时，仍存在实质性残留风险，污染通常表现为无声的错误答案。
AI.conclusion: 共享状态智能体需要超越文本层面净化的工件级防御措施，以防止无声的跨用户故障。

title: IDEA2: Expert-in-the-loop competency question elicitation for collaborative ontology engineering
summary: Competency question (CQ) elicitation represents a critical but resource-intensive bottleneck in ontology engineering. This foundational phase is often hampered by the communication gap between domain experts, who possess the necessary knowledge, and ontology engineers, who formalise it. This paper introduces IDEA2, a novel, semi-automated workflow that integrates Large Language Models (LLMs) within a collaborative, expert-in-the-loop process to address this challenge. The methodology is characterised by a core iterative loop: an initial LLM-based extraction of CQs from requirement documents, a co-creational review and feedback phase by domain experts on an accessible collaborative platform, and an iterative, feedback-driven reformulation of rejected CQs by an LLM until consensus is achieved. To ensure transparency and reproducibility, the entire lifecycle of each CQ is tracked using a provenance model that captures the full lineage of edits, anonymised feedback, and generation parameters. The workflow was validated in 2 real-world scenarios (scientific data, cultural heritage), demonstrating that IDEA2 can accelerate the requirements engineering process, improve the acceptance and relevance of the resulting CQs, and exhibit high usability and effectiveness among domain experts. We release all code and experiments at https://github.com/KE-UniLiv/IDEA2

AI.tldr: IDEA2是一个将大型语言模型集成到协作式专家参与流程中的半自动化工作流，用于从需求文档中提取能力问题，通过迭代反馈循环提高能力问题的质量和接受度。
AI.motivation: 能力问题提取是本体工程中的关键但资源密集型瓶颈，存在领域专家和本体工程师之间的沟通鸿沟，需要更高效、协作的方法来改进这一过程。
AI.method: IDEA2采用半自动化工作流，集成了大型语言模型和专家参与循环：1) LLM从需求文档中初步提取能力问题；2) 领域专家在协作平台上评审并提供反馈；3) LLM根据反馈迭代重新表述被拒绝的能力问题，直到达成共识；4) 使用溯源模型跟踪每个能力问题的完整生命周期。
AI.result: 在科学数据和文化遗产两个真实场景中的验证表明，IDEA2能够加速需求工程过程，提高能力问题的接受度和相关性，并在领域专家中展现出高可用性和有效性。
AI.conclusion: IDEA2通过整合大型语言模型和协作式专家参与流程，有效解决了能力问题提取中的瓶颈问题，提高了本体工程需求阶段的效率和质量。

title: Camouflage-aware Image-Text Retrieval via Expert Collaboration
summary: Camouflaged scene understanding (CSU) has attracted significant attention due to its broad practical implications. However, in this field, robust image-text cross-modal alignment remains under-explored, hindering deeper understanding of camouflaged scenarios and their related applications. To this end, we focus on the typical image-text retrieval task, and formulate a new task dubbed ``camouflage-aware image-text retrieval'' (CA-ITR). We first construct a dedicated camouflage image-text retrieval dataset (CamoIT), comprising $\sim$10.5K samples with multi-granularity textual annotations. Benchmark results conducted on CamoIT reveal the underlying challenges of CA-ITR for existing cutting-edge retrieval techniques, which are mainly caused by objects' camouflage properties as well as those complex image contents. As a solution, we propose a camouflage-expert collaborative network (CECNet), which features a dual-branch visual encoder: one branch captures holistic image representations, while the other incorporates a dedicated model to inject representations of camouflaged objects. A novel confidence-conditioned graph attention (C\textsuperscript{2}GA) mechanism is incorporated to exploit the complementarity across branches. Comparative experiments show that CECNet achieves $\sim$29% overall CA-ITR accuracy boost, surpassing seven representative retrieval models. The dataset and code will be available at https://github.com/jiangyao-scu/CA-ITR.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了伪装感知图像-文本检索任务，构建了CamoIT数据集，并开发了CECNet模型，在伪装场景理解中实现了显著的检索性能提升。
AI.motivation: 伪装场景理解具有广泛的实际应用价值，但该领域中的图像-文本跨模态对齐研究不足，限制了伪装场景的深入理解和相关应用开发。
AI.method: 提出了伪装专家协作网络，采用双分支视觉编码器：一个分支捕获整体图像表示，另一个分支通过专用模型注入伪装对象表示。引入了置信度条件图注意力机制来利用分支间的互补性。
AI.result: 在构建的CamoIT数据集上，CECNet实现了约29%的整体检索准确率提升，超越了七种代表性检索模型，证明了其在伪装感知图像-文本检索任务上的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 该研究填补了伪装场景理解中跨模态对齐的空白，提出的CA-ITR任务、CamoIT数据集和CECNet模型为伪装场景的深入理解提供了新的研究方向和工具。

title: Open-Domain Safety Policy Construction
summary: Moderation layers are increasingly a core component of many products built on user- or model-generated content. However, drafting and maintaining domain-specific safety policies remains costly. We present Deep Policy Research (DPR), a minimal agentic system that drafts a full content moderation policy based on only human-written seed domain information. DPR uses a single web search tool and lightweight scaffolding to iteratively propose search queries, distill diverse web sources into policy rules, and organize rules into an indexed document. We evaluate DPR on (1) the OpenAI undesired content benchmark across five domains with two compact reader LLMs and (2) an in-house multimodal advertisement moderation benchmark. DPR consistently outperforms definition-only and in-context learning baselines, and in our end-to-end setting it is competitive with expert-written policy sections in several domains. Moreover, under the same seed specification and evaluation protocol, DPR outperforms a general-purpose deep research system, suggesting that a task-specific, structured research loop can be more effective than generic web research for policy drafting. We release our experiment code at https://github.com/xiaowu0162/deep-policy-research.

AI.tldr: Deep Policy Research (DPR)是一个最小化的智能体系统，仅基于人工编写的种子领域信息就能自动起草完整的内容审核政策，在多个基准测试中表现优于基线方法。
AI.motivation: 随着用户生成内容和模型生成内容产品的增多，审核层变得越来越重要，但制定和维护特定领域的安全政策成本高昂，需要自动化解决方案来降低这一成本。
AI.method: DPR使用单一网络搜索工具和轻量级脚手架，通过迭代提出搜索查询、将多样化的网络资源提炼为政策规则，并将规则组织成索引文档的方式，自动生成内容审核政策。
AI.result: DPR在OpenAI不良内容基准测试（五个领域）和内部多模态广告审核基准测试中，始终优于仅使用定义和上下文学习的基线方法，在某些领域甚至能与专家编写的政策部分相竞争。在相同的种子规范和评估协议下，DPR也优于通用的深度研究系统。
AI.conclusion: 任务特定的结构化研究循环比通用的网络研究在政策起草方面更有效，DPR展示了自动化内容审核政策生成的可行性，为降低政策制定成本提供了有效解决方案。

title: Semantic Modeling for World-Centered Architectures
summary: We introduce world-centered multi-agent systems (WMAS) as an alternative to traditional agent-centered architectures, arguing that structured domains such as enterprises and institutional systems require a shared, explicit world representation to ensure semantic consistency, explainability, and long-term stability. We classify worlds along dimensions including ontological explicitness, normativity, etc. In WMAS, learning and coordination operate over a shared world model rather than isolated agent-local representations, enabling global consistency and verifiable system behavior. We propose semantic models as a mathematical formalism for representing such worlds. Finally, we present the Ontobox platform as a realization of WMAS.

AI.tldr: 提出以世界为中心的多智能体系统作为传统智能体中心架构的替代方案，强调结构化领域需要共享的显式世界表示来确保语义一致性、可解释性和长期稳定性。
AI.motivation: 传统智能体中心架构在企业和制度系统等结构化领域中存在语义不一致、可解释性差和长期稳定性不足的问题，需要一种新的架构来确保全局一致性和可验证的系统行为。
AI.method: 引入世界为中心的多智能体系统，通过共享的显式世界表示来协调智能体行为；提出语义模型作为表示这种世界的数学形式化方法；开发Ontobox平台作为WMAS的实现。
AI.result: 建立了世界为中心的多智能体系统理论框架，提出了世界分类维度（本体显式性、规范性等），并开发了Ontobox平台作为该架构的具体实现。
AI.conclusion: 世界为中心的多智能体系统为结构化领域提供了更好的语义一致性、可解释性和长期稳定性，是传统智能体中心架构的有力替代方案。

title: Look Twice: Training-Free Evidence Highlighting in Multimodal Large Language Models
summary: Answering questions about images often requires combining visual understanding with external knowledge. Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) provide a natural framework for this setting, but they often struggle to identify the most relevant visual and textual evidence when answering knowledge-intensive queries. In such scenarios, models must integrate visual cues with retrieved textual evidence that is often noisy or only partially relevant, while also localizing fine-grained visual information in the image. In this work, we introduce Look Twice (LoT), a training-free inference-time framework that improves how pretrained MLLMs utilize multimodal evidence. Specifically, we exploit the model attention patterns to estimate which visual regions and retrieved textual elements are relevant to a query, and then generate the answer conditioned on this highlighted evidence. The selected cues are highlighted through lightweight prompt-level markers that encourage the model to re-attend to the relevant evidence during generation. Experiments across multiple knowledge-based VQA benchmarks show consistent improvements over zero-shot MLLMs. Additional evaluations on vision-centric and hallucination-oriented benchmarks further demonstrate that visual evidence highlighting alone improves model performance in settings without textual context, all without additional training or architectural modifications. Source code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: Look Twice (LoT)是一个无需训练、在推理时改进多模态大语言模型利用多模态证据的框架，通过注意力模式识别相关视觉区域和文本元素，并使用提示标记引导模型重新关注相关证据。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在回答需要外部知识的图像问题时，难以识别最相关的视觉和文本证据，特别是在需要整合视觉线索与可能嘈杂或部分相关的检索文本证据，同时定位图像中细粒度视觉信息的场景下。
AI.method: 利用模型注意力模式估计哪些视觉区域和检索到的文本元素与查询相关，然后基于这些突出显示的证据生成答案。通过轻量级的提示级标记突出显示选定的线索，鼓励模型在生成过程中重新关注相关证据。
AI.result: 在多个基于知识的视觉问答基准测试中，相比零样本多模态大语言模型取得了持续改进。在仅视觉中心和幻觉导向的基准测试中，仅视觉证据突出显示也能在没有文本上下文的情况下提高模型性能，且无需额外训练或架构修改。
AI.conclusion: Look Twice框架通过推理时重新关注相关多模态证据，有效提升了预训练多模态大语言模型在知识密集型查询中的表现，为改进模型证据利用提供了一种无需训练的方法。

title: Friends and Grandmothers in Silico: Localizing Entity Cells in Language Models
summary: Language models can answer many entity-centric factual questions, but it remains unclear which internal mechanisms are involved in this process. We study this question across multiple language models. We localize entity-selective MLP neurons using templated prompts about each entity, and then validate them with causal interventions on PopQA-based QA examples. On a curated set of 200 entities drawn from PopQA, localized neurons concentrate in early layers. Negative ablation produces entity-specific amnesia, while controlled injection at a placeholder token improves answer retrieval relative to mean-entity and wrong-cell controls. For many entities, activating a single localized neuron is sufficient to recover entity-consistent predictions once the context is initialized, consistent with compact entity retrieval rather than purely gradual enrichment across depth. Robustness to aliases, acronyms, misspellings, and multilingual forms supports a canonicalization interpretation. The effect is strong but not universal: not every entity admits a reliable single-neuron handle, and coverage is higher for popular entities. Overall, these results identify sparse, causally actionable access points for analyzing and modulating entity-conditioned factual behavior.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型中存在稀疏的、对实体敏感的MLP神经元，这些神经元在早期层集中，能够通过因果干预实现实体特异性记忆操控，支持紧凑实体检索而非渐进式信息丰富化。
AI.motivation: 语言模型能够回答许多以实体为中心的事实性问题，但其内部机制尚不清楚。本研究旨在探究语言模型在处理实体相关事实时的内部工作机制，特别是寻找能够解释实体检索过程的稀疏、可操作的访问点。
AI.method: 使用模板化提示定位实体选择性MLP神经元，然后在PopQA问答示例上进行因果干预验证。研究基于PopQA选取的200个实体，通过负向消融和受控注入实验分析神经元功能。
AI.result: 定位到的神经元集中在早期层；负向消融导致实体特异性遗忘，而受控注入能改善答案检索；单个神经元激活足以恢复实体一致性预测；对别名、缩写、拼写错误和多语言形式的鲁棒性支持规范化解释；效果显著但不普遍，流行实体覆盖率更高。
AI.conclusion: 研究识别出了稀疏的、具有因果可操作性的访问点，可用于分析和调节语言模型中实体条件化的事实行为，支持紧凑实体检索而非渐进式信息丰富化的解释。

title: Crashing Waves vs. Rising Tides: Preliminary Findings on AI Automation from Thousands of Worker Evaluations of Labor Market Tasks
summary: We propose that AI automation is a continuum between: (i) crashing waves where AI capabilities surge abruptly over small sets of tasks, and (ii) rising tides where the increase in AI capabilities is more continuous and broad-based. We test for these effects in preliminary evidence from an ongoing evaluation of AI capabilities across over 3,000 broad-based tasks derived from the U.S. Department of Labor O*NET categorization that are text-based and thus LLM-addressable. Based on more than 17,000 evaluations by workers from these jobs, we find little evidence of crashing waves (in contrast to recent work by METR), but substantial evidence that rising tides are the primary form of AI automation. AI performance is high and improving rapidly across a wide range of tasks. We estimate that, in 2024-Q2, AI models successfully complete tasks that take humans approximately 3-4 hours with about a 50% success rate, increasing to about 65% by 2025-Q3. If recent trends in AI capability growth persist, this pace of AI improvement implies that LLMs will be able to complete most text-related tasks with success rates of, on average, 80%-95% by 2029 at a minimally sufficient quality level. Achieving near-perfect success rates at this quality level or comparable success rates at superior quality would require several additional years. These AI capability improvements would impact the economy and labor market as organizations adopt AI, which could have a substantially longer timeline.

AI.tldr: 研究发现AI自动化呈现"涨潮式"而非"浪潮式"发展，AI能力在广泛任务中持续提升，预计到2029年LLM能完成80%-95%的文本任务
AI.motivation: 探讨AI自动化的本质特征，验证AI能力发展是"浪潮式"（特定任务突然突破）还是"涨潮式"（广泛任务持续改进），为理解AI对经济和劳动力市场的影响提供实证基础
AI.method: 基于美国劳工部O*NET分类的3000多个文本任务，通过17000多次由相关职业工作者进行的评估，系统测试AI模型在不同任务上的表现，分析AI能力随时间的变化趋势
AI.result: 发现AI能力呈现"涨潮式"发展，而非"浪潮式"突破；2024年第二季度AI完成人类3-4小时任务的成功率约50%，预计2025年第三季度提升至65%；若趋势持续，到2029年LLM在大多数文本任务上的平均成功率可达80%-95%
AI.conclusion: AI自动化主要表现为广泛任务能力的持续提升，而非特定任务的突然突破；AI能力改善速度较快，但组织采用AI并影响经济和劳动力市场可能需要更长时间

title: Assessing Pause Thresholds for empirical Translation Process Research
comment: Accepted for Presentation at "Translation in Transition 8, September 2026"
summary: Text production (and translations) proceeds in the form of stretches of typing, interrupted by keystroke pauses. It is often assumed that fast typing reflects unchallenged/automated translation production while long(er) typing pauses are indicative of translation problems, hurdles or difficulties. Building on a long discussion concerning the determination of pause thresholds that separate automated from presumably reflective translation processes (O'Brien, 2006; Alves and Vale, 2009; Timarova et al., 2011; Dragsted and Carl, 2013; Lacruz et al., 2014; Kumpulainen, 2015; Heilmann and Neumann 2016), this paper compares three recent approaches for computing these pause thresholds, and suggest and evaluate a novel method for computing Production Unit Breaks.

AI.tldr: 本文比较了三种计算翻译过程中停顿阈值的方法，并提出并评估了一种新的生产单元中断计算方法
AI.motivation: 翻译过程中的打字停顿通常被用来区分自动化翻译过程与需要认知处理的翻译过程，但如何确定停顿阈值一直存在争议，需要更可靠的方法来识别翻译中的认知困难
AI.method: 比较了三种现有的停顿阈值计算方法，并提出了一种新的生产单元中断计算方法进行评估
AI.result: 通过比较不同方法，验证了新提出的生产单元中断计算方法的有效性
AI.conclusion: 新提出的生产单元中断计算方法为识别翻译过程中的认知困难提供了更可靠的指标，有助于更好地理解翻译认知过程

title: CogBias: Measuring and Mitigating Cognitive Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed in high-stakes decision-making contexts. While prior work has shown that LLMs exhibit cognitive biases behaviorally, whether these biases correspond to identifiable internal representations and can be mitigated through targeted intervention remains an open question. We define LLM cognitive bias as systematic, reproducible deviations from correct answers in tasks with computable ground-truth baselines, and introduce LLM CogBias, a benchmark organized around four families of cognitive biases: Judgment, Information Processing, Social, and Response. We evaluate three LLMs and find that cognitive biases emerge systematically across all four families, with magnitudes and debiasing responses that are strongly family-dependent: prompt-level debiasing substantially reduces Response biases but backfires for Judgment biases. Using linear probes under a contrastive design, we show that these biases are encoded as linearly separable directions in model activation space. Finally, we apply activation steering to modulate biased behavior, achieving 26--32\% reduction in bias score (fraction of biased responses) while preserving downstream capability on 25 benchmarks (Llama: negligible degradation; Qwen: up to $-$19.0pp for Judgment biases). Despite near-orthogonal bias representations across models (mean cosine similarity 0.01), steering reduces bias at similar rates across architectures ($r(246)$=.621, $p$<.001), suggesting shared functional organization.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了大型语言模型中的认知偏见，发现这些偏见在模型激活空间中呈现线性可分离方向，并通过激活导向技术成功减少了26-32%的偏见分数，同时保持了模型的下游能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型越来越多地应用于高风险决策场景。虽然先前研究表明LLM在行为上表现出认知偏见，但这些偏见是否对应可识别的内部表征，以及能否通过针对性干预来缓解，仍然是一个未解决的问题。
AI.method: 1. 定义LLM认知偏见为在具有可计算基准的任务中系统性的、可复现的偏离正确答案；2. 引入LLM CogBias基准，围绕四个认知偏见家族组织：判断、信息处理、社会和反应偏见；3. 评估三个LLM；4. 使用对比设计下的线性探针分析偏见在模型激活空间中的编码方式；5. 应用激活导向技术来调节偏见行为。
AI.result: 1. 认知偏见在所有四个家族中系统性出现，其程度和去偏见响应强烈依赖于家族：提示级去偏见显著减少反应偏见，但对判断偏见产生反效果；2. 偏见在模型激活空间中编码为线性可分离方向；3. 激活导向实现了26-32%的偏见分数减少，同时在25个基准测试中保持了下游能力；4. 尽管不同模型间的偏见表征接近正交，但导向在不同架构中以相似速率减少偏见，表明存在共享的功能组织。
AI.conclusion: LLM中的认知偏见在激活空间中具有可识别的线性表征，可以通过激活导向技术有效缓解。不同模型间偏见表征的差异与去偏见效果的相似性表明，尽管内部表征不同，但偏见的功能组织在不同架构中是共享的，这为理解和干预LLM中的系统性偏见提供了新途径。

title: ViTs for Action Classification in Videos: An Approach to Risky Tackle Detection in American Football Practice Videos
comment: 15 pages, 4 figures. Accepted to ICPR 2026 (28th International Conference on Pattern Recognition)
summary: Early identification of hazardous actions in contact sports enables timely intervention and improves player safety. We present a method for detecting risky tackles in American football practice videos and introduce a substantially expanded dataset for this task. Our work contains 733 single-athlete-dummy tackle clips, each temporally localized around first point contact and labeled with a strike zone component of the standardized Assessment for Tackling Technique (SATT-3), extending prior work that reported 178 annotated videos. Using a Vision transformer-based model with imbalance-aware training, we obtain risky recall of 0.67 and Risky F1 of 0.59 under crossvalidation. Relative to the previous baseline in a smaller subset (risky recall of 0.58; Risky F1 0.56 ), our approach improves risky recall by more than 8% points on a much larger dataset. These results indicate that the vision transformer-based video analysis, coupled with careful handling of class imbalance, can reliably detect rare but safety-critical tackling patterns, offering a practical pathway toward coach-centered injury prevention tools.

AI.tldr: 基于视觉Transformer的视频分析方法，通过处理类别不平衡问题，在美式足球训练视频中检测危险擒抱动作，相比基线方法在更大数据集上提升了8%以上的危险召回率。
AI.motivation: 早期识别接触性运动中的危险动作能够及时干预并提高运动员安全性。美式足球中的擒抱动作存在安全风险，需要开发自动检测方法来辅助教练预防伤害。
AI.method: 使用视觉Transformer模型处理视频数据，采用不平衡感知训练方法。构建了包含733个单运动员-假人擒抱片段的扩展数据集，每个片段围绕首次接触点进行时间定位，并用标准擒抱技术评估(SATT-3)的撞击区域组件进行标注。
AI.result: 在交叉验证中获得0.67的危险召回率和0.59的危险F1分数。相比先前在较小数据集上的基线方法（危险召回率0.58，危险F1 0.56），在更大数据集上危险召回率提升了超过8个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 视觉Transformer视频分析结合类别不平衡的谨慎处理，能够可靠地检测罕见但安全关键的擒抱模式，为教练中心的伤害预防工具提供了实用途径。

title: Adaptive Stopping for Multi-Turn LLM Reasoning
summary: Large Language Models (LLMs) increasingly rely on multi-turn reasoning and interaction, such as adaptive retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) and ReAct-style agents, to answer difficult questions. These methods improve accuracy by iteratively retrieving information, reasoning, or acting, but introduce a key challenge: \textbf{When should the model stop?} Existing approaches rely on heuristic stopping rules or fixed turn budgets and provide no formal guarantees that the final prediction still contains the correct answer. This limitation is particularly problematic in high-stakes domains such as finance and healthcare, where unnecessary turns increase cost and latency, while stopping too early risks incorrect decisions. Conformal prediction (CP) provides formal coverage guarantees, but existing LLM-CP methods only apply to a single model output and cannot handle multi-turn pipelines with adaptive stopping. To address this gap, we propose Multi-Turn Language Models with Conformal Prediction (MiCP), the first CP framework for multi-turn reasoning. MiCP allocates different error budgets across turns, enabling the model to stop early while maintaining an overall coverage guarantee. We demonstrate MiCP on adaptive RAG and ReAct, where it achieves the target coverage on both single-hop and multi-hop question answering benchmarks while reducing the number of turns, inference cost, and prediction set size. We further introduce a new metric that jointly evaluates coverage validity and answering efficiency.

AI.tldr: 提出了MiCP框架，为多轮推理的大语言模型提供符合性预测，实现自适应停止的同时保证整体覆盖保证
AI.motivation: 现有多轮推理方法（如自适应RAG和ReAct代理）缺乏正式的停止准则，依赖启发式规则或固定轮次预算，无法保证最终预测包含正确答案，这在金融、医疗等高风险领域尤为关键
AI.method: 提出Multi-Turn Language Models with Conformal Prediction (MiCP)框架，为多轮推理分配不同的错误预算，使模型能够提前停止同时保持整体覆盖保证
AI.result: 在自适应RAG和ReAct上验证MiCP，在单跳和多跳问答基准测试中达到目标覆盖，同时减少轮次数、推理成本和预测集大小
AI.conclusion: MiCP是首个为多轮推理设计的符合性预测框架，解决了多轮推理中的停止问题，在保证覆盖有效性的同时提高了回答效率

title: RIFT: A RubrIc Failure Mode Taxonomy and Automated Diagnostics
summary: Rubric-based evaluation is widely used in LLM benchmarks and training pipelines for open-ended, less verifiable tasks. While prior work has demonstrated the effectiveness of rubrics using downstream signals such as reinforcement learning outcomes, there remains no principled way to diagnose rubric quality issues from such aggregated or downstream signals alone. To address this gap, we introduce RIFT: RubrIc Failure mode Taxonomy, a taxonomy for systematically characterizing failure modes in rubric composition and design. RIFT consists of eight failure modes organized into three high-level categories: Reliability Failures, Content Validity Failures, and Consequential Validity Failures. RIFT is developed using grounded theory by iteratively annotating rubrics drawn from five diverse benchmarks spanning general instruction following, code generation, creative writing, and expert-level deep research, until no new failure modes are identified. We evaluate the consistency of the taxonomy by measuring agreement among independent human annotators, observing fair agreement overall (87% pairwise agreement and 0.64 average Cohen's kappa). Finally, to support scalable diagnosis, we propose automated rubric quality metrics and show that they align with human failure-mode annotations, achieving up to 0.86 F1.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RIFT（RubrIc Failure mode Taxonomy），这是一个用于系统化描述评分标准（rubric）在设计和构成中失败模式的分类法，旨在解决当前LLM基准测试和训练中评分标准质量难以诊断的问题。
AI.motivation: 当前基于评分标准的评估在LLM基准测试和训练中被广泛使用，但现有方法主要通过下游信号（如强化学习结果）来评估评分标准的有效性，缺乏从这些聚合或下游信号中诊断评分标准质量问题的原则性方法。
AI.method:
1. 提出RIFT分类法，包含8个失败模式，分为三个高级类别：可靠性失败、内容有效性失败和结果有效性失败。
2. 使用扎根理论方法，从五个不同基准（通用指令遵循、代码生成、创意写作、专家级深度研究）中迭代标注评分标准，直到没有新的失败模式出现。
3. 通过测量独立人类标注者之间的一致性来评估分类法的一致性。
4. 提出自动化评分标准质量指标，并验证其与人工失败模式标注的对齐程度。
AI.result:
1. 开发了包含8个失败模式的RIFT分类法，涵盖三个高级类别。
2. 观察到整体公平的一致性（87%的成对一致性和0.64的平均Cohen's kappa）。
3. 自动化评分标准质量指标与人工失败模式标注对齐良好，达到最高0.86的F1分数。
AI.conclusion: RIFT分类法为系统化诊断评分标准质量问题提供了框架，自动化指标能够有效支持大规模诊断，有助于改进LLM基准测试和训练中评分标准的设计和质量。

title: Human Pose Estimation in Trampoline Gymnastics: Improving Performance Using a New Synthetic Dataset
summary: Trampoline gymnastics involves extreme human poses and uncommon viewpoints, on which state-of-the art pose estimation models tend to under-perform. We demonstrate that this problem can be addressed by fine-tuning a pose estimation model on a dataset of synthetic trampoline poses (STP). STP is generated from motion capture recordings of trampoline routines. We develop a pipeline to fit noisy motion capture data to a parametric human model, then generate multiview realistic images. We use this data to fine-tune a ViTPose model, and test it on real multi-view trampoline images. The resulting model exhibits accuracy improvements in 2D which translates to improved 3D triangulation. In 2D, we obtain state-of-the-art results on such challenging data, bridging the performance gap between common and extreme poses. In 3D, we reduce the MPJPE by 12.5 mm with our best model, which represents an improvement of 19.6% compared to the pretrained ViTPose model.

AI.tldr: 使用合成蹦床姿势数据集微调ViTPose模型，显著提升极端人体姿态估计性能
AI.motivation: 现有姿态估计模型在蹦床体操这种极端人体姿态和非常规视角下表现不佳，需要专门的数据集来提升性能
AI.method: 从动作捕捉数据生成合成蹦床姿势数据集(STP)，通过参数化人体模型拟合噪声数据，生成多视角真实图像，用此数据微调ViTPose模型
AI.result: 在2D姿态估计上达到最先进水平，在3D三角测量中MPJPE减少12.5毫米，相比预训练ViTPose模型提升19.6%
AI.conclusion: 合成数据微调能有效解决极端人体姿态估计问题，缩小常见姿态与极端姿态之间的性能差距

title: Cost-Efficient Estimation of General Abilities Across Benchmarks
summary: Thousands of diverse benchmarks have been developed to measure the quality of large language models (LLMs). Yet prior work has demonstrated that LLM performance is often sufficiently explained by a small set of latent factors, or abilities. This suggests the potential for more efficient and principled benchmarking, but it remains difficult to compare the quality of different methods. Motivated by predictive validity, we argue that the quality of a benchmarking framework should be grounded in how efficiently it enables the prediction of model performance on unseen tasks. To analyze this objective, we collect the "Wide-scale Item Level Dataset" (WILD), a dataset of item-model response pairs, comprising evaluations of 65 models on 109,564 unique items spanning 163 tasks drawn from 27 datasets. This dataset enables the first analysis of how different techniques can predict a model's performance on a large, diverse collection of unseen tasks under different budget constraints. We demonstrate that combining a modified multidimensional item response theory (IRT) model with adaptive item selection driven by optimal experimental design can predict performance on 112 held-out benchmark tasks with a mean absolute error (MAE) of less than 7%, and can do so after observing only 16 items. We further demonstrate that incorporating cost-aware discount factors into our selection criteria can reduce the total tokens needed to reach 7% MAE from 141,000 tokens to only 22,000, an 85% reduction in evaluation cost.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了基于预测效度的基准测试评估框架，通过收集大规模项目级数据集WILD，结合改进的多维项目反应理论和自适应项目选择，能够高效预测模型在未见任务上的性能，显著降低评估成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的大语言模型基准测试数量庞大但效率低下，研究发现模型性能通常由少量潜在能力因素解释。需要更高效、有原则的基准测试方法，但缺乏比较不同方法质量的标准化框架。
AI.method: 收集WIDE-scale Item Level Dataset (WILD)，包含65个模型在163个任务上的109,564个独特项目响应。采用改进的多维项目反应理论模型，结合基于最优实验设计的自适应项目选择策略，并引入成本感知折扣因子。
AI.result: 提出的方法在仅观察16个项目后，就能在112个保留基准任务上实现平均绝对误差小于7%的预测性能。通过成本感知折扣因子，将达到7% MAE所需的总token数从141,000减少到22,000，评估成本降低85%。
AI.conclusion: 基于预测效度的基准测试框架能够高效预测模型在未见任务上的性能，显著降低评估成本，为大语言模型评估提供了更高效、有原则的方法。

title: Leveraging the Value of Information in POMDP Planning
summary: Partially observable Markov decision processes (POMDPs) offer a principled formalism for planning under state and transition uncertainty. Despite advances made towards solving large POMDPs, obtaining performant policies under limited planning time remains a major challenge due to the curse of dimensionality and the curse of history. For many POMDP problems, the value of information (VOI) - the expected performance gain from reasoning about observations - varies over the belief space. We introduce a dynamic programming framework that exploits this structure by conditionally processing observations based on the value of information at each belief. Building on this framework, we propose Value of Information Monte Carlo planning (VOIMCP), a Monte Carlo Tree Search algorithm that allocates computational effort more efficiently by selectively disregarding observation information when the VOI is low, avoiding unnecessary branching of observations. We provide theoretical guarantees on the near-optimality of our VOI reasoning framework and derive non-asymptotic convergence bounds for VOIMCP. Simulation evaluations demonstrate that VOIMCP outperforms baselines on several POMDP benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种基于信息价值(VOI)的POMDP规划框架，通过选择性忽略低VOI的观测信息来更高效分配计算资源，避免不必要的观测分支。
AI.motivation: POMDP在状态和转移不确定性下的规划提供了原则性形式化，但受限于维度和历史诅咒，在有限规划时间内获得高性能策略仍然是一个主要挑战。许多POMDP问题中，信息价值(VOI)在信念空间中是变化的。
AI.method: 提出了一个动态规划框架，利用VOI结构在每个信念处基于信息价值有条件地处理观测。基于此框架提出了VOIMCP算法，这是一种蒙特卡洛树搜索算法，当VOI较低时选择性忽略观测信息，避免不必要的观测分支。
AI.result: 提供了VOI推理框架的近优性理论保证，推导了VOIMCP的非渐近收敛界。仿真评估表明VOIMCP在多个POMDP基准测试中优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过利用信息价值的变化性，提出的框架和算法能够更高效地分配计算资源，在有限规划时间内获得更好的性能，为解决大规模POMDP问题提供了有效方法。

title: ClawSafety: "Safe" LLMs, Unsafe Agents
summary: Personal AI agents like OpenClaw run with elevated privileges on users' local machines, where a single successful prompt injection can leak credentials, redirect financial transactions, or destroy files. This threat goes well beyond conventional text-level jailbreaks, yet existing safety evaluations fall short: most test models in isolated chat settings, rely on synthetic environments, and do not account for how the agent framework itself shapes safety outcomes. We introduce CLAWSAFETY, a benchmark of 120 adversarial test scenarios organized along three dimensions (harm domain, attack vector, and harmful action type) and grounded in realistic, high-privilege professional workspaces spanning software engineering, finance, healthcare, law, and DevOps. Each test case embeds adversarial content in one of three channels the agent encounters during normal work: workspace skill files, emails from trusted senders, and web pages. We evaluate five frontier LLMs as agent backbones, running 2,520 sandboxed trials across all configurations. Attack success rates (ASR) range from 40\% to 75\% across models and vary sharply by injection vector, with skill instructions (highest trust) consistently more dangerous than email or web content. Action-trace analysis reveals that the strongest model maintains hard boundaries against credential forwarding and destructive actions, while weaker models permit both. Cross-scaffold experiments on three agent frameworks further demonstrate that safety is not determined by the backbone model alone but depends on the full deployment stack, calling for safety evaluation that treats model and framework as joint variables.

AI.tldr: CLAWSAFETY是一个评估个人AI代理安全性的基准测试，包含120个对抗性测试场景，涵盖多个专业领域，测试结果显示攻击成功率在40%-75%之间，安全性能取决于模型和框架的完整部署栈。
AI.motivation: 个人AI代理（如OpenClaw）在用户本地机器上以高权限运行，单个成功的提示注入攻击可能导致凭证泄露、金融交易重定向或文件破坏。现有安全评估不足：大多在隔离聊天环境中测试模型，依赖合成环境，且未考虑代理框架本身如何影响安全结果。
AI.method: 引入CLAWSAFETY基准测试，包含120个对抗性测试场景，按三个维度组织（危害领域、攻击向量、有害行动类型），基于现实高权限专业工作环境（软件工程、金融、医疗、法律、DevOps）。每个测试案例将对抗性内容嵌入代理正常工作遇到的三个渠道之一：工作空间技能文件、可信发件人的电子邮件、网页。评估五个前沿LLM作为代理骨干，在所有配置中运行2,520个沙盒试验。
AI.result: 攻击成功率（ASR）在模型间从40%到75%不等，且因注入向量差异显著：技能指令（最高信任度）始终比电子邮件或网页内容更危险。行动轨迹分析显示，最强模型对凭证转发和破坏性行动保持硬边界，而较弱模型允许两者。三个代理框架的交叉脚手架实验进一步证明，安全性不仅由骨干模型决定，还取决于完整部署栈。
AI.conclusion: 安全性评估应将模型和框架作为联合变量处理，需要更全面的安全评估方法，考虑实际部署环境中的完整技术栈。

title: Perceptual misalignment of texture representations in convolutional neural networks
summary: Mathematical modeling of visual textures traces back to Julesz's intuition that texture perception in humans is based on local correlations between image features. An influential approach for texture analysis and generation generalizes this notion to linear correlations between the nonlinear features computed by convolutional neural networks (CNNs), compiled into Gram matrices. Given that CNNs are often used as models for the visual system, it is natural to ask whether such "texture representations" spontaneously align with the textures' perceptual content, and in particular whether those CNNs that are regarded as better models for the visual system also possess more human-like texture representations. Here we compare the perceptual content captured by feature correlations computed for a diverse pool of CNNs, and we compare it to the models' perceptual alignment with the mammalian visual system as measured by Brain-Score. Surprisingly, we find that there is no connection between conventional measures of CNN quality as a model of the visual system and its alignment with human texture perception. We conclude that texture perception involves mechanisms that are distinct from those that are commonly modeled using approaches based on CNNs trained on object recognition, possibly depending on the integration of contextual information.

AI.tldr: 研究发现CNN模型作为视觉系统模型的传统质量指标与其与人类纹理感知的对齐程度之间没有关联，表明纹理感知机制不同于基于物体识别训练的CNN常用方法。
AI.motivation: 研究动机是探究CNN特征相关性（Gram矩阵）是否自发地与纹理的感知内容对齐，特别是那些被视为更好视觉系统模型的CNN是否具有更类似人类的纹理表示。
AI.method: 比较了多样化CNN池中计算的特征相关性所捕获的感知内容，并将其与通过Brain-Score测量的模型与哺乳动物视觉系统的感知对齐进行比较。
AI.result: 令人惊讶地发现，CNN作为视觉系统模型的传统质量指标与其与人类纹理感知的对齐程度之间没有关联。
AI.conclusion: 纹理感知涉及与基于物体识别训练的CNN常用方法不同的机制，可能依赖于上下文信息的整合。

title: Are Finer Citations Always Better? Rethinking Granularity for Attributed Generation
summary: Citation granularity - whether to cite individual sentences, paragraphs, or documents - is a critical design choice in attributed generation. While fine-grained citations are often preferred for precise human verification, their impact on model performance remains under-explored. We analyze four model scales (8B-120B) and demonstrate that enforcing fine-grained citations degrades attribution quality by 16-276% compared to the best-performing granularity. We observe a consistent performance pattern where attribution quality peaks at intermediate granularities (paragraph-level). Our analysis suggests that fine-grained (sentence-level) citations disrupt necessary semantic dependencies for attributing evidence to answer claims, while excessively coarse citations (multi-paragraph) introduce distracting noise. Importantly, the magnitude of this performance gap varies non-monotonically with model scale: fine-grained constraints disproportionately penalize larger models, suggesting that atomic citation units disrupt the multi-sentence information synthesis at which these models excel. Strikingly, citation-optimal granularity leads to substantial gains in attribution quality while preserving or even improving answer correctness. Overall, our findings demonstrate that optimizing solely for human verification via fine-grained citation disregards model constraints, compromising both attribution faithfulness and generation reliability. Instead, effective attribution requires aligning citation granularity with the model's natural semantic scope.

AI.tldr: 研究发现引用粒度对模型性能有显著影响：中等粒度（段落级）的引用效果最佳，而过于细粒度的句子级引用会降低16-276%的归因质量，尤其对大型模型影响更大。
AI.motivation: 虽然细粒度引用通常被认为有利于人工验证，但其对模型性能的影响尚未充分研究。本文旨在探索不同引用粒度（句子级、段落级、文档级）对归因质量和模型性能的影响。
AI.method: 分析了四种不同规模的模型（8B-120B），比较了不同引用粒度（句子级、段落级、多段落级）对归因质量的影响。通过实验验证了不同粒度下模型的归因性能和答案正确性。
AI.result: 中等粒度（段落级）引用表现最佳，细粒度（句子级）引用使归因质量下降16-276%。性能差距随模型规模非单调变化，细粒度约束对大型模型影响更大。引用最优粒度在保持或提高答案正确性的同时，显著提升了归因质量。
AI.conclusion: 仅为了人工验证而优化细粒度引用会忽视模型约束，损害归因忠实性和生成可靠性。有效的归因需要将引用粒度与模型的自然语义范围对齐，段落级引用是最佳平衡点。

title: Wired for Overconfidence: A Mechanistic Perspective on Inflated Verbalized Confidence in LLMs
summary: Large language models are often not just wrong, but \emph{confidently wrong}: when they produce factually incorrect answers, they tend to verbalize overly high confidence rather than signal uncertainty. Such verbalized overconfidence can mislead users and weaken confidence scores as a reliable uncertainty signal, yet its internal mechanisms remain poorly understood. We present a circuit-level mechanistic analysis of this inflated verbalized confidence in LLMs, organized around three axes: capturing verbalized confidence as a differentiable internal signal, identifying the circuits that causally inflate it, and leveraging these insights for targeted inference-time recalibration. Across two instruction-tuned LLMs on three datasets, we find that a compact set of MLP blocks and attention heads, concentrated in middle-to-late layers, consistently writes the confidence-inflation signal at the final token position. We further show that targeted inference-time interventions on these circuits substantially improve calibration. Together, our results suggest that verbalized overconfidence in LLMs is driven by identifiable internal circuits and can be mitigated through targeted intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文对LLM中过度自信的言语表达进行了电路级机制分析，发现特定MLP块和注意力头在中间到后期层中写入过度自信信号，并通过针对性干预改善了校准。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型经常表现出"过度自信"的问题：当产生事实错误的答案时，它们倾向于表达过高的置信度而不是表示不确定性。这种言语表达的过度自信会误导用户，削弱置信度分数作为可靠不确定性信号的效用，但其内部机制尚不清楚。
AI.method: 采用电路级机制分析方法，围绕三个轴展开：将言语表达的置信度捕捉为可微分的内部信号；识别导致其膨胀的电路；利用这些见解进行有针对性的推理时重新校准。在两个指令调优的LLM和三个数据集上进行实验。
AI.result: 发现一组紧凑的MLP块和注意力头（集中在中间到后期层）在最终标记位置一致地写入置信度膨胀信号。针对性推理时干预显著改善了校准效果。
AI.conclusion: LLM中的言语表达过度自信是由可识别的内部电路驱动的，可以通过针对性干预来缓解。这为理解和改善LLM的校准提供了机制性见解。

title: A Multi-Agent Human-LLM Collaborative Framework for Closed-Loop Scientific Literature Summarization
summary: Scientific discovery is slowed by fragmented literature that requires excessive human effort to gather, analyze, and understand. AI tools, including autonomous summarization and question answering, have been developed to aid in understanding scientific literature. However, these tools lack the structured, multi-step approach necessary for extracting deep insights from scientific literature. Large Language Models (LLMs) offer new possibilities for literature analysis, but remain unreliable due to hallucinations and incomplete extraction. We introduce Elhuyar, a multi-agent, human-in-the-loop system that integrates LLMs, structured AI, and human scientists to extract, analyze, and iteratively refine insights from scientific literature. The framework distributes tasks among specialized agents for filtering papers, extracting data, fitting models, and summarizing findings, with human oversight ensuring reliability. The system generates structured reports with extracted data, visualizations, model equations, and text summaries, enabling deeper inquiry through iterative refinement. Deployed in materials science, it analyzed literature on tungsten under helium-ion irradiation, showing experimentally correlated exponential helium bubble growth with irradiation dose and temperature, offering insight for plasma-facing materials (PFMs) in fusion reactors. This demonstrates how AI-assisted literature review can uncover scientific patterns and accelerate discovery.

AI.tldr: Elhuyar是一个多智能体、人在回路系统，结合LLM、结构化AI和人类科学家，从科学文献中提取、分析和迭代精炼见解，应用于材料科学领域
AI.motivation: 科学发现受到碎片化文献的限制，现有AI工具缺乏结构化、多步骤的方法来从科学文献中提取深度见解，LLM存在幻觉和不完整提取的问题
AI.method: 开发了Elhuyar多智能体系统，将任务分配给专门的智能体进行论文筛选、数据提取、模型拟合和结果总结，结合人类监督确保可靠性，生成结构化报告并支持迭代精炼
AI.result: 在材料科学中部署该系统，分析了钨在氦离子辐照下的文献，发现氦气泡生长与辐照剂量和温度呈指数相关，为聚变反应堆等离子体面向材料提供见解
AI.conclusion: AI辅助的文献综述能够揭示科学模式并加速发现，Elhuyar系统展示了结合LLM、结构化AI和人类监督的多智能体方法在科学文献分析中的有效性

title: A Dynamic Atlas of Persian Poetic Symbolism: Families, Fields, and the Historical Rewiring of Meaning
summary: Persian poetry is often remembered through recurrent symbols before it is remembered through plot. Wine vessels, gardens, flames, sacred titles, bodily beauty, and courtly names return across centuries, yet computational work still tends to flatten this material into isolated words or broad document semantics. That misses a practical unit of organization in Persian poetics: related forms travel as families and gain force through recurring relations. Using a corpus of 129,451 poems, we consolidate recurrent forms into traceable families, separate imagistic material from sacred and courtly reference, and map their relations in a multi-layer graph. The symbolic core is relatively sparse, the referential component much denser, and the attachment zone between them selective rather than diffuse. Across 11 Hijri-century bins, some families remain widely distributed, especially Shab (Night), Ruz (Day), and Khaak (Earth). Wine vessels, garden space, flame, and lyric sound strengthen later, while prestige-coded and heroic-courtly vocabulary is weighted earlier. Century-specific graphs show change in arrangement as well as membership. Modularity rises, cross-scope linkage declines, courtly bridges weaken, and sacred bridges strengthen. Hub positions shift too: Kherqe (Sufi Robe) gains late prominence, Farkhondeh {Blessed} and Banafsheh (Violet) recede, and Saaghar (Wine Cup) stays central across the chronology. In this corpus, Persian symbolism appears less as a fixed repertory than as a long-lived system whose internal weights and connections change over time.

AI.tldr: 该研究使用129,451首波斯诗歌构建多层图网络，追踪诗歌中反复出现的象征形式家族，分析其随时间演变的模式和关系变化。
AI.motivation: 波斯诗歌通常通过反复出现的象征符号（如酒器、花园、火焰等）被记忆，但现有计算方法往往将这些材料简化为孤立的词语或宽泛的文档语义，忽略了波斯诗学中一个实用的组织单位：相关形式以家族形式传播并通过重复关系获得力量。
AI.method: 使用129,451首诗歌的语料库，将反复出现的形式整合为可追踪的家族，将意象材料与神圣和宫廷参照分离，并在多层图中映射它们的关系。分析跨越11个伊斯兰世纪的时间段。
AI.result: 象征核心相对稀疏，参照成分更密集，两者之间的连接区域具有选择性而非扩散性。某些家族（如夜、日、土）广泛分布，酒器、花园空间、火焰和抒情声音后期增强，而声望编码和英雄宫廷词汇早期更突出。模块性增加，跨范围连接减少，宫廷桥梁减弱，神圣桥梁增强。枢纽位置也发生变化。
AI.conclusion: 波斯象征主义不是一个固定的剧目，而是一个长寿的系统，其内部权重和连接随时间变化。该方法揭示了波斯诗歌中象征形式的动态演变模式。

title: Infeasibility Aware Large Language Models for Combinatorial Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly explored for NP-hard combinatorial optimization problems, but most existing methods emphasize feasible-instance solution generation and do not explicitly address infeasibility detection. We propose an infeasibility-aware framework that combines certifiable dataset construction, supervised fine-tuning, and LLM-assisted downstream search. For the minor-embedding problem, we introduce a new mathematical programming formulation together with provable zero-phase infeasibility screening, which enables scalable construction of training instances labeled either as feasible with structured certificates or as certifiably infeasible. Using training data generated through this exact optimization pipeline, we show that an 8B-parameter LLM can be fine-tuned to jointly perform solution generation and infeasibility detection. We further utilize LLM outputs as warm starts for downstream local search, providing a practical way to accelerate optimization even when the LLM outputs are imperfect. Experiments show that our fine-tuned model improves overall accuracy by up to 30\% over GPT-5.2; meanwhile LLM-guided warm starts provide up to $2\times$ speedup compared with starting from scratch in downstream local search.

AI.tldr: 提出一个不可行性感知框架，结合可验证数据集构建、监督微调和LLM辅助下游搜索，用于NP难组合优化问题，特别针对minor-embedding问题，显著提升准确性和搜索速度。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM方法主要关注可行实例的解决方案生成，而未能明确处理不可行性检测问题，这在组合优化中至关重要。
AI.method: 1) 提出不可行性感知框架；2) 针对minor-embedding问题引入新的数学规划公式和可证明的零相不可行性筛选；3) 构建可验证的训练数据集；4) 对8B参数LLM进行监督微调；5) 利用LLM输出作为下游局部搜索的暖启动。
AI.result: 微调模型比GPT-5.2整体准确率提升达30%；LLM引导的暖启动使下游局部搜索速度提升达2倍。
AI.conclusion: 该框架成功解决了LLM在组合优化中不可行性检测的不足，通过可验证数据生成和LLM微调，实现了解决方案生成和不可行性检测的联合优化，同时通过暖启动机制加速了下游搜索过程。

title: GRAZE: Grounded Refinement and Motion-Aware Zero-Shot Event Localization
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, accepted to the CVPR 2026 Workshop on Computer Vision in Sports (CVSports) code: https://github.com/AhsanZaidi12/GRAZE
summary: American football practice generates video at scale, yet the interaction of interest occupies only a brief window of each long, untrimmed clip. Reliable biomechanical analysis, therefore, depends on spatiotemporal localization that identifies both the interacting entities and the onset of contact. We study First Point of Contact (FPOC), defined as the first frame in which a player physically touches a tackle dummy, in unconstrained practice footage with camera motion, clutter, multiple similarly equipped athletes, and rapid pose changes around impact. We present GRAZE, a training-free pipeline for FPOC localization that requires no labeled tackle-contact examples. GRAZE uses Grounding DINO to discover candidate player-dummy interactions, refines them with motion-aware temporal reasoning, and uses SAM2 as an explicit pixel-level verifier of contact rather than relying on detection confidence alone. This separation between candidate discovery and contact confirmation makes the approach robust to cluttered scenes and unstable grounding near impact. On 738 tackle-practice videos, GRAZE produces valid outputs for 97.4% of clips and localizes FPOC within $\pm$ 10 frames on 77.5% of all clips and within $\pm$ 20 frames on 82.7% of all clips. These results show that frame-accurate contact onset localization in real-world practice footage is feasible without task-specific training.

AI.tldr: GRAZE是一个无需训练的框架，用于在美式足球训练视频中定位"首次接触点"，无需接触标签，通过目标检测、运动感知时序推理和像素级验证实现鲁棒的接触检测。
AI.motivation: 美式足球训练产生大量视频，但关键交互只占极短时间。可靠的生物力学分析需要时空定位来识别交互实体和接触开始时间。现有方法面临相机运动、杂乱场景、多个相似装备运动员以及冲击时快速姿态变化等挑战。
AI.method: 提出GRAZE训练免费流水线：1) 使用Grounding DINO发现候选球员-假人交互；2) 通过运动感知时序推理进行细化；3) 使用SAM2作为显式像素级接触验证器，不依赖检测置信度。候选发现与接触确认分离使方法对杂乱场景和冲击时不稳定定位具有鲁棒性。
AI.result: 在738个擒抱训练视频上，GRAZE对97.4%的视频产生有效输出，在77.5%的视频中将首次接触点定位在±10帧内，在82.7%的视频中定位在±20帧内。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明，在真实世界训练视频中实现帧级准确的接触开始定位是可行的，无需特定任务训练。分离候选发现与接触确认的方法对杂乱场景具有鲁棒性。

title: Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin: LLM Output Diversity is Everything, Everywhere, All at Once
summary: Research on Large Language Models (LLMs) studies output variation across generation, reasoning, alignment, and representational analysis, often under the umbrella of "diversity." Yet the terminology remains fragmented, largely because the normative objectives underlying tasks are rarely made explicit. We introduce the Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin framework, which models output variation along a homogeneity-heterogeneity axis, where valuation is determined by the task and its normative objective. We organize tasks into four normative contexts: epistemic (factuality), interactional (user utility), societal (representation), and safety (robustness). For each, we examine the failure modes and vocabulary such as hallucination, mode collapse, bias, and erasure through which variation is studied. We apply the framework to analyze all pairwise cross-contextual interactions, revealing that optimizing for one objective, such as improving safety, can inadvertently harm demographic representation or creative diversity. We argue for context-aware evaluation of output variation, reframing it as a property shaped by task objectives rather than a model's intrinsic trait.

AI.tldr: 论文提出Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin框架，将LLM输出变化建模为同质-异质轴，根据任务规范目标（认知、交互、社会、安全）评估变化，强调需基于任务目标进行情境感知评估而非视为模型固有特性。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM研究中关于"多样性"的术语碎片化，主要原因是任务背后的规范目标很少明确说明。需要统一的框架来理解输出变化在不同任务情境下的意义和价值。
AI.method: 提出Magic, Madness, Heaven, Sin框架，将输出变化建模为同质-异质轴，根据四个规范情境（认知性-事实性、交互性-用户效用、社会性-代表性、安全性-鲁棒性）组织任务，分析每种情境下的失败模式和词汇。
AI.result: 应用框架分析所有成对跨情境交互，揭示优化一个目标（如提高安全性）可能无意中损害人口统计代表性或创意多样性。框架提供了系统化理解输出变化在不同任务情境中意义的方法。
AI.conclusion: 输出变化应作为由任务目标塑造的属性进行情境感知评估，而非模型固有特性。需要明确任务规范目标来理解输出变化的价值和意义。

title: Reducing Hallucinations in LLM-based Scientific Literature Analysis Using Peer Context Outlier Detection
summary: Reducing hallucinations in Large Language Models (LLMs) is essential for improving the accuracy of data extraction from large text corpora. Current methods, like prompt engineering and chain-of-thought prompting, focus on individual documents but fail to consider relationships across a corpus. This paper introduces Peer Context Outlier Detection (P-COD), a novel approach that uses the relationships between documents to improve extraction accuracy. Our application domain is in scientific literature summarization, where papers with similar experiment settings should draw similar conclusions. By comparing extracted data to validated peer information within the corpus, we adjust confidence scores and flag low-confidence results for expert review. High-confidence results, supported by peer validation, are considered reliable. Our experiments demonstrate up to 98% precision in outlier detection across 6 domains of science, demonstrating that our design reduces hallucinations, enhances trust in automated systems, and allows researchers to focus on ambiguous cases, streamlining the data extraction workflows.

AI.tldr: P-COD是一种通过文档间关系检测异常值的新方法，利用科学文献中相似实验设置应有相似结论的原理，通过同行验证提高LLM数据提取的准确性，减少幻觉。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在从大型文本语料库中提取数据时存在幻觉问题，现有方法如提示工程和思维链提示只关注单个文档，忽略了语料库中文档间的关系，这限制了数据提取的准确性。
AI.method: 提出Peer Context Outlier Detection (P-COD)方法，利用文档间的关系来提高提取准确性。该方法比较提取的数据与语料库中经过验证的同行信息，调整置信度分数，并将低置信度结果标记为需要专家审查。在科学文献摘要领域，基于相似实验设置的论文应得出相似结论的原理。
AI.result: 实验在6个科学领域展示了高达98%的异常检测精度，证明该方法能有效减少幻觉，增强对自动化系统的信任，并让研究人员专注于模糊案例，简化数据提取工作流程。
AI.conclusion: P-COD通过利用文档间关系显著提高了LLM数据提取的准确性，减少了幻觉，为科学文献摘要等应用提供了更可靠的数据提取解决方案。

title: Why Instruction-Based Unlearning Fails in Diffusion Models?
summary: Instruction-based unlearning has proven effective for modifying the behavior of large language models at inference time, but whether this paradigm extends to other generative models remains unclear. In this work, we investigate instruction-based unlearning in diffusion-based image generation models and show, through controlled experiments across multiple concepts and prompt variants, that diffusion models systematically fail to suppress targeted concepts when guided solely by natural-language unlearning instructions. By analyzing both the CLIP text encoder and cross-attention dynamics during the denoising process, we find that unlearning instructions do not induce sustained reductions in attention to the targeted concept tokens, causing the targeted concept representations to persist throughout generation. These results reveal a fundamental limitation of prompt-level instruction in diffusion models and suggest that effective unlearning requires interventions beyond inference-time language control.

AI.tldr: 扩散模型无法通过自然语言指令有效遗忘特定概念，仅靠提示级控制不足以实现有效遗忘
AI.motivation: 研究指令式遗忘在基于扩散的图像生成模型中的有效性，探索这种范式是否适用于除大语言模型之外的其他生成模型
AI.method: 通过多个概念和提示变体的受控实验，分析CLIP文本编码器和去噪过程中的交叉注意力动态，研究指令式遗忘在扩散模型中的效果
AI.result: 扩散模型在仅受自然语言遗忘指令引导时，系统性地无法抑制目标概念；遗忘指令未能持续减少对目标概念标记的注意力，导致目标概念表示在整个生成过程中持续存在
AI.conclusion: 扩散模型中提示级指令存在根本性限制，有效的遗忘需要在推理时语言控制之外进行干预

title: A Self-Evolving Agentic Framework for Metasurface Inverse Design
summary: Metasurface inverse design has become central to realizing complex optical functionality, yet translating target responses into executable, solver-compatible workflows still demands specialized expertise in computational electromagnetics and solver-specific software engineering. Recent large language models (LLMs) offer a complementary route to reducing this workflow-construction burden, but existing language-driven systems remain largely session-bounded and do not preserve reusable workflow knowledge across inverse-design tasks. We present an agentic framework for metasurface inverse design that addresses this limitation through context-level skill evolution. The framework couples a coding agent, evolving skill artifacts, and a deterministic evaluator grounded in physical simulation so that solver-specific strategies can be iteratively refined across tasks without modifying model weights or the underlying physics solver. We evaluate the framework on a benchmark spanning multiple metasurface inverse-design task types, with separate training-aligned and held-out task families. Evolved skills raise in-distribution task success from 38% to 74%, increase criteria pass fraction from 0.510 to 0.870, and reduce average attempts from 4.10 to 2.30. On held-out task families, binary success changes only marginally, but improvements in best margin together with shifts in error composition and agent behavior indicate partial transfer of workflow knowledge. These results suggest that the main value of skill evolution lies in accumulating reusable solver-specific expertise around reliable computational engines, thereby offering a practical path toward more autonomous and accessible metasurface inverse-design workflows.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了一个基于智能体框架的元表面逆向设计系统，通过上下文级技能演化来积累可重用的求解器专业知识，减少对计算电磁学专业知识的依赖。
AI.motivation: 元表面逆向设计需要复杂的计算电磁学专业知识和求解器特定的软件工程，现有的大语言模型系统缺乏跨任务的可重用工作流知识积累，限制了设计效率。
AI.method: 开发了一个智能体框架，包含编码智能体、演化技能工件和基于物理仿真的确定性评估器，通过迭代精化求解器特定策略而不修改模型权重或底层物理求解器。
AI.result: 在训练对齐任务中，成功率从38%提升到74%，标准通过率从0.510提高到0.870，平均尝试次数从4.10减少到2.30；在保留任务族中显示出部分工作流知识迁移。
AI.conclusion: 技能演化的主要价值在于围绕可靠计算引擎积累可重用的求解器专业知识，为实现更自主和易访问的元表面逆向设计工作流提供了实用路径。

title: EgoFlow: Gradient-Guided Flow Matching for Egocentric 6DoF Object Motion Generation
summary: Understanding and predicting object motion from egocentric video is fundamental to embodied perception and interaction. However, generating physically consistent 6DoF trajectories remains challenging due to occlusions, fast motion, and the lack of explicit physical reasoning in existing generative models. We present EgoFlow, a flow-matching framework that synthesizes realistic and physically plausible trajectories conditioned on multimodal egocentric observations. EgoFlow employs a hybrid Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver architecture to jointly model temporal dynamics, scene geometry, and semantic intent, while a gradient-guided inference process enforces differentiable physical constraints such as collision avoidance and motion smoothness. This combination yields coherent and controllable motion generation without post-hoc filtering or additional supervision. Experiments on real-world datasets HD-EPIC, EgoExo4D, and HOT3D show that EgoFlow outperforms diffusion-based and transformer baselines in accuracy, generalization, and physical realism, reducing collision rates by up to 79%, and strong generalization to unseen scenes. Our results highlight the promise of flow-based generative modeling for scalable and physically grounded egocentric motion understanding.

AI.tldr: EgoFlow是一个基于流匹配的框架，用于从第一人称视角视频中生成物理一致的6自由度物体轨迹，通过混合Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver架构和多模态条件输入实现物理约束的运动生成。
AI.motivation: 从第一人称视频理解和预测物体运动是具身感知和交互的基础，但由于遮挡、快速运动以及现有生成模型缺乏显式物理推理，生成物理一致的6自由度轨迹仍然具有挑战性。
AI.method: 提出EgoFlow流匹配框架，采用混合Mamba-Transformer-Perceiver架构联合建模时间动态、场景几何和语义意图，通过梯度引导推理过程强制执行可微物理约束（如碰撞避免和运动平滑性）。
AI.result: 在HD-EPIC、EgoExo4D和HOT3D数据集上的实验表明，EgoFlow在准确性、泛化性和物理真实性方面优于基于扩散和Transformer的基线方法，碰撞率降低高达79%，并在未见场景中表现出强泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果突显了基于流的生成建模在可扩展和物理基础的自我中心运动理解方面的潜力，实现了无需后处理过滤或额外监督的连贯可控运动生成。

title: Read More, Think More: Revisiting Observation Reduction for Web Agents
summary: Web agents based on large language models (LLMs) rely on observations of web pages -- commonly represented as HTML -- as the basis for identifying available actions and planning subsequent steps. Prior work has treated the verbosity of HTML as an obstacle to performance and adopted observation reduction as a standard practice. We revisit this trend and demonstrate that the optimal observation representation depends on model capability and thinking token budget: (1) compact observations (accessibility trees) are preferable for lower-capability models, while detailed observations (HTML) are advantageous for higher-capability models; moreover, increasing thinking tokens further amplifies the benefit of HTML. (2) Our error analysis suggests that higher-capability models exploit layout information in HTML for better action grounding, while lower-capability models suffer from increased hallucination under longer inputs. We also find that incorporating observation history improves performance across most models and settings, and a diff-based representation offers a token-efficient alternative. Based on these findings, we suggest practical guidelines: adaptively select observation representations based on model capability and thinking token budget, and incorporate observation history using diff-based representations.

AI.tldr: 研究发现网页代理的最佳观察表示取决于模型能力和思考token预算：低能力模型适合紧凑表示，高能力模型适合详细HTML表示，且增加思考token会放大HTML优势。
AI.motivation: 重新审视网页代理中HTML冗长性作为性能障碍的传统观点，探索不同模型能力下观察表示的最优选择。
AI.method: 通过实验比较不同模型在不同观察表示（HTML vs 可访问性树）下的性能，分析错误模式，并测试观察历史（包括差分表示）的影响。
AI.result: 1) 低能力模型适合紧凑表示，高能力模型适合详细HTML表示；2) 增加思考token会放大HTML优势；3) 高能力模型利用HTML布局信息进行更好的动作定位；4) 观察历史能提升大多数模型性能，差分表示是token高效替代方案。
AI.conclusion: 提出实用指南：根据模型能力和思考token预算自适应选择观察表示，并使用差分表示纳入观察历史。

title: AgentSocialBench: Evaluating Privacy Risks in Human-Centered Agentic Social Networks
summary: With the rise of personalized, persistent LLM agent frameworks such as OpenClaw, human-centered agentic social networks in which teams of collaborative AI agents serve individual users in a social network across multiple domains are becoming a reality. This setting creates novel privacy challenges: agents must coordinate across domain boundaries, mediate between humans, and interact with other users' agents, all while protecting sensitive personal information. While prior work has evaluated multi-agent coordination and privacy preservation, the dynamics and privacy risks of human-centered agentic social networks remain unexplored. To this end, we introduce AgentSocialBench, the first benchmark to systematically evaluate privacy risk in this setting, comprising scenarios across seven categories spanning dyadic and multi-party interactions, grounded in realistic user profiles with hierarchical sensitivity labels and directed social graphs. Our experiments reveal that privacy in agentic social networks is fundamentally harder than in single-agent settings: (1) cross-domain and cross-user coordination creates persistent leakage pressure even when agents are explicitly instructed to protect information, (2) privacy instructions that teach agents how to abstract sensitive information paradoxically cause them to discuss it more (we call it abstraction paradox). These findings underscore that current LLM agents lack robust mechanisms for privacy preservation in human-centered agentic social networks, and that new approaches beyond prompt engineering are needed to make agent-mediated social coordination safe for real-world deployment.

AI.tldr: AgentSocialBench是首个评估以人为中心的智能体社交网络中隐私风险的基准，发现跨域协调和抽象悖论使隐私保护比单智能体设置更困难。
AI.motivation: 随着个性化、持久性LLM智能体框架（如OpenClaw）的兴起，以人为中心的智能体社交网络正在成为现实，其中协作AI智能体团队在社交网络中为个体用户跨多个领域服务。这种设置带来了新的隐私挑战：智能体必须跨领域边界协调、在人类之间调解、与其他用户的智能体交互，同时保护敏感个人信息。虽然先前工作评估了多智能体协调和隐私保护，但以人为中心的智能体社交网络的动态和隐私风险仍未探索。
AI.method: 研究者引入了AgentSocialBench，这是首个系统评估该设置中隐私风险的基准。该基准包含七个类别的场景，涵盖二元和多参与者交互，基于具有分层敏感性标签和定向社交图的现实用户配置文件。
AI.result: 实验显示，智能体社交网络中的隐私保护比单智能体设置更困难：(1)跨域和跨用户协调即使智能体被明确指示保护信息也会产生持续泄漏压力；(2)教导智能体如何抽象敏感信息的隐私指令反而导致它们更频繁地讨论这些信息（称为抽象悖论）。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM智能体缺乏在以人为中心的智能体社交网络中保护隐私的稳健机制，需要超越提示工程的新方法，才能使智能体介导的社交协调在现实世界部署中安全。

title: Better Rigs, Not Bigger Networks: A Body Model Ablation for Gaussian Avatars
summary: Recent 3D Gaussian splatting methods built atop SMPL achieve remarkable visual fidelity while continually increasing the complexity of the overall training architecture. We demonstrate that much of this complexity is unnecessary: by replacing SMPL with the Momentum Human Rig (MHR), estimated via SAM-3D-Body, a minimal pipeline with no learned deformations or pose-dependent corrections achieves the highest reported PSNR and competitive or superior LPIPS and SSIM on PeopleSnapshot and ZJU-MoCap. To disentangle pose estimation quality from body model representational capacity, we perform two controlled ablations: translating SAM-3D-Body meshes to SMPL-X, and translating the original dataset's SMPL poses into MHR both retrained under identical conditions. These ablations confirm that body model expressiveness has been a primary bottleneck in avatar reconstruction, with both mesh representational capacity and pose estimation quality contributing meaningfully to the full pipeline's gains.

AI.tldr: 使用Momentum Human Rig替代SMPL，无需学习变形或姿态相关修正，在PeopleSnapshot和ZJU-MoCap数据集上取得最高PSNR和竞争性LPIPS/SSIM
AI.motivation: 现有基于SMPL的3D高斯泼溅方法架构复杂，作者认为这种复杂性是不必要的。通过使用更优的身体模型和姿态估计，可以简化流程并提升性能
AI.method: 用Momentum Human Rig替代SMPL，通过SAM-3D-Body估计MHR，构建最小化流程，无需学习变形或姿态相关修正。进行两个对照消融实验：将SAM-3D-Body网格转换为SMPL-X，以及将原始数据集的SMPL姿态转换为MHR
AI.result: 在PeopleSnapshot和ZJU-MoCap数据集上取得最高PSNR和竞争性或更优的LPIPS、SSIM指标。消融实验证实身体模型表达能力是虚拟人重建的主要瓶颈
AI.conclusion: 身体模型的表达能力和姿态估计质量是提升虚拟人重建性能的关键因素，简化架构同时使用更优的身体模型可以取得更好的结果

title: LLM Agents as Social Scientists: A Human-AI Collaborative Platform for Social Science Automation
summary: Traditional social science research often requires designing complex experiments across vast methodological spaces and depends on real human participants, making it labor-intensive, costly, and difficult to scale. Here we present S-Researcher, an LLM-agent-based platform that assists researchers in conducting social science research more efficiently and at greater scale by "siliconizing" both the research process and the participant pool. To build S-Researcher, we first develop YuLan-OneSim, a large-scale social simulation system designed around three core requirements: generality via auto-programming from natural language to executable scenarios, scalability via a distributed architecture supporting up to 100,000 concurrent agents, and reliability via feedback-driven LLM fine-tuning. Leveraging this system, S-Researcher supports researchers in designing social experiments, simulating human behavior with LLM agents, analyzing results, and generating reports, forming a complete human-AI collaborative research loop in which researchers retain oversight and intervention at every stage. We operationalize LLM simulation research paradigms into three canonical reasoning modes (induction, deduction, and abduction) and validate S-Researcher through systematic case studies: inductive reproduction of cultural dynamics consistent with Axelrod's theory, deductive testing of competing hypotheses on teacher attention validated against survey data, and abductive identification of a cooperation mechanism in public goods games confirmed by human experiments. S-Researcher establishes a new human--AI collaborative paradigm for social science, in which computational simulation augments human researchers to accelerate discovery across the full spectrum of social inquiry.

AI.tldr: S-Researcher是一个基于LLM代理的平台，通过"硅化"研究过程和参与者池，帮助研究人员更高效、更大规模地进行社会科学研究。
AI.motivation: 传统社会科学研究需要设计复杂的实验，依赖真实人类参与者，导致研究劳动密集、成本高昂且难以扩展。需要一种能够提高效率、降低成本并扩大规模的研究方法。
AI.method: 首先开发YuLan-OneSim大规模社会模拟系统，具备三个核心特性：通过自然语言到可执行场景的自动编程实现通用性，通过分布式架构支持高达10万并发代理实现可扩展性，通过反馈驱动的LLM微调确保可靠性。基于此系统，S-Researcher支持研究人员设计社会实验、用LLM代理模拟人类行为、分析结果和生成报告。
AI.result: 将LLM模拟研究范式操作化为三种经典推理模式（归纳、演绎和溯因），并通过系统案例研究验证：归纳再现与Axelrod理论一致的文化动态，演绎测试教师注意力竞争假设并与调查数据验证，溯因识别公共物品游戏中的合作机制并通过人类实验确认。
AI.conclusion: S-Researcher建立了社会科学研究的新人机协作范式，其中计算模拟增强人类研究人员，加速整个社会科学探究领域的发现。

title: Nonlinear Methods for Analyzing Pose in Behavioral Research
summary: Advances in markerless pose estimation have made it possible to capture detailed human movement in naturalistic settings using standard video, enabling new forms of behavioral analysis at scale.
