However, the high dimensionality, noise, and temporal complexity of pose data raise significant challenges for extracting meaningful patterns of coordination and behavioral change. This paper presents a general-purpose analysis pipeline for human pose data, designed to support both linear and nonlinear characterizations of movement across diverse experimental contexts. The pipeline combines principled preprocessing, dimensionality reduction, and recurrence-based time series analysis to quantify the temporal structure of movement dynamics. To illustrate the pipeline's flexibility, we present three case studies spanning facial and full-body movement, 2D and 3D data, and individual versus multi-agent behavior. Together, these examples demonstrate how the same analytic workflow can be adapted to extract theoretically meaningful insights from complex pose time series.

AI.tldr: 提出一个通用的人体姿态数据分析流程，结合预处理、降维和基于递归的时间序列分析，用于从复杂姿态数据中提取有意义的运动模式。
AI.motivation: 无标记姿态估计技术使得使用标准视频捕捉自然场景中的人类运动成为可能，但姿态数据的高维度、噪声和时间复杂性给提取有意义的协调和行为变化模式带来了挑战。
AI.method: 开发了一个通用分析流程，结合原则性预处理、降维和基于递归的时间序列分析，量化运动动态的时间结构。
AI.result: 通过三个案例研究展示了流程的灵活性：涵盖面部和全身运动、2D和3D数据、个体与多智能体行为，证明同一分析工作流可以适应不同情境。
AI.conclusion: 该分析流程能够从复杂姿态时间序列中提取理论上有意义的见解，支持线性和非线性运动表征，适用于多样化的实验环境。

title: DeltaMem: Towards Agentic Memory Management via Reinforcement Learning
summary: Recent advances in persona-centric memory have revealed the powerful capability of multi-agent systems in managing persona memory, especially in conversational scenarios. However, these complex frameworks often suffer from information loss and are fragile across varying scenarios, resulting in suboptimal performance. In this paper, we propose DeltaMem, an agentic memory management system that formulates persona-centric memory management as an end-to-end task within a single-agent setting. To further improve the performance of our agentic memory manager, we draw inspiration from the evolution of human memory and synthesize a user-assistant dialogue dataset along with corresponding operation-level memory updating labels. Building on this, we introduce a novel Memory-based Levenshtein Distance to formalize the memory updating reward, and propose a tailored reinforcement learning framework to further enhance the management capabilities of DeltaMem. Extensive experiments show that both training-free and RL-trained DeltaMem outperform all product-level baselines across diverse long-term memory benchmarks, including LoCoMo, HaluMem, and PersonaMem.

AI.tldr: DeltaMem：一个基于单智能体的记忆管理系统，通过强化学习优化角色中心记忆管理，在多个长期记忆基准测试中超越现有产品级基线
AI.motivation: 现有角色中心记忆管理系统存在信息丢失和场景适应性差的问题，导致性能不佳。需要更鲁棒、端到端的记忆管理解决方案。
AI.method: 1. 提出DeltaMem单智能体记忆管理系统；2. 基于人类记忆演化原理合成用户-助手对话数据集及操作级记忆更新标签；3. 引入基于记忆的Levenshtein距离形式化记忆更新奖励；4. 设计定制化强化学习框架增强管理能力
AI.result: DeltaMem（包括无训练版本和RL训练版本）在LoCoMo、HaluMem和PersonaMem等多个长期记忆基准测试中均超越所有产品级基线方法
AI.conclusion: DeltaMem通过单智能体端到端框架和强化学习优化，有效解决了角色中心记忆管理中的信息丢失和场景脆弱性问题，在长期记忆任务中表现出色

title: A Role-Based LLM Framework for Structured Information Extraction from Healthy Food Policies
summary: Current Large Language Model (LLM) approaches for information extraction (IE) in the healthy food policy domain are often hindered by various factors, including misinformation, specifically hallucinations, misclassifications, and omissions that result from the structural diversity and inconsistency of policy documents. To address these limitations, this study proposes a role-based LLM framework that automates the IE from unstructured policy data by assigning specialized roles: an LLM policy analyst for metadata and mechanism classification, an LLM legal strategy specialist for identifying complex legal approaches, and an LLM food system expert for categorizing food system stages. This framework mimics expert analysis workflows by incorporating structured domain knowledge, including explicit definitions of legal mechanisms and classification criteria, into role-specific prompts. We evaluate the framework using 608 healthy food policies from the Healthy Food Policy Project (HFPP) database, comparing its performance against zero-shot, few-shot, and chain-of-thought (CoT) baselines using Llama-3.3-70B. Our proposed framework demonstrates superior performance in complex reasoning tasks, offering a reliable and transparent methodology for automating IE from health policies.

AI.tldr: 提出基于角色的LLM框架，通过分配专业角色（政策分析师、法律策略专家、食品系统专家）来改进健康食品政策信息提取，解决现有方法中的幻觉、误分类和遗漏问题。
AI.motivation: 当前LLM在健康食品政策领域的信息提取方法受到多种因素阻碍，包括错误信息（幻觉）、误分类和遗漏，这些问题源于政策文档的结构多样性和不一致性。
AI.method: 提出基于角色的LLM框架，分配三个专业角色：LLM政策分析师（元数据和机制分类）、LLM法律策略专家（识别复杂法律方法）、LLM食品系统专家（分类食品系统阶段）。框架通过将结构化领域知识（法律机制定义和分类标准）整合到角色特定提示中，模拟专家分析工作流程。
AI.result: 在Healthy Food Policy Project数据库的608个健康食品政策上评估框架性能，与零样本、少样本和思维链基线（使用Llama-3.3-70B）进行比较。提出的框架在复杂推理任务中表现出优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为健康政策信息提取自动化提供了可靠且透明的方法论，在复杂推理任务中表现优异。

title: Reinforcing Consistency in Video MLLMs with Structured Rewards
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in video understanding. However, seemingly plausible outputs often suffer from poor visual and temporal grounding: a model may fabricate object existence, assign incorrect attributes, or collapse repeated events while still producing a globally reasonable caption or answer. We study this failure mode through a compositional consistency audit that decomposes a caption into supporting factual and temporal claims, investigating whether a correct high-level prediction is actually backed by valid lower-level evidence. Our top-down audit reveals that even correct root relational claims often lack reliable attribute and existence support. This indicates that standard sentence-level supervision is a weak proxy for faithful video understanding. Furthermore, when turning to reinforcement learning (RL) for better alignment, standard sentence-level rewards often prove too coarse to accurately localize specific grounding failures. To address this, we replace generic sentence-level rewards with a structured reward built from factual and temporal units. Our training objective integrates three complementary components: (1) an instance-aware scene-graph reward for factual objects, attributes, and relations; (2) a temporal reward for event ordering and repetition; and (3) a video-grounded VQA reward for hierarchical self-verification. Across temporal, general video understanding, and hallucination-oriented benchmarks, this objective yields consistent gains on open-source backbones. These results suggest that structured reward shaping is a practical route to more faithful video understanding.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种结构化奖励方法来解决多模态大语言模型在视频理解中的幻觉问题，通过分解事实和时间单元来改善视觉和时间基础性。
AI.motivation: 多模态大语言模型在视频理解方面取得了显著进展，但输出结果经常存在视觉和时间基础性问题，如虚构对象存在、分配错误属性或压缩重复事件。标准的句子级监督是视频理解忠实性的弱代理，而强化学习中句子级奖励过于粗糙，无法准确定位具体的基础性失败。
AI.method: 提出了一种结构化奖励方法，包含三个互补组件：1）实例感知的场景图奖励，用于事实对象、属性和关系；2）时间奖励，用于事件排序和重复；3）视频基础性的VQA奖励，用于分层自我验证。通过组合一致性审计分解字幕为支持性事实和时间声明。
AI.result: 在时间、通用视频理解和幻觉导向的基准测试中，该方法在开源骨干网络上取得了一致的性能提升。结构化奖励塑造是提高视频理解忠实性的实用途径。
AI.conclusion: 结构化奖励方法能够有效解决多模态大语言模型在视频理解中的幻觉问题，通过分解事实和时间单元来提供更精确的监督信号，从而获得更忠实的视频理解能力。

title: Swift-SVD: Theoretical Optimality Meets Practical Efficiency in Low-Rank LLM Compression
summary: The deployment of Large Language Models is constrained by the memory and bandwidth demands of static weights and dynamic Key-Value cache. SVD-based compression provides a hardware-friendly solution to reduce these costs. However, existing methods suffer from two key limitations: some are suboptimal in reconstruction error, while others are theoretically optimal but practically inefficient. In this paper, we propose Swift-SVD, an activation-aware, closed-form compression framework that simultaneously guarantees theoretical optimum, practical efficiency and numerical stability. Swift-SVD incrementally aggregates covariance of output activations given a batch of inputs and performs a single eigenvalue decomposition after aggregation, enabling training-free, fast, and optimal layer-wise low-rank approximation. We employ effective rank to analyze local layer-wise compressibility and design a dynamic rank allocation strategy that jointly accounts for local reconstruction loss and end-to-end layer importance. Extensive experiments across six LLMs and eight datasets demonstrate that Swift-SVD outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving optimal compression accuracy while delivering 3-70X speedups in end-to-end compression time. Our code will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: Swift-SVD是一个激活感知的闭式压缩框架，通过增量聚合输出激活的协方差并进行单次特征值分解，实现训练免费、快速且最优的层间低秩近似，在保证理论最优的同时提供3-70倍的端到端压缩加速。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型的部署受到静态权重和动态键值缓存的内存和带宽需求的限制。现有的SVD压缩方法存在两个关键限制：一些方法在重建误差上不是最优的，而另一些方法理论上最优但实际效率低下。
AI.method: Swift-SVD是一个激活感知的闭式压缩框架，通过增量聚合给定输入批次下输出激活的协方差，并在聚合后执行单次特征值分解。该方法使用有效秩分析局部层间可压缩性，并设计了动态秩分配策略，同时考虑局部重建损失和端到端层重要性。
AI.result: 在六个LLM和八个数据集上的广泛实验表明，Swift-SVD优于最先进的基线方法，在实现最优压缩精度的同时，端到端压缩时间加速了3-70倍。
AI.conclusion: Swift-SVD提供了一个同时保证理论最优、实际效率和数值稳定的压缩框架，为大型语言模型的部署提供了硬件友好的解决方案。

title: PHMForge: A Scenario-Driven Agentic Benchmark for Industrial Asset Lifecycle Maintenance
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly deployed for complex tool-orchestration tasks, yet existing benchmarks fail to capture the rigorous demands of industrial domains where incorrect decisions carry significant safety and financial consequences. To address this critical gap, we introduce PHMForge, the first comprehensive benchmark specifically designed to evaluate LLM agents on Prognostics and Health Management (PHM) tasks through realistic interactions with domain-specific MCP servers. Our benchmark encompasses 75 expert-curated scenarios spanning 7 industrial asset classes (turbofan engines, bearings, electric motors, gearboxes, aero-engines) across 5 core task categories: Remaining Useful Life (RUL) Prediction, Fault Classification, Engine Health Analysis, Cost-Benefit Analysis, and Safety/Policy Evaluation. To enable rigorous evaluation, we construct 65 specialized tools across two MCP servers and implement execution-based evaluators with task-commensurate metrics: MAE/RMSE for regression, F1-score for classification, and categorical matching for health assessments. Through extensive evaluation of leading frameworks (ReAct, Cursor Agent, Claude Code) paired with frontier LLMs (Claude Sonnet 4.0, GPT-4o, Granite-3.0-8B), we find that even top-performing configurations achieve only 68\% task completion, with systematic failures in tool orchestration (23\% incorrect sequencing), multi-asset reasoning (14.9 percentage point degradation), and cross-equipment generalization (42.7\% on held-out datasets). We open-source our complete benchmark, including scenario specifications, ground truth templates, tool implementations, and evaluation scripts, to catalyze research in agentic industrial AI.

AI.tldr: PHMForge是首个专门评估LLM代理在工业预测与健康管理任务中表现的基准测试，涵盖75个专家策划场景、7类工业资产和5个核心任务类别，通过MCP服务器实现真实交互。
AI.motivation: 现有基准测试无法满足工业领域对LLM代理的严格要求，工业领域决策错误会带来重大的安全和财务后果，需要专门针对预测与健康管理任务的评估基准。
AI.method: 构建包含75个专家策划场景的基准测试，涵盖7类工业资产和5个核心任务类别；开发65个专用工具分布在两个MCP服务器上；实现基于执行的评估器，使用任务相应的指标（MAE/RMSE、F1分数、分类匹配）。
AI.result: 即使顶级配置（ReAct、Cursor Agent、Claude Code与前沿LLM组合）也只能完成68%的任务，存在工具编排错误（23%）、多资产推理能力下降（14.9个百分点）和跨设备泛化能力弱（42.7%）等系统性失败。
AI.conclusion: PHMForge基准测试揭示了当前LLM代理在工业PHM任务中的局限性，开源完整基准以推动工业AI代理研究发展。

title: Prime Once, then Reprogram Locally: An Efficient Alternative to Black-Box Service Model Adaptation
summary: Adapting closed-box service models (i.e., APIs) for target tasks typically relies on reprogramming via Zeroth-Order Optimization (ZOO). However, this standard strategy is known for extensive, costly API calls and often suffers from slow, unstable optimization. Furthermore, we observe that this paradigm faces new challenges with modern APIs (e.g., GPT-4o). These models can be less sensitive to the input perturbations ZOO relies on, thereby hindering performance gains. To address these limitations, we propose an Alternative efficient Reprogramming approach for Service models (AReS). Instead of direct, continuous closed-box optimization, AReS initiates a single-pass interaction with the service API to prime an amenable local pre-trained encoder. This priming stage trains only a lightweight layer on top of the local encoder, making it highly receptive to the subsequent glass-box (white-box) reprogramming stage performed directly on the local model. Consequently, all subsequent adaptation and inference rely solely on this local proxy, eliminating all further API costs. Experiments demonstrate AReS's effectiveness where prior ZOO-based methods struggle: on GPT-4o, AReS achieves a +27.8% gain over the zero-shot baseline, a task where ZOO-based methods provide little to no improvement. Broadly, across ten diverse datasets, AReS outperforms state-of-the-art methods (+2.5% for VLMs, +15.6% for standard VMs) while reducing API calls by over 99.99%. AReS thus provides a robust and practical solution for adapting modern closed-box models.

AI.tldr: 提出AReS方法，通过单次API交互训练本地编码器，实现免API调用的黑盒模型适配，显著提升性能并减少99.99%的API调用
AI.motivation: 传统基于零阶优化的黑盒模型适配方法存在API调用成本高、优化缓慢不稳定等问题，且现代API（如GPT-4o）对输入扰动不敏感，导致性能提升有限
AI.method: AReS方法采用两阶段策略：1）单次API交互阶段，通过轻量层训练本地预训练编码器；2）白盒重编程阶段，直接在本地代理模型上进行适配和推理，完全避免后续API调用
AI.result: 在GPT-4o上，AReS相比零样本基线提升27.8%，而传统ZOO方法几乎无改进；在10个多样化数据集上，AReS超越SOTA方法（VLM提升2.5%，标准VM提升15.6%），同时减少99.99%的API调用
AI.conclusion: AReS为现代黑盒模型适配提供了鲁棒且实用的解决方案，通过本地代理模型实现高效适配，显著降低API成本并提升性能

title: Grounding AI-in-Education Development in Teachers' Voices: Findings from a National Survey in Indonesia
summary: Despite emerging use in Indonesian classrooms, there is limited large-scale, teacher-centred evidence on how AI is used in practice and what support teachers need, hindering the development of context-appropriate AI systems and policies. To address this gap, we conduct a nationwide survey of 349 K-12 teachers across elementary, junior high, and senior high schools. We find increasing use of AI for pedagogy, content development, and teaching media, although adoption remains uneven. Elementary teachers report more consistent use, while senior high teachers engage less; mid-career teachers assign higher importance to AI, and teachers in Eastern Indonesia perceive greater value. Across levels, teachers primarily use AI to reduce instructional preparation workload (e.g., assessment, lesson planning, and material development). However, generic outputs, infrastructure constraints, and limited contextual alignment continue to hinder effective classroom integration.

AI.tldr: 印尼K-12教师AI使用调查显示：AI在教学中应用增加但分布不均，主要用于减轻教学准备负担，但仍面临通用输出、基础设施和情境适配等挑战。
AI.motivation: 尽管AI在印尼课堂中的应用逐渐增多，但缺乏大规模、以教师为中心的实证研究来了解实际使用情况和教师需求，这阻碍了开发适合当地情境的AI系统和政策。
AI.method: 对349名K-12教师进行全国性调查，涵盖小学、初中和高中不同教育阶段。
AI.result: 研究发现：1）AI在教学、内容开发和教学媒体中的应用增加但分布不均；2）小学教师使用更一致，高中教师参与较少；3）中年教师更重视AI，东印尼地区教师感知价值更高；4）各阶段教师主要用AI减轻教学准备负担；5）通用输出、基础设施限制和情境适配不足阻碍有效整合。
AI.conclusion: 需要开发更符合印尼教育情境的AI系统，解决基础设施和情境适配问题，以支持教师有效整合AI技术。

title: RAE-AR: Taming Autoregressive Models with Representation Autoencoders
summary: The latent space of generative modeling is long dominated by the VAE encoder. The latents from the pretrained representation encoders (e.g., DINO, SigLIP, MAE) are previously considered inappropriate for generative modeling. Recently, RAE method lights the hope and reveals that the representation autoencoder can also achieve competitive performance as the VAE encoder. However, the integration of representation autoencoder into continuous autoregressive (AR) models, remains largely unexplored. In this work, we investigate the challenges of employing high-dimensional representation autoencoders within the AR paradigm, denoted as \textit{RAE-AR}. We focus on the unique properties of AR models and identify two primary hurdles: complex token-wise distribution modeling and the high-dimensionality amplified training-inference gap (exposure bias). To address these, we introduce token simplification via distribution normalization to ease modeling difficulty and improve convergence. Furthermore, we enhance prediction robustness by incorporating Gaussian noise injection during training to mitigate exposure bias. Our empirical results demonstrate that these modifications substantially bridge the performance gap, enabling representation autoencoder to achieve results comparable to traditional VAEs on AR models. This work paves the way for a more unified architecture across visual understanding and generative modeling.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了将表示自编码器（RAE）整合到连续自回归（AR）模型中的挑战，提出了分布归一化和高斯噪声注入两种方法来解决高维表示自编码器在AR范式中的建模难题。
AI.motivation: 传统的VAE编码器长期主导生成模型的潜在空间，而预训练表示编码器（如DINO、SigLIP、MAE）的潜在表示被认为不适合生成建模。虽然RAE方法显示了表示自编码器也能达到与VAE编码器相当的性能，但将其整合到连续自回归模型中仍未被充分探索。
AI.method: 提出了RAE-AR框架，针对AR模型的两个主要挑战：复杂的token级分布建模和高维性放大的训练-推理差距（暴露偏差）。通过分布归一化进行token简化以降低建模难度，并在训练中加入高斯噪声注入来增强预测鲁棒性，缓解暴露偏差。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，这些修改显著缩小了性能差距，使表示自编码器在AR模型上能够达到与传统VAE相当的结果。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作为实现视觉理解和生成建模之间更统一的架构铺平了道路，证明了表示自编码器在自回归生成模型中具有与VAE编码器相当的潜力。

title: UniRecGen: Unifying Multi-View 3D Reconstruction and Generation
summary: Sparse-view 3D modeling represents a fundamental tension between reconstruction fidelity and generative plausibility. While feed-forward reconstruction excels in efficiency and input alignment, it often lacks the global priors needed for structural completeness. Conversely, diffusion-based generation provides rich geometric details but struggles with multi-view consistency. We present UniRecGen, a unified framework that integrates these two paradigms into a single cooperative system. To overcome inherent conflicts in coordinate spaces, 3D representations, and training objectives, we align both models within a shared canonical space. We employ disentangled cooperative learning, which maintains stable training while enabling seamless collaboration during inference. Specifically, the reconstruction module is adapted to provide canonical geometric anchors, while the diffusion generator leverages latent-augmented conditioning to refine and complete the geometric structure. Experimental results demonstrate that UniRecGen achieves superior fidelity and robustness, outperforming existing methods in creating complete and consistent 3D models from sparse observations.

AI.tldr: UniRecGen是一个统一框架，将前馈重建和扩散生成结合，在共享规范空间中协同工作，从稀疏观测中创建完整一致的3D模型。
AI.motivation: 稀疏视图3D建模面临重建保真度与生成合理性之间的基本矛盾：前馈重建效率高但对齐输入但缺乏结构完整性所需的全局先验，而扩散生成提供丰富几何细节但多视图一致性差。
AI.method: 提出UniRecGen统一框架，将两种范式整合到单一协作系统中。通过共享规范空间对齐坐标空间、3D表示和训练目标，采用解耦协作学习保持训练稳定性并在推理时实现无缝协作。重建模块提供规范几何锚点，扩散生成器利用潜在增强条件来细化和完成几何结构。
AI.result: 实验结果表明，UniRecGen在从稀疏观测创建完整一致的3D模型方面，实现了卓越的保真度和鲁棒性，优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过统一重建和生成范式，UniRecGen成功解决了稀疏视图3D建模中的保真度与合理性矛盾，为创建高质量3D模型提供了有效解决方案。

title: Fragile Reasoning: A Mechanistic Analysis of LLM Sensitivity to Meaning-Preserving Perturbations
summary: Large language models demonstrate strong performance on mathematical reasoning benchmarks, yet remain surprisingly fragile to meaning-preserving surface perturbations. We systematically evaluate three open-weight LLMs, Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B, and Qwen2.5-7B, on 677 GSM8K problems paired with semantically equivalent variants generated through name substitution and number format paraphrasing. All three models exhibit substantial answer-flip rates (28.8%-45.1%), with number paraphrasing consistently more disruptive than name swaps. To trace the mechanistic basis of these failures, we introduce the Mechanistic Perturbation Diagnostics (MPD) framework, combining logit lens analysis, activation patching, component ablation, and the Cascading Amplification Index (CAI) into a unified diagnostic pipeline. CAI, a novel metric quantifying layer-wise divergence amplification, outperforms first divergence layer as a failure predictor for two of three architectures (AUC up to 0.679). Logit lens reveals that flipped samples diverge from correct predictions at significantly earlier layers than stable samples. Activation patching reveals a stark architectural divide in failure localizability: Llama-3 failures are recoverable by patching at specific layers (43/60 samples), while Mistral and Qwen failures are broadly distributed (3/60 and 0/60). Based on these diagnostic signals, we propose a mechanistic failure taxonomy (localized, distributed, and entangled) and validate it through targeted repair experiments: steering vectors and layer fine-tuning recover 12.2% of localized failures (Llama-3) but only 7.2% of entangled (Qwen) and 5.2% of distributed (Mistral) failures.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究了大型语言模型在数学推理任务中对语义保持的表面扰动的脆弱性，提出了机械扰动诊断框架来分析失败机制，并建立了失败分类学。
AI.motivation: 尽管大型语言模型在数学推理基准测试中表现出色，但它们对语义保持的表面扰动（如名称替换和数字格式改写）表现出惊人的脆弱性。这种脆弱性暴露了模型推理机制中的深层问题，需要系统性的诊断方法来理解失败的根本原因。
AI.method: 研究采用系统评估方法：1) 在677个GSM8K问题上测试三个开源LLM（Mistral-7B, Llama-3-8B, Qwen2.5-7B）对语义等价变体的敏感性；2) 提出机械扰动诊断（MPD）框架，结合logit lens分析、激活修补、组件消融和级联放大指数（CAI）；3) 基于诊断信号建立机械失败分类学（局部化、分布式、纠缠式）；4) 通过针对性修复实验验证分类学。
AI.result: 所有三个模型都表现出显著的答案翻转率（28.8%-45.1%），数字改写比名称替换更具破坏性。CAI作为失败预测指标优于首次分歧层（两个架构的AUC最高达0.679）。Logit lens显示翻转样本比稳定样本在更早的层出现分歧。激活修补揭示了架构差异：Llama-3的失败可通过特定层修补恢复（43/60样本），而Mistral和Qwen的失败分布广泛（3/60和0/60）。针对性修复实验验证了分类学：局部化失败（Llama-3）恢复率12.2%，纠缠式（Qwen）7.2%，分布式（Mistral）5.2%。
AI.conclusion: 大型语言模型在数学推理中对表面扰动的脆弱性反映了其推理机制的深层差异。提出的机械扰动诊断框架能够有效识别失败模式，建立的失败分类学（局部化、分布式、纠缠式）为理解不同架构的脆弱性提供了理论框架，并为针对性模型改进提供了方向。

title: Does Your Optimizer Care How You Normalize? Normalization-Optimizer Coupling in LLM Training
summary: In LLM training, normalization layers and optimizers are typically treated as independent design choices. In a 3x2 factorial at 1B parameters and 1000 training steps, we show this assumption can fail: Dynamic Erf (Derf; Chen & Liu, 2025) suffers a large negative interaction with Muon (Jordan, 2024), with its gap to RMSNorm growing from +0.31 nats under AdamW to +0.97 under Muon, approximately three times larger. Dynamic Tanh (DyT; Zhu et al., 2025), included as a bounded-normalizer control, shows no such penalty. Our evidence points to two failure modes of erf under Muon's faster spectral-norm growth: saturation (lossy compression) and scale blindness (discarding activation magnitude). An EMA-blend that reintroduces running scale estimates recovers ~84% of the gap. Separately, reducing Derf's alpha from its published default (0.5 to 0.3) recovers ~80% by keeping erf in its near-linear regime, where it approximately preserves relative scale; this setting is not the published default of Chen & Liu (2025). Using Derf's published default alpha with Muon incurs a 0.66-nat interaction penalty without producing NaNs or divergence, making the failure easy to miss in short pilot runs.

AI.tldr: 研究发现LLM训练中归一化层与优化器存在交互效应：Derf归一化与Muon优化器组合时性能显著下降，而DyT归一化则无此问题。问题源于erf函数在Muon快速谱范增长下的饱和与尺度盲区，通过EMA混合或调整alpha参数可部分恢复性能。
AI.motivation: 传统上LLM训练中将归一化层和优化器视为独立设计选择，但本文研究发现这种假设可能不成立，特别是在Derf归一化与Muon优化器组合时存在显著的负交互效应，可能导致性能下降但不易被发现。
AI.method: 采用3x2因子设计实验，在10亿参数和1000训练步的规模下，比较不同归一化层(Derf、RMSNorm、DyT)与优化器(AdamW、Muon)的组合效果。通过分析erf函数在Muon优化器下的行为，识别饱和和尺度盲区两种失效模式，并提出EMA混合和调整alpha参数两种解决方案。
AI.result: Derf与Muon组合时性能差距从AdamW下的+0.31 nats扩大到Muon下的+0.97 nats，增加约三倍。DyT作为有界归一化对照组未显示类似惩罚。EMA混合方法恢复了约84%的性能差距，将Derf的alpha参数从0.5降至0.3恢复了约80%的性能差距。使用Derf默认参数与Muon组合会产生0.66 nats的交互惩罚，但不会产生NaN或发散。
AI.conclusion: 归一化层与优化器选择不是独立的，存在显著的交互效应。Derf与Muon组合存在特定失效模式，但可通过技术调整缓解。研究强调了在LLM训练中需要系统评估不同组件组合的重要性，避免因不易察觉的交互效应导致性能损失。

title: Universal computational thermal imaging overcoming the ghosting effect
summary: Thermal imaging is crucial for night vision but fundamentally hampered by the ghosting effect, a loss of detailed texture in cluttered photon streams. While conventional ghosting mitigation has relied on data post-processing, the recent breakthrough in heat-assisted detection and ranging (HADAR) opens a promising frontier for hyperspectral computational thermal imaging that produces night vision with day-like visibility. However, universal anti-ghosting imaging remains elusive, as state-of-the-art HADAR applies only to limited scenes with uniform materials, whereas material non-uniformity is ubiquitous in the real world. Here, we propose a universal computational thermal imaging framework, TAG (thermal anti-ghosting), to address material non-uniformity and overcome ghosting for high-fidelity night vision. TAG takes hyperspectral photon streams for nonparametric texture recovery, enabling our experimental demonstration of unprecedented expression recovery in thus-far-elusive ghostly human faces -- the archetypal, long-recognized ghosting phenomenon. Strikingly, TAG not only universally outperforms HADAR across various scenes, but also reveals the influence of material non-uniformity, shedding light on HADAR's effectiveness boundary. We extensively test facial texture and expression recovery across day and night, and demonstrate, for the first time, thermal 3D topological alignment and mood detection. This work establishes a universal foundation for high-fidelity computational night vision, with potential applications in autonomous navigation, reconnaissance, healthcare, and wildlife monitoring.

AI.tldr: 提出TAG热成像框架，通过非参数纹理恢复解决材料非均匀性问题，实现高保真夜视成像，首次恢复幽灵人脸表情
AI.motivation: 传统热成像存在鬼影效应，现有HADAR技术仅适用于均匀材料场景，而现实世界中材料非均匀性普遍存在，需要通用解决方案
AI.method: 提出TAG（热反鬼影）计算热成像框架，利用高光谱光子流进行非参数纹理恢复，解决材料非均匀性问题
AI.result: TAG在多种场景中普遍优于HADAR，首次实现幽灵人脸表情恢复，展示热3D拓扑对齐和情绪检测能力
AI.conclusion: TAG建立了高保真计算夜视的通用基础，在自主导航、侦察、医疗保健和野生动物监测等领域具有应用潜力

title: What Do Claim Verification Datasets Actually Test? A Reasoning Trace Analysis
summary: Despite rapid progress in claim verification, we lack a systematic understanding of what reasoning these benchmarks actually exercise. We generate structured reasoning traces for 24K claim-verification examples across 9 datasets using GPT-4o-mini and find that direct evidence extraction dominates, while multi-sentence synthesis and numerical reasoning are severely under-represented. A dataset-level breakdown reveals stark biases: some datasets almost exclusively test lexical matching, while others require information synthesis in roughly half of cases. Using a compact 1B-parameter reasoning verifier, we further characterize five error types and show that error profiles vary dramatically by domain -- general-domain verification is dominated by lexical overlap bias, scientific verification by overcautiousness, and mathematical verification by arithmetic reasoning failures. Our findings suggest that high benchmark scores primarily reflect retrieval-plus-entailment ability. We outline recommendations for building more challenging evaluation suites that better test the reasoning capabilities verification systems need.

AI.tldr: 论文分析了9个声明验证数据集的推理模式，发现现有基准主要测试证据提取能力，而多句合成和数值推理严重不足，高基准分数主要反映检索+蕴含能力而非复杂推理。
AI.motivation: 尽管声明验证领域进展迅速，但缺乏对现有基准实际测试推理能力的系统理解。研究者希望揭示这些数据集真正测试的推理类型，识别偏见，并为构建更具挑战性的评估套件提供建议。
AI.method: 使用GPT-4o-mini为9个数据集的24K个声明验证示例生成结构化推理轨迹，分析推理模式分布。然后使用紧凑的1B参数推理验证器，识别五种错误类型并分析不同领域的错误特征。
AI.result: 发现直接证据提取占主导（约80%），多句合成和数值推理严重不足（各约10%）。数据集层面存在明显偏见：有些数据集几乎只测试词汇匹配，而其他数据集约一半情况需要信息合成。错误分析显示：通用领域验证主要受词汇重叠偏见影响，科学验证由过度谨慎主导，数学验证则因算术推理失败。
AI.conclusion: 当前声明验证基准的高分主要反映检索+蕴含能力，而非复杂推理能力。需要构建更平衡的评估套件，更好地测试验证系统所需的推理能力，特别是多句合成和数值推理方面。

title: NED-Tree: Bridging the Semantic Gap with Nonlinear Element Decomposition Tree for LLM Nonlinear Optimization Modeling
summary: Automating the translation of Operations Research (OR) problems from natural language to executable models is a critical challenge. While Large Language Models (LLMs) have shown promise in linear tasks, they suffer from severe performance degradation in real-world nonlinear scenarios due to semantic misalignment between mathematical formulations and solver codes, as well as unstable information extraction. In this study, we introduce NED-Tree, a systematic framework designed to bridge the semantic gap. NED-Tree employs (a) a sentence-by-sentence extraction strategy to ensure robust parameter mapping and traceability; and (b) a recursive tree-based structure that adaptively decomposes complex nonlinear terms into solver-compatible sub-elements. Additionally, we present NEXTOR, a novel benchmark specifically designed for complex nonlinear, extensive-constraint OR problems. Experiments across 10 benchmarks demonstrate that NED-Tree establishes a new state-of-the-art with 72.51% average accuracy, NED-Tree is the first framework that drives LLMs to resolve nonlinear modeling difficulties through element decomposition, achieving alignment between modeling semantics and code semantics. The NED-Tree framework and benchmark are accessible in the anonymous repository https://anonymous.4open.science/r/NORA-NEXTOR.

AI.tldr: NED-Tree框架通过句子级提取和递归树结构解决LLM在非线性OR问题建模中的语义对齐问题，在10个基准测试中达到72.51%的平均准确率。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在线性任务中表现良好，但在真实世界非线性场景中性能严重下降，主要原因是数学公式与求解器代码之间的语义不对齐，以及信息提取不稳定。
AI.method: NED-Tree框架采用：(a) 逐句提取策略确保稳健的参数映射和可追溯性；(b) 递归树结构自适应地将复杂非线性项分解为求解器兼容的子元素。
AI.result: 在10个基准测试中，NED-Tree实现了72.51%的平均准确率，建立了新的最先进水平。NED-Tree是首个通过元素分解驱动LLM解决非线性建模困难的框架。
AI.conclusion: NED-Tree成功弥合了建模语义与代码语义之间的差距，为自动化OR问题翻译提供了有效解决方案，并提出了专门针对复杂非线性、多约束OR问题的NEXTOR基准。

title: PRCCF: A Persona-guided Retrieval and Causal-aware Cognitive Filtering Framework for Emotional Support Conversation
comment: 14 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Submitted to Transactions of the Association for Computational Linguistics (TACL)
summary: Emotional Support Conversation (ESC) aims to alleviate individual emotional distress by generating empathetic responses. However, existing methods face challenges in effectively supporting deep contextual understanding. To address this issue, we propose PRCCF, a Persona-guided Retrieval and Causality-aware Cognitive Filtering framework. Specifically, the framework incorporates a persona-guided retrieval mechanism that jointly models semantic compatibility and persona alignment to enhance response generation. Furthermore, it employs a causality-aware cognitive filtering module to prioritize causally relevant external knowledge, thereby improving contextual cognitive understanding for emotional reasoning. Extensive experiments on the ESConv dataset demonstrate that PRCCF outperforms state-of-the-art baselines on both automatic metrics and human evaluations. Our code is publicly available at: https://github.com/YancyLyx/PRCCF.

AI.tldr: PRCCF是一个用于情感支持对话的框架，通过人物角色引导的检索和因果感知的认知过滤机制，提升对深层上下文的理解和情感推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有情感支持对话方法在有效支持深层上下文理解方面面临挑战，需要更好的机制来增强情感推理能力。
AI.method: 提出PRCCF框架，包含两个核心模块：1）人物角色引导的检索机制，联合建模语义兼容性和人物角色对齐；2）因果感知的认知过滤模块，优先考虑因果相关的外部知识。
AI.result: 在ESConv数据集上的实验表明，PRCCF在自动评估指标和人工评估上都优于现有最先进的基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PRCCF通过结合人物角色引导的检索和因果感知的认知过滤，有效提升了情感支持对话中的上下文认知理解和情感推理能力。

title: ThinkTwice: Jointly Optimizing Large Language Models for Reasoning and Self-Refinement
summary: We introduce ThinkTwice, a simple two-phase framework that jointly optimizes LLMs to solve reasoning problems and refine the answers, based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). In each pair of training steps, ThinkTwice first optimizes the model on solving reasoning problems, then optimizes it on refining its own solutions to the same problems, using the same binary correctness reward in both phases without correctness signals or critique annotations. Across five mathematical reasoning benchmarks and two model families including Qwen3-4B and Olmo3-7B, ThinkTwice substantially improves both reasoning and refinement performance over competitive online policy optimization baselines. Specifically, on Qwen3-4B, ThinkTwice outperforms GRPO on AIME by 5 percentage points before refinement and by 11.5 points after one self-refinement step, measured by pass@4. Analysis of the training dynamics of ThinkTwice reveals an implicit rectify-then-fortify curriculum: refinement predominantly corrects errors early in training and naturally shifts toward preserving already-correct solutions as the model improves, yielding a more rectified reward signal. Our work establishes joint training of reasoning and self-refinement as a principled and effective methodology for RLVR.

AI.tldr: ThinkTwice是一个两阶段框架，通过GRPO联合优化LLMs解决推理问题和精炼答案，无需正确性信号或批判注释，在数学推理基准上显著提升性能。
AI.motivation: 当前LLMs在推理任务中存在错误，需要改进推理和自精炼能力。现有方法通常需要额外的正确性信号或批判注释，而ThinkTwice旨在通过简单的两阶段框架联合优化推理和精炼，无需额外监督信号。
AI.method: 提出ThinkTwice两阶段框架：1）第一阶段优化模型解决推理问题；2）第二阶段优化模型精炼自己的解决方案。两个阶段使用相同的二元正确性奖励，基于Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)进行训练，无需正确性信号或批判注释。
AI.result: 在五个数学推理基准和两个模型家族（Qwen3-4B和Olmo3-7B）上，ThinkTwice显著优于竞争性在线策略优化基线。在Qwen3-4B上，ThinkTwice在AIME上比GRPO在精炼前提升5个百分点，一次自精炼后提升11.5个百分点（pass@4）。训练动态分析显示隐含的"纠正-强化"课程：早期精炼主要纠正错误，随着模型改进自然转向保持已正确解决方案。
AI.conclusion: ThinkTwice建立了推理和自精炼联合训练作为RLVR的原则性和有效方法，通过简单的两阶段框架实现了显著的性能提升，揭示了训练动态中的隐含课程学习机制。

title: PRISM: Probability Reallocation with In-Span Masking for Knowledge-Sensitive Alignment
summary: Supervised fine-tuning (SFT) with token-level hard labels can amplify overconfident imitation of factually unsupported targets, causing hallucinations that propagate in multi-sentence generation. We study an augmented SFT setting in which training instances include coarse sentence-level factuality risk labels and inter-sentence dependency annotations, providing structured signals about where factual commitments are weakly supported. We propose \textbf{PRISM}, a differentiable risk-gated framework that modifies learning only at fact-critical positions. PRISM augments standard SFT with a lightweight, model-aware probability reallocation objective that penalizes high-confidence predictions on risky target tokens, with its scope controlled by span-level risk weights and model-aware gating. Experiments on hallucination-sensitive factual benchmarks and general evaluations show that PRISM improves factual aggregates across backbones while maintaining a competitive overall capability profile. Ablations further show that the auxiliary signal is most effective when used conservatively, and that knowledge masking and model-aware reallocation play complementary roles in balancing factual correction and capability preservation.

AI.tldr: PRISM框架通过风险门控机制改进监督微调，在事实风险位置调整学习，减少多句子生成中的幻觉问题
AI.motivation: 传统监督微调使用token级硬标签会放大对事实不支持目标的过度自信模仿，导致幻觉在多句子生成中传播
AI.method: 提出PRISM框架，在训练实例中加入句子级事实风险标签和句子间依赖标注，使用风险门控机制在事实关键位置修改学习，通过轻量级模型感知概率重分配目标惩罚高风险token的高置信度预测
AI.result: 在幻觉敏感的事实基准测试和一般评估中，PRISM改善了不同骨干模型的事实聚合能力，同时保持了竞争力的整体能力
AI.conclusion: 辅助信号在保守使用时最有效，知识掩码和模型感知重分配在平衡事实纠正和能力保持方面发挥互补作用

title: Do Large Language Models Mentalize When They Teach?
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures. Workshop paper at ICML 2026
summary: How do LLMs decide what to teach next: by reasoning about a learner's knowledge, or by using simpler rules of thumb? We test this in a controlled task previously used to study human teaching strategies. On each trial, a teacher LLM sees a hypothetical learner's trajectory through a reward-annotated directed graph and must reveal a single edge so the learner would choose a better path if they replanned. We run a range of LLMs as simulated teachers and fit their trial-by-trial choices with the same cognitive models used for humans: a Bayes-Optimal teacher that infers which transitions the learner is missing (inverse planning), weaker Bayesian variants, heuristic baselines (e.g., reward based), and non-mentalizing utility models. In a baseline experiment matched to the stimuli presented to human subjects, most LLMs perform well, show little change in strategy over trials, and their graph-by-graph performance is similar to that of humans. Model comparison (BIC) shows that Bayes-Optimal teaching best explains most models' choices. When given a scaffolding intervention, models follow auxiliary inference- or reward-focused prompts, but these scaffolds do not reliably improve later teaching on heuristic-incongruent test graphs and can sometimes reduce performance. Overall, cognitive model fits provide insight into LLM tutoring policies and show that prompt compliance does not guarantee better teaching decisions.

AI.tldr: 研究测试LLMs如何决定教学内容：是通过推理学习者知识还是使用简单经验法则。在受控教学任务中，大多数LLMs表现良好，其选择最佳由贝叶斯最优教学模型解释，提示干预不一定改善教学决策。
AI.motivation: 探究LLMs的教学决策机制：是像人类一样通过推理学习者的知识状态（心理理论），还是使用简单的启发式规则。这有助于理解LLMs作为教学工具的能力和局限性。
AI.method: 使用先前研究人类教学策略的受控任务：教师LLM观察学习者在奖励标注有向图中的轨迹，必须揭示一条边以改善学习者的路径规划。测试多种LLMs作为模拟教师，用与人类研究相同的认知模型（贝叶斯最优教师、弱贝叶斯变体、启发式基线、非心理化效用模型）拟合其选择。进行基线实验和支架干预实验。
AI.result: 在基线实验中，大多数LLMs表现良好，策略变化小，图间表现与人类相似。模型比较显示贝叶斯最优教学最能解释大多数模型的选择。支架干预中，模型能遵循推理或奖励导向的提示，但这些支架不能可靠改善在启发式不一致测试图上的教学，有时反而降低性能。
AI.conclusion: LLMs的教学决策主要由贝叶斯最优推理驱动，而非简单启发式。认知模型拟合为LLMs的教学策略提供了洞察，表明提示遵从性不能保证更好的教学决策，这对设计LLM教学工具具有重要意义。

title: On the Role of Reasoning Patterns in the Generalization Discrepancy of Long Chain-of-Thought Supervised Fine-Tuning
summary: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on long Chain-of-Thought (CoT) trajectories has become a pivotal phase in building large reasoning models. However, how CoT trajectories from different sources influence the generalization performance of models remains an open question. In this paper, we conduct a comparative study using two sources of verified CoT trajectories generated by two competing models, \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} and \texttt{gpt-oss-120b}, with their problem sets controlled to be identical. Despite their comparable performance, we uncover a striking paradox: lower training loss does not translate to better generalization. SFT on \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} data achieves remarkably lower training loss, yet exhibits significantly worse generalization performance on reasoning benchmarks compared to those trained on \texttt{gpt-oss-120b}. To understand this paradox, we perform a multi-faceted analysis probing token-level SFT loss and step-level reasoning behaviors. Our analysis reveals a difference in reasoning patterns. \texttt{gpt-oss-120b} exhibits highly convergent and deductive trajectories, whereas \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} favors a divergent and branch-heavy exploration pattern. Consequently, models trained with \texttt{DeepSeek-R1} data inherit inefficient exploration behaviors, often getting trapped in redundant exploratory branches that hinder them from reaching correct solutions. Building upon this insight, we propose a simple yet effective remedy of filtering out frequently branching trajectories to improve the generalization of SFT. Experiments show that training on selected \texttt{DeepSeek-R1-0528} subsets surprisingly improves reasoning performance by up to 5.1% on AIME25, 5.5% on BeyondAIME, and on average 3.6% on five benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 研究发现监督微调中思维链轨迹来源影响模型泛化性能的悖论：训练损失更低的DeepSeek-R1数据反而导致更差的泛化能力，原因是其发散式推理模式被模型继承。
AI.motivation: 研究不同来源的思维链轨迹如何影响大语言模型的泛化性能，特别是发现训练损失与泛化能力之间的反常关系，需要深入理解这一悖论背后的机制。
AI.method: 使用DeepSeek-R1-0528和gpt-oss-120b生成的思维链轨迹进行对比研究，控制问题集相同。通过多层面分析包括token级训练损失和步骤级推理行为，并提出了过滤频繁分支轨迹的简单有效方法。
AI.result: DeepSeek-R1数据训练损失更低但泛化性能显著更差。分析发现gpt-oss-120b采用收敛式演绎推理，而DeepSeek-R1偏好发散式探索模式。过滤分支轨迹后，DeepSeek-R1子集的推理性能在AIME25上提升5.1%，BeyondAIME上提升5.5%，五个基准平均提升3.6%。
AI.conclusion: 思维链轨迹的推理模式对模型泛化能力有重要影响，发散式探索模式会降低泛化性能。通过筛选轨迹可以显著改善监督微调的效果，这为构建更好的推理模型提供了重要洞见。

title: ByteRover: Agent-Native Memory Through LLM-Curated Hierarchical Context
summary: Memory-Augmented Generation (MAG) extends large language models with external memory to support long-context reasoning, but existing approaches universally treat memory as an external service that agents call into, delegating storage to separate pipelines of chunking, embedding, and graph extraction. This architectural separation means the system that stores knowledge does not understand it, leading to semantic drift between what the agent intended to remember and what the pipeline actually captured, loss of coordination context across agents, and fragile recovery after failures. In this paper, we propose ByteRover, an agent-native memory architecture that inverts the memory pipeline: the same LLM that reasons about a task also curates, structures, and retrieves knowledge. ByteRover represents knowledge in a hierarchical Context Tree, a file-based knowledge graph organized as Domain, Topic, Subtopic, and Entry, where each entry carries explicit relations, provenance, and an Adaptive Knowledge Lifecycle (AKL) with importance scoring, maturity tiers, and recency decay. Retrieval uses a 5-tier progressive strategy that resolves most queries at sub-100 ms latency without LLM calls, escalating to agentic reasoning only for novel questions. Experiments on LoCoMo and LongMemEval demonstrate that ByteRover achieves state-of-the-art accuracy on LoCoMo and competitive results on LongMemEval while requiring zero external infrastructure, no vector database, no graph database, no embedding service, with all knowledge stored as human-readable markdown files on the local filesystem.

AI.tldr: ByteRover提出了一种基于LLM的本地内存架构，通过上下文树结构存储知识，无需外部基础设施，实现了高效检索和知识管理。
AI.motivation: 现有内存增强生成方法将内存作为外部服务，导致语义漂移、协调上下文丢失和故障恢复脆弱等问题，需要更智能的内存架构。
AI.method: 提出ByteRover架构，让LLM直接管理知识，使用分层上下文树（域、主题、子主题、条目）组织知识，采用自适应知识生命周期和5层渐进检索策略。
AI.result: 在LoCoMo基准上达到最先进准确率，在LongMemEval上表现有竞争力，无需外部基础设施，所有知识以可读markdown文件存储在本地文件系统。
AI.conclusion: ByteRover通过LLM原生内存架构解决了现有方法的语义漂移问题，提供更协调、更可靠的知识管理，同时保持高效检索性能。

title: VideoZeroBench: Probing the Limits of Video MLLMs with Spatio-Temporal Evidence Verification
summary: Recent video multimodal large language models achieve impressive results across various benchmarks. However, current evaluations suffer from two critical limitations: (1) inflated scores can mask deficiencies in fine-grained visual understanding and reasoning, and (2) answer correctness is often measured without verifying whether models identify the precise spatio-temporal evidence supporting their predictions. To address this, we present VideoZeroBench, a hierarchical benchmark designed for challenging long-video question answering that rigorously verifies spatio-temporal evidence. It comprises 500 manually annotated questions across 13 domains, paired with temporal intervals and spatial bounding boxes as evidence. To disentangle answering generation, temporal grounding, and spatial grounding, we introduce a five-level evaluation protocol that progressively tightens evidence requirements. Experiments show that even Gemini-3-Pro correctly answers fewer than 17% of questions under the standard end-to-end QA setting (Level-3). When grounding constraints are imposed, performance drops sharply: No model exceeds 1% accuracy when both correct answering and accurate spatio-temporal localization are required (Level-5), with most failing to achieve any correct grounded predictions. These results expose a significant gap between surface-level answer correctness and genuine evidence-based reasoning, revealing that grounded video understanding remains a bottleneck for long-video QA. We further analyze performance across minimal evidence spans, atomic abilities, and inference paradigms, providing insights for future research in grounded video reasoning. The benchmark and code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: VideoZeroBench：针对长视频问答的层次化基准测试，通过时空证据验证揭示当前视频多模态大语言模型在细粒度视觉理解和推理方面的严重不足。
AI.motivation: 当前视频多模态大语言模型的评估存在两个关键局限：(1) 夸大的分数掩盖了细粒度视觉理解和推理的缺陷；(2) 答案正确性评估通常不验证模型是否识别支持其预测的精确时空证据。
AI.method: 提出VideoZeroBench，包含500个手动标注的问题，涵盖13个领域，配有时间区间和空间边界框作为证据。引入五级评估协议，逐步收紧证据要求，以分离答案生成、时间定位和空间定位能力。
AI.result: 实验显示，即使在标准端到端QA设置下，Gemini-3-Pro的正确回答率也低于17%。当施加定位约束时，性能急剧下降：在同时要求正确答案和精确时空定位时，没有模型超过1%的准确率，大多数模型无法实现任何正确的定位预测。
AI.conclusion: 结果揭示了表面答案正确性与真正基于证据的推理之间的显著差距，表明基于证据的视频理解仍然是长视频QA的瓶颈。基准测试和代码将公开提供，为未来基于证据的视频推理研究提供见解。

title: MM-ReCoder: Advancing Chart-to-Code Generation with Reinforcement Learning and Self-Correction
summary: Multimodal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have recently demonstrated promising capabilities in multimodal coding tasks such as chart-to-code generation. However, existing methods primarily rely on supervised fine-tuning (SFT), which requires the model to learn code patterns through chart-code pairs but does not expose the model to a code execution environment. Moreover, while self-correction through execution feedback offers a potential route to improve coding quality, even state-of-the-art MLLMs have been shown to struggle with effective self-correction. In this work, we introduce MM-ReCoder, a chart-to-code generation model trained with reinforcement learning (RL) and equipped with self-correction ability. We propose a two-stage multi-turn self-correction RL strategy based on Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO). The first stage enhances the model's self-correction ability via rolling out a shared first turn, while the second stage improves the coding capability with full-trajectory optimization. MM-ReCoder learns to produce more accurate and executable code through the interaction with the environment and by iteratively correcting its own outputs. Our results on three chart-to-code benchmarks demonstrate the state-of-the-art performance of MM-ReCoder.

AI.tldr: MM-ReCoder：基于强化学习和自校正能力的图表到代码生成模型，通过两阶段多轮自校正RL策略提升代码生成质量
AI.motivation: 现有MLLMs主要依赖监督微调，缺乏代码执行环境暴露，且自校正能力不足，需要更有效的训练方法来提升图表到代码生成的质量
AI.method: 提出MM-ReCoder模型，采用基于GRPO的两阶段多轮自校正强化学习策略：第一阶段通过共享首轮增强自校正能力，第二阶段通过全轨迹优化提升编码能力
AI.result: 在三个图表到代码基准测试中取得了最先进的性能，能够生成更准确、可执行的代码
AI.conclusion: 通过强化学习和自校正能力的结合，MM-ReCoder显著提升了MLLMs在图表到代码生成任务中的表现，为多模态编码任务提供了新的有效方法

title: Harmonized Tabular-Image Fusion via Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning
summary: Multimodal tabular-image fusion is an emerging task that has received increasing attention in various domains. However, existing methods may be hindered by gradient conflicts between modalities, misleading the optimization of the unimodal learner. In this paper, we propose a novel Gradient-Aligned Alternating Learning (GAAL) paradigm to address this issue by aligning modality gradients. Specifically, GAAL adopts an alternating unimodal learning and shared classifier to decouple the multimodal gradient and facilitate interaction. Furthermore, we design uncertainty-based cross-modal gradient surgery to selectively align cross-modal gradients, thereby steering the shared parameters to benefit all modalities. As a result, GAAL can provide effective unimodal assistance and help boost the overall fusion performance. Empirical experiments on widely used datasets reveal the superiority of our method through comparison with various state-of-the-art (SoTA) tabular-image fusion baselines and test-time tabular missing baselines. The source code is available at https://github.com/njustkmg/ICME26-GAAL.

AI.tldr: 提出梯度对齐交替学习（GAAL）范式，通过模态梯度对齐解决多模态表格-图像融合中的梯度冲突问题
AI.motivation: 现有多模态表格-图像融合方法存在模态间梯度冲突问题，这会误导单模态学习器的优化，影响整体融合性能
AI.method: 采用交替单模态学习和共享分类器来解耦多模态梯度，设计基于不确定性的跨模态梯度手术来选择性对齐跨模态梯度，引导共享参数对所有模态都有利
AI.result: 在广泛使用的数据集上，与多种最先进的表格-图像融合基线和测试时表格缺失基线相比，该方法表现出优越性
AI.conclusion: GAAL范式能够提供有效的单模态辅助，有助于提升整体融合性能，解决了多模态融合中的梯度冲突问题

title: Memory in the LLM Era: Modular Architectures and Strategies in a Unified Framework
summary: Memory emerges as the core module in the large language model (LLM)-based agents for long-horizon complex tasks (e.g., multi-turn dialogue, game playing, scientific discovery), where memory can enable knowledge accumulation, iterative reasoning and self-evolution. A number of memory methods have been proposed in the literature. However, these methods have not been systematically and comprehensively compared under the same experimental settings. In this paper, we first summarize a unified framework that incorporates all the existing agent memory methods from a high-level perspective. We then extensively compare representative agent memory methods on two well-known benchmarks and examine the effectiveness of all methods, providing a thorough analysis of those methods. As a byproduct of our experimental analysis, we also design a new memory method by exploiting modules in the existing methods, which outperforms the state-of-the-art methods. Finally, based on these findings, we offer promising future research opportunities. We believe that a deeper understanding of the behavior of existing methods can provide valuable new insights for future research.

AI.tldr: 本文系统综述了LLM智能体中的记忆方法，提出了统一框架，在标准基准上全面比较现有方法，并设计出超越SOTA的新记忆方法，最后展望未来研究方向。
AI.motivation: 记忆是LLM智能体处理长时程复杂任务（如多轮对话、游戏、科学发现）的核心模块，能够实现知识积累、迭代推理和自我进化。尽管已有多种记忆方法被提出，但缺乏在相同实验设置下的系统全面比较。
AI.method: 1. 从高层视角总结包含所有现有智能体记忆方法的统一框架；2. 在两个知名基准上广泛比较代表性记忆方法；3. 分析所有方法的有效性；4. 基于实验分析，利用现有方法模块设计新的记忆方法。
AI.result: 1. 提出了统一的智能体记忆方法框架；2. 在标准基准上全面评估了现有方法；3. 设计的新记忆方法超越了现有最先进方法；4. 提供了对现有方法行为的深入理解。
AI.conclusion: 对现有记忆方法的深入理解能为未来研究提供宝贵的新见解。基于研究发现，本文提出了有前景的未来研究方向，强调了系统比较和统一框架在推动LLM智能体记忆研究中的重要性。

title: CRaFT: Circuit-Guided Refusal Feature Selection via Cross-Layer Transcoders
summary: As safety concerns around large language models (LLMs) grow, understanding the internal mechanisms underlying refusal behavior has become increasingly important. Recent work has studied this behavior by identifying internal features associated with refusal and manipulating them to induce compliance with harmful requests. However, existing refusal feature selection methods rely on how strongly features activate on harmful prompts, which tends to capture superficial signals rather than the causal factors underlying the refusal decision. We propose CRaFT, a circuit-guided refusal feature selection framework that ranks features by their influence on the model's refusal-compliance decision using prompts near the refusal boundary. On Gemma-3-1B-it, CRaFT improves attack success rate (ASR) from 6.7% to 48.2% and outperforms baseline methods across multiple jailbreak benchmarks. These results suggest that circuit influence is a more reliable criterion than activation magnitude for identifying features that causally mediate refusal behavior.

AI.tldr: CRaFT框架通过基于电路影响力的特征选择方法，显著提升了对大语言模型拒绝行为的攻击成功率，从6.7%提升到48.2%。
AI.motivation: 随着大语言模型安全性问题日益重要，理解拒绝行为的内部机制变得至关重要。现有方法依赖特征在有害提示上的激活强度，这往往捕捉的是表面信号而非拒绝决策的因果因素。
AI.method: 提出CRaFT框架，这是一种电路引导的拒绝特征选择方法，通过使用接近拒绝边界的提示来根据特征对模型拒绝-合规决策的影响力对特征进行排序。
AI.result: 在Gemma-3-1B-it模型上，CRaFT将攻击成功率从6.7%提升到48.2%，并在多个越狱基准测试中优于基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 电路影响力比激活强度更可靠，能够识别因果介导拒绝行为的特征，为理解大语言模型安全机制提供了新方法。

title: Satellite-Free Training for Drone-View Geo-Localization
summary: Drone-view geo-localization (DVGL) aims to determine the location of drones in GPS-denied environments by retrieving the corresponding geotagged satellite tile from a reference gallery given UAV observations of a location. In many existing formulations, these observations are represented by a single oblique UAV image. In contrast, our satellite-free setting is designed for multi-view UAV sequences, which are used to construct a geometry-normalized UAV-side location representation before cross-view retrieval. Existing approaches rely on satellite imagery during training, either through paired supervision or unsupervised alignment, which limits practical deployment when satellite data are unavailable or restricted. In this paper, we propose a satellite-free training (SFT) framework that converts drone imagery into cross-view compatible representations through three main stages: drone-side 3D scene reconstruction, geometry-based pseudo-orthophoto generation, and satellite-free feature aggregation for retrieval. Specifically, we first reconstruct dense 3D scenes from multi-view drone images using 3D Gaussian splatting and project the reconstructed geometry into pseudo-orthophotos via PCA-guided orthographic projection. This rendering stage operates directly on reconstructed scene geometry without requiring camera parameters at rendering time. Next, we refine these orthophotos with lightweight geometry-guided inpainting to obtain texture-complete drone-side views. Finally, we extract DINOv3 patch features from the generated orthophotos, learn a Fisher vector aggregation model solely from drone data, and reuse it at test time to encode satellite tiles for cross-view retrieval. Experimental results on University-1652 and SUES-200 show that our SFT framework substantially outperforms satellite-free generalization baselines and narrows the gap to methods trained with satellite imagery.

AI.tldr: 提出卫星图像自由训练框架，通过无人机多视角序列重建3D场景并生成伪正射影像，实现无卫星数据训练的跨视图地理定位。
AI.motivation: 现有无人机地理定位方法依赖卫星图像进行训练，但在卫星数据不可用或受限的实际部署中存在局限性。需要开发不依赖卫星图像的训练方法。
AI.method: 采用三阶段框架：1) 使用3D高斯泼溅从多视角无人机图像重建密集3D场景；2) 通过PCA引导的正射投影生成几何归一化的伪正射影像；3) 仅使用无人机数据训练Fisher向量聚合模型，用于跨视图检索。
AI.result: 在University-1652和SUES-200数据集上的实验表明，SFT框架显著优于无卫星图像泛化基线方法，并缩小了与使用卫星图像训练方法的性能差距。
AI.conclusion: 提出的卫星图像自由训练框架能够在不依赖卫星图像的情况下实现有效的跨视图地理定位，为实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: From Multi-Agent to Single-Agent: When Is Skill Distillation Beneficial?
summary: Multi-agent systems (MAS) tackle complex tasks by distributing expertise, though this often comes at the cost of heavy coordination overhead, context fragmentation, and brittle phase ordering. Distilling a MAS into a single-agent skill can bypass these costs, but this conversion lacks a principled answer for when and what to distill. Instead, the empirical outcome is surprisingly inconsistent: skill lift ranges from a 28% improvement to a 2% degradation across metrics of the exact same task. In this work, we reveal that skill utility is governed not by the task, but by the evaluation metric. We introduce Metric Freedom ($F$), the first a priori predictor of skill utility. $F$ measures the topological rigidity of a metric's scoring landscape by quantifying how output diversity couples with score variance via a Mantel test. Guided by $F$, we propose a two-stage adaptive distillation framework. Stage 1 acts as a selective extraction mechanism, extracting tools and knowledge while discarding restrictive structures on "free" metrics to preserve exploration. Stage 2 targets computationally intensive iterative refinement exclusively toward "rigid" metrics ($F \lesssim 0.6$) to eliminate trajectory-local overfitting. Evaluating across 4 tasks, 11 datasets, and 6 metrics, $F$ strongly predicts skill utility ($ρ= -0.62$, $p < 0.05$). Strikingly, identical agent trajectories yield diametrically opposite skill lifts under rigid versus free metrics, demonstrating that skill utility is fundamentally a metric-level property. Driven by this signal, our adaptive agent matches or exceeds the original MAS while reducing cost up to 8$\times$ and latency by up to 15$\times$.

AI.tldr: 多智能体系统向单智能体技能蒸馏的效果并非由任务决定，而是由评估指标决定。研究者提出了Metric Freedom（F）作为技能效用的先验预测器，并开发了自适应蒸馏框架，在降低成本的同时提升性能。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统虽然能处理复杂任务，但存在协调开销大、上下文碎片化和脆弱的阶段排序等问题。将多智能体系统蒸馏为单智能体技能可以绕过这些成本，但缺乏关于何时蒸馏、蒸馏什么的原则性指导，导致实验结果不一致。
AI.method: 提出了Metric Freedom（F）作为技能效用的先验预测器，通过Mantel测试量化输出多样性与得分方差之间的耦合程度，测量评估指标评分地形的拓扑刚性。基于F提出了两阶段自适应蒸馏框架：第一阶段作为选择性提取机制，在"自由"指标上提取工具和知识同时丢弃限制性结构；第二阶段专门针对"刚性"指标（F≲0.6）进行计算密集的迭代优化。
AI.result: 在4个任务、11个数据集和6个指标上的评估显示，F能强烈预测技能效用（ρ=-0.62，p<0.05）。相同的智能体轨迹在刚性指标与自由指标下产生完全相反的技能提升效果。自适应智能体匹配或超越了原始多智能体系统，同时将成本降低高达8倍，延迟降低高达15倍。
AI.conclusion: 技能效用本质上是评估指标层面的属性，而非任务层面的属性。Metric Freedom（F）作为先验预测器能有效指导自适应蒸馏，在保持或提升性能的同时显著降低多智能体系统的协调成本和延迟。

title: SHOE: Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation Metric
comment: Accepted to GRAIL-V Workshop at CVPR 2026
summary: Open-vocabulary human-object interaction (HOI) detection is a step towards building scalable systems that generalize to unseen interactions in real-world scenarios and support grounded multimodal systems that reason about human-object relationships. However, standard evaluation metrics, such as mean Average Precision (mAP), treat HOI classes as discrete categorical labels and fail to credit semantically valid but lexically different predictions (e.g., "lean on couch" vs. "sit on couch"), limiting their applicability for evaluating open-vocabulary predictions that go beyond any predefined set of HOI labels. We introduce SHOE (Semantic HOI Open-Vocabulary Evaluation), a new evaluation framework that incorporates semantic similarity between predicted and ground-truth HOI labels. SHOE decomposes each HOI prediction into its verb and object components, estimates their semantic similarity using the average of multiple large language models (LLMs), and combines them into a similarity score to evaluate alignment beyond exact string match. This enables a flexible and scalable evaluation of both existing HOI detection methods and open-ended generative models using standard benchmarks such as HICO-DET. Experimental results show that SHOE scores align more closely with human judgments than existing metrics, including LLM-based and embedding-based baselines, achieving an agreement of 85.73% with the average human ratings. Our work underscores the need for semantically grounded HOI evaluation that better mirrors human understanding of interactions. We will release our evaluation metric to the public to facilitate future research.

AI.tldr: SHOE是一个新的开放词汇人-物交互检测评估框架，它使用语义相似度而非精确字符串匹配来评估预测结果，能更好地反映人类对交互的理解。
AI.motivation: 传统的mAP等评估指标将HOI类别视为离散分类标签，无法识别语义有效但词汇不同的预测（如"靠在沙发上"vs"坐在沙发上"），限制了开放词汇预测的评估能力。
AI.method: SHOE将每个HOI预测分解为动词和对象组件，使用多个大型语言模型计算它们的语义相似度，然后组合成相似度分数，从而在标准基准（如HICO-DET）上实现灵活可扩展的评估。
AI.result: 实验结果显示，SHOE分数比现有指标（包括基于LLM和嵌入的基线）更接近人类判断，与平均人类评分的吻合度达到85.73%。
AI.conclusion: 这项工作强调了需要基于语义的HOI评估，以更好地反映人类对交互的理解。作者将公开评估指标以促进未来研究。

title: GraphWalk: Enabling Reasoning in Large Language Models through Tool-Based Graph Navigation
summary: The use of knowledge graphs for grounding agents in real-world Q&A applications has become increasingly common. Answering complex queries often requires multi-hop reasoning and the ability to navigate vast relational structures. Standard approaches rely on prompting techniques that steer large language models to reason over raw graph context, or retrieval-augmented generation pipelines where relevant subgraphs are injected into the context. These, however, face severe limitations with enterprise-scale KGs that cannot fit in even the largest context windows available today. We present GraphWalk, a problem-agnostic, training-free, tool-based framework that allows off-the-shelf LLMs to reason through sequential graph navigation, dramatically increasing performance across different tasks. Unlike task-specific agent frameworks that encode domain knowledge into specialized tools, GraphWalk equips the LLM with a minimal set of orthogonal graph operations sufficient to traverse any graph structure. We evaluate whether models equipped with GraphWalk can compose these operations into correct multi-step reasoning chains, where each tool call represents a verifiable step creating a transparent execution trace. We first demonstrate our approach on maze traversal, a problem non-reasoning models are completely unable to solve, then present results on graphs resembling real-world enterprise knowledge graphs. To isolate structural reasoning from world knowledge, we evaluate on entirely synthetic graphs with random, non-semantic labels. Our benchmark spans 12 query templates from basic retrieval to compound first-order logic queries. Results show that tool-based traversal yields substantial and consistent gains over in-context baselines across all model families tested, with gains becoming more pronounced as scale increases, precisely where in-context approaches fail catastrophically.

AI.tldr: GraphWalk是一个无需训练、基于工具的框架，让现成LLM能够通过顺序图导航进行推理，显著提升在大型知识图谱上的复杂查询性能。
AI.motivation: 企业级知识图谱规模庞大，无法放入现有最大上下文窗口，传统基于提示或检索增强的方法在处理复杂多跳推理查询时面临严重限制。
AI.method: 提供最小正交图操作工具集，让LLM通过顺序图导航进行推理，每个工具调用代表可验证步骤，创建透明执行轨迹。
AI.result: 在合成图上测试12种查询模板，基于工具的遍历方法相比上下文基线在所有模型家族中都取得显著一致提升，且随着规模增大优势更明显。
AI.conclusion: GraphWalk框架使LLM能够通过图导航解决复杂推理任务，在大型知识图谱上提供透明、可验证的推理链，克服了上下文窗口限制。

title: LiveMathematicianBench: A Live Benchmark for Mathematician-Level Reasoning with Proof Sketches
summary: Mathematical reasoning is a hallmark of human intelligence, and whether large language models (LLMs) can meaningfully perform it remains a central question in artificial intelligence and cognitive science. As LLMs are increasingly integrated into scientific workflows, rigorous evaluation of their mathematical capabilities becomes a practical necessity. Existing benchmarks are limited by synthetic settings and data contamination. We present LiveMathematicianBench, a dynamic multiple-choice benchmark for research-level mathematical reasoning built from recent arXiv papers published after model training cutoffs. By grounding evaluation in newly published theorems, it provides a realistic testbed beyond memorized patterns. The benchmark introduces a thirteen-category logical taxonomy of theorem types (e.g., implication, equivalence, existence, uniqueness), enabling fine-grained evaluation across reasoning forms. It employs a proof-sketch-guided distractor pipeline that uses high-level proof strategies to construct plausible but invalid answer choices reflecting misleading proof directions, increasing sensitivity to genuine understanding over surface-level matching. We also introduce a substitution-resistant mechanism to distinguish answer recognition from substantive reasoning. Evaluation shows the benchmark is far from saturated: Gemini-3.1-pro-preview, the best model, achieves only 43.5%. Under substitution-resistant evaluation, accuracy drops sharply: GPT-5.4 scores highest at 30.6%, while Gemini-3.1-pro-preview falls to 17.6%, below the 20% random baseline. A dual-mode protocol reveals that proof-sketch access yields consistent accuracy gains, suggesting models can leverage high-level proof strategies for reasoning. Overall, LiveMathematicianBench offers a scalable, contamination-resistant testbed for studying research-level mathematical reasoning in LLMs.

AI.tldr: LiveMathematicianBench是一个基于最新arXiv论文的动态数学推理基准测试，通过13类逻辑分类和证明草图引导的干扰项设计，评估LLMs的研究级数学能力，结果显示当前最佳模型准确率仅43.5%，在抗替换评估中表现更差。
AI.motivation: 现有数学推理基准测试存在合成设置和数据污染问题，无法真实评估LLMs的研究级数学能力。随着LLMs越来越多地融入科学工作流程，需要建立更严谨、现实的评估体系。
AI.method: 基于模型训练截止日期后发布的arXiv论文构建动态选择题基准；引入13类逻辑分类体系；采用证明草图引导的干扰项生成管道，利用高层次证明策略构建似是而非的错误选项；设计抗替换机制区分答案识别与实质推理。
AI.result: 基准测试远未饱和：最佳模型Gemini-3.1-pro-preview准确率仅43.5%；在抗替换评估中，GPT-5.4最高30.6%，Gemini-3.1-pro-preview降至17.6%（低于20%随机基线）；证明草图访问能带来一致的准确率提升。
AI.conclusion: LiveMathematicianBench提供了一个可扩展、抗污染的研究级数学推理测试平台，揭示了当前LLMs在真实数学推理方面的局限性，但证明草图访问表明模型能够利用高层次证明策略进行推理。

title: Analysis of LLM Performance on AWS Bedrock: Receipt-item Categorisation Case Study
comment: Preprint. Accepted to the 19th International Conference on Evaluation of Novel Approaches to Software Engineering (ENASE 2026). Final version to be published by SCITEPRESS, http://www.scitepress.org
summary: This paper presents a systematic, cost-aware evaluation of large language models (LLMs) for receipt-item categorisation within a production-oriented classification framework. We compare four instruction-tuned models available through AWS Bedrock: Claude 3.7 Sonnet, Claude 4 Sonnet, Mixtral 8x7B Instruct, and Mistral 7B Instruct. The aim of the study was (1) to assess performance across accuracy, response stability, and token-level cost, and (2) to investigate what prompting methods, zero-shot or few-shot, are especially appropriate both in terms of accuracy and in terms of incurred costs. Results of our experiments demonstrated that Claude 3.7 Sonnet achieves the most favourable balance between classification accuracy and cost efficiency.

AI.tldr: 系统评估AWS Bedrock上四种指令调优LLM在收据项目分类中的性能与成本，发现Claude 3.7 Sonnet在准确性和成本效率方面表现最佳
AI.motivation: 在面向生产的分类框架中，系统评估大型语言模型在收据项目分类任务上的表现，特别关注性能（准确性、响应稳定性）与成本（token级别成本）之间的平衡，并研究零样本和少样本提示方法在准确性和成本方面的适用性
AI.method: 使用AWS Bedrock平台上的四种指令调优模型（Claude 3.7 Sonnet、Claude 4 Sonnet、Mixtral 8x7B Instruct、Mistral 7B Instruct），在收据项目分类任务上进行比较评估，考察零样本和少样本提示方法，从准确性、响应稳定性和token级成本三个维度进行系统分析
AI.result: 实验结果表明，Claude 3.7 Sonnet在分类准确性和成本效率之间取得了最有利的平衡，为收据项目分类任务提供了最佳的性能-成本比
AI.conclusion: 在面向生产的收据项目分类应用中，Claude 3.7 Sonnet是最佳选择，能够提供良好的分类准确性同时保持成本效率，为零样本和少样本提示方法在实际应用中的选择提供了实证依据

title: Taming CATS: Controllable Automatic Text Simplification through Instruction Fine-Tuning with Control Tokens
summary: Controllable Automatic Text Simplification (CATS) produces user-tailored outputs, yet controllability is often treated as a decoding problem and evaluated with metrics that are not reflective to the measure of control. We observe that controllability in ATS is significantly constrained by data and evaluation. To this end, we introduce a domain-agnostic CATS framework based on instruction fine-tuning with discrete control tokens, steering open-source models to target readability levels and compression rates. Across three model families with different model sizes (Llama, Mistral, Qwen; 1-14B) and four domains (medicine, public administration, news, encyclopedic text), we find that smaller models (1-3B) can be competitive, but reliable controllability strongly depends on whether the training data encodes sufficient variation in the target attribute. Readability control (FKGL, ARI, Dale-Chall) is learned consistently, whereas compression control underperforms due to limited signal variability in the existing corpora. We further show that standard simplification and similarity metrics are insufficient for measuring control, motivating error-based measures for target-output alignment. Finally, our sampling and stratification experiments demonstrate that naive splits can introduce distributional mismatch that undermines both training and evaluation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于指令微调和离散控制标记的领域无关可控自动文本简化框架，发现小模型在特定条件下可达到竞争性表现，但可靠可控性取决于训练数据中目标属性的变化程度，并指出现有评估指标不足以衡量控制效果。
AI.motivation: 当前可控自动文本简化(CATS)通常将可控性视为解码问题，并使用不能有效衡量控制效果的指标进行评估。研究发现CATS的可控性受到数据和评估方法的显著限制。
AI.method: 提出基于指令微调和离散控制标记的领域无关CATS框架，使用三个模型家族(Llama、Mistral、Qwen，1-14B参数)在四个领域(医学、公共管理、新闻、百科文本)进行实验，通过控制标记引导模型达到目标可读性水平和压缩率。
AI.result: 小模型(1-3B)在特定条件下可达到竞争性表现，但可靠可控性取决于训练数据是否编码足够的目标属性变化。可读性控制(FKGL、ARI、Dale-Chall)学习一致，而压缩控制因现有语料库中信号变化有限而表现不佳。标准简化和相似性指标不足以衡量控制效果。
AI.conclusion: 需要基于误差的度量来衡量目标-输出对齐，朴素的数据分割可能引入分布不匹配，从而破坏训练和评估效果。训练数据的属性变化程度是影响可控性的关键因素。

title: OSCAR: Orchestrated Self-verification and Cross-path Refinement
summary: Diffusion language models (DLMs) expose their denoising trajectories, offering a natural handle for inference-time control; accordingly, an ideal hallucination mitigation framework should intervene during generation using this model-native signal rather than relying on an externally trained hallucination classifier. Toward this, we formulate commitment uncertainty localization: given a denoising trajectory, identify token positions whose cross-chain entropy exceeds an unsupervised threshold before factually unreliable commitments propagate into self-consistent but incorrect outputs. We introduce a suite of trajectory-level assessments, including a cross-chain divergence-at-hallucination (CDH) metric, for principled comparison of localization methods. We also introduce OSCAR, a training-free inference-time framework operationalizing this formulation. OSCAR runs N parallel denoising chains with randomized reveal orders, computes cross-chain Shannon entropy to detect high-uncertainty positions, and then performs targeted remasking conditioned on retrieved evidence. Ablations confirm that localization and correction contribute complementary gains, robust across N in {4, 8, 16}. On TriviaQA, HotpotQA, RAGTruth, and CommonsenseQA using LLaDA-8B and Dream-7B, OSCAR enhances generation quality by significantly reducing hallucinated content and improving factual accuracy through uncertainty-guided remasking, which also facilitates more effective integration of retrieved evidence. Its native entropy-based uncertainty signal surpasses that of specialized trained detectors, highlighting an inherent capacity of diffusion language models to identify factual uncertainty that is not present in the sequential token commitment structure of autoregressive models. We are releasing the codebase1 to support future research on localization and uncertainty-aware generation in DLMs.

AI.tldr: OSCAR是一个无需训练的推理时框架，利用扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹，通过并行链的交叉熵检测不确定性位置，然后进行针对性重掩码以减少幻觉内容。
AI.motivation: 扩散语言模型暴露其去噪轨迹，为推理时控制提供了天然机制。理想的幻觉缓解框架应利用这种模型原生信号进行干预，而非依赖外部训练的幻觉分类器。
AI.method: 提出承诺不确定性定位：给定去噪轨迹，识别交叉链熵超过无监督阈值的token位置。引入OSCAR框架：运行N个并行去噪链（随机揭示顺序），计算交叉链香农熵检测高不确定性位置，然后基于检索证据进行针对性重掩码。
AI.result: 在TriviaQA、HotpotQA、RAGTruth和CommonsenseQA上使用LLaDA-8B和Dream-7B，OSCAR显著减少幻觉内容并提高事实准确性。其基于熵的不确定性信号优于专门训练的检测器，展示了扩散语言模型识别事实不确定性的内在能力。
AI.conclusion: OSCAR通过利用扩散语言模型的去噪轨迹进行不确定性定位和针对性干预，有效缓解幻觉问题。该方法超越了自回归模型的token承诺结构限制，为扩散语言模型的定位和不确定性感知生成研究提供了新方向。

title: Towards Minimal Focal Stack in Shape from Focus
summary: Shape from Focus (SFF) is a depth reconstruction technique that estimates scene structure from focus variations observed across a focal stack, that is, a sequence of images captured at different focus settings. A key limitation of SFF methods is their reliance on densely sampled, large focal stacks, which limits their practical applicability. In this study, we propose a focal stack augmentation that enables SFF methods to estimate depth using a reduced stack of just two images, without sacrificing precision. We introduce a simple yet effective physics-based focal stack augmentation that enriches the stack with two auxiliary cues: an all-in-focus (AiF) image estimated from two input images, and Energy-of-Difference (EOD) maps, computed as the energy of differences between the AiF and input images. Furthermore, we propose a deep network that computes a deep focus volume from the augmented focal stacks and iteratively refines depth using convolutional Gated Recurrent Units (ConvGRUs) at multiple scales. Extensive experiments on both synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that the proposed augmentation benefits existing state-of-the-art SFF models, enabling them to achieve comparable accuracy. The results also show that our approach maintains state-of-the-art performance with a minimal stack size.

AI.tldr: 提出一种基于物理的焦点堆栈增强方法，使形状聚焦技术仅需两幅图像即可估计深度，同时保持精度。通过生成全聚焦图像和能量差图来丰富堆栈信息，并结合多尺度ConvGRU网络进行深度细化。
AI.motivation: 传统形状聚焦技术需要密集采样的焦点堆栈，这限制了其实际应用。本研究旨在解决这一限制，使SFF方法能够使用更少的图像（仅两幅）进行深度估计，同时不牺牲精度。
AI.method: 1) 提出基于物理的焦点堆栈增强：从两幅输入图像估计全聚焦图像，并计算全聚焦图像与输入图像之间的能量差图作为辅助线索；2) 设计深度网络：从增强的焦点堆栈计算深度聚焦体积，并使用多尺度卷积门控循环单元迭代细化深度估计。
AI.result: 在合成和真实世界数据集上的广泛实验表明：1) 所提出的增强方法使现有最先进的SFF模型能够实现可比较的精度；2) 该方法在最小堆栈大小下仍能保持最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过焦点堆栈增强和深度网络设计，成功实现了仅使用两幅图像的形状聚焦深度估计，显著提高了SFF技术的实用性和应用范围，同时保持了高精度性能。

title: DEFT: Distribution-guided Efficient Fine-Tuning for Human Alignment
summary: Reinforcement Learning from Human Feedback (RLHF), using algorithms like Proximal Policy Optimization (PPO), aligns Large Language Models (LLMs) with human values but is costly and unstable. Alternatives have been proposed to replace PPO or integrate Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) and contrastive learning for direct fine-tuning and value alignment. However, these methods still require voluminous data to learn preferences and may weaken the generalization ability of LLMs. To further enhance alignment efficiency and performance while mitigating the loss of generalization ability, this paper introduces Distribution-guided Efficient Fine-Tuning (DEFT), an efficient alignment framework incorporating data filtering and distributional guidance by calculating the differential distribution reward based on the output distribution of language model and the discrepancy distribution of preference data. A small yet high-quality subset is filtered from the raw data using a differential distribution reward, which is then incorporated into existing alignment methods to guide the model's output distribution. Experimental results demonstrate that the methods enhanced by DEFT outperform the original methods in both alignment capability and generalization ability, with significantly reduced training time.

AI.tldr: DEFT框架通过数据筛选和分布引导，提升LLM对齐效率和性能，同时保持泛化能力
AI.motivation: RLHF方法成本高且不稳定，现有替代方法需要大量数据且可能削弱LLM泛化能力，需要更高效的对齐方法
AI.method: 提出DEFT框架：1）基于语言模型输出分布和偏好数据差异分布计算差异分布奖励；2）使用该奖励从原始数据中筛选高质量子集；3）将筛选数据融入现有对齐方法，引导模型输出分布
AI.result: DEFT增强的方法在对齐能力和泛化能力上均优于原始方法，且训练时间显著减少
AI.conclusion: DEFT通过数据筛选和分布引导，有效提升对齐效率与性能，同时保持模型泛化能力

title: Exploring Robust Multi-Agent Workflows for Environmental Data Management
summary: Embedding LLM-driven agents into environmental FAIR data management is compelling - they can externalize operational knowledge and scale curation across heterogeneous data and evolving conventions. However, replacing deterministic components with probabilistic workflows changes the failure mode: LLM pipelines may generate plausible but incorrect outputs that pass superficial checks and propagate into irreversible actions such as DOI minting and public release. We introduce EnviSmart, a production data management system deployed on campus-wide storage infrastructure for environmental research. EnviSmart treats reliability as an architectural property through two mechanisms: a three-track knowledge architecture that externalizes behaviors (governance constraints), domain knowledge (retrievable context), and skills (tool-using procedures) as persistent, interlocking artifacts; and a role-separated multi-agent design where deterministic validators and audited handoffs restore fail-stop semantics at trust boundaries before irreversible steps. We compare two production deployments. The University's GIS Center Ecological Archive (849 curated datasets) serves as a single-agent baseline. SF2Bench, a compound flooding benchmark comprising 2,452 monitoring stations and 8,557 published files spanning 39 years, validates the multi-agent workflow. The multi-agent approach improved both efficiency - completed by a single operator in two days with repeated artifact reuse across deployments - and reliability: audited handoffs detected and blocked a coordinate transformation error affecting all 2,452 stations before publication. A representative incident (ISS-004) demonstrated boundary-based containment with 10-minute detection latency, zero user exposure, and 80-minute resolution. This paper has been accepted at PEARC 2026.

AI.tldr: EnviSmart是一个用于环境数据管理的生产系统，通过三轨知识架构和角色分离的多智能体设计，在LLM驱动的数据管理流程中确保可靠性，防止错误传播到不可逆操作。
AI.motivation: 将LLM驱动的智能体嵌入环境FAIR数据管理很有吸引力，因为它们可以外部化操作知识并在异构数据和不断发展的规范中扩展数据整理。但用概率性工作流替换确定性组件改变了故障模式：LLM管道可能生成看似合理但错误的输出，这些输出通过表面检查并传播到不可逆操作（如DOI分配和公开发布）。
AI.method: EnviSmart通过两种机制将可靠性作为架构属性：1）三轨知识架构，将行为（治理约束）、领域知识（可检索上下文）和技能（工具使用程序）外部化为持久、互锁的工件；2）角色分离的多智能体设计，其中确定性验证器和审计交接在不可逆步骤前的信任边界恢复故障停止语义。
AI.result: 在两个生产部署中验证：大学GIS中心生态档案（849个整理数据集）作为单智能体基线；SF2Bench复合洪水基准（2,452个监测站和8,557个已发布文件，跨越39年）验证多智能体工作流。多智能体方法提高了效率（单个操作员在两天内完成，工件在部署间重复使用）和可靠性：审计交接检测并阻止了影响所有2,452个站的坐标转换错误。代表性事件（ISS-004）展示了基于边界的遏制，检测延迟10分钟，零用户暴露，80分钟解决。
AI.conclusion: EnviSmart通过架构方法在LLM驱动的环境数据管理中实现了可靠性，将概率性智能体与确定性验证相结合，防止错误传播到不可逆操作，同时保持效率。该论文已被PEARC 2026接受。

title: PLOT: Enhancing Preference Learning via Optimal Transport
summary: Preference learning in Large Language Models (LLMs) has advanced significantly, yet existing methods remain limited by modest performance gains, high computational costs, hyperparameter sensitivity, and insufficient modeling of global token-level relationships. We introduce PLOT, which enhances Preference Learning in fine-tuning-based alignment through a token-level loss derived from Optimal Transport. By formulating preference learning as an Optimal Transport Problem, PLOT aligns model outputs with human preferences while preserving the original distribution of LLMs, ensuring stability and robustness. Furthermore, PLOT leverages token embeddings to capture semantic relationships, enabling globally informed optimization. Experiments across two preference categories - Human Values and Logic & Problem Solving - spanning seven subpreferences demonstrate that PLOT consistently improves alignment performance while maintaining fluency and coherence. These results substantiate optimal transport as a principled methodology for preference learning, establishing a theoretically grounded framework that provides new insights for preference learning of LLMs.

AI.tldr: PLOT是一种基于最优传输的token级损失函数，用于增强LLM偏好学习，通过建模全局token关系提升对齐性能，同时保持模型稳定性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM偏好学习方法存在性能提升有限、计算成本高、超参数敏感以及缺乏全局token关系建模等问题，需要更有效、稳定且理论扎实的方法。
AI.method: PLOT将偏好学习建模为最优传输问题，通过token级损失函数对齐模型输出与人类偏好，同时保持LLM原始分布，利用token嵌入捕捉语义关系进行全局优化。
AI.result: 在人类价值观和逻辑问题解决两大类共七个子偏好上的实验表明，PLOT能持续提升对齐性能，同时保持文本的流畅性和连贯性。
AI.conclusion: 最优传输为LLM偏好学习提供了理论扎实的框架，PLOT证明了该方法在提升对齐性能方面的有效性，为LLM偏好学习提供了新的理论洞见。

title: ThinknCheck: Grounded Claim Verification with Compact, Reasoning-Driven, and Interpretable Models
summary: We present ThinknCheck, a 1B-parameter verifier for grounded claim verification that first produces a short, structured rationale and then a binary verdict. We construct LLMAggreFact-Think, a 24.1k reasoning-augmented training set derived from LLMAggreFact, and fine-tune a 4-bit Gemma3 model to follow this format. On LLMAggreFact, ThinknCheck attains 78.1 balanced accuracy (BAcc), surpassing MiniCheck-7B (77.4) with 7x fewer parameters; removing the reasoning step reduces BAcc to 57.5. On SciFact, ThinknCheck reaches 64.7 BAcc, a +14.7 absolute gain over MiniCheck-7B. By contrast, zero-shot chain-of-thought on the base Gemma3-1B harms accuracy relative to direct answers, and preference optimization with a simple format+accuracy reward underperforms supervised reasoning. To probe the latter, we introduce GSMClaims and a domain-specialized variant, ThinknCheck-Science, which improves across benchmarks, including 61.0\% accuracy on GSMClaims. Overall, explicit, supervised reasoning enables compact verifiers that are competitive while remaining resource-efficient and interpretable.

AI.tldr: ThinknCheck是一个10亿参数的验证器，通过结构化推理步骤进行事实核查，在多个基准测试中超越更大模型，同时保持资源高效和可解释性。
AI.motivation: 开发一个紧凑、资源高效且可解释的事实核查模型，通过显式的结构化推理步骤来提高准确性，同时减少参数数量。
AI.method: 1. 构建LLMAggreFact-Think训练集（24.1k个推理增强样本）；2. 对4位量化的Gemma3模型进行微调，使其首先生成结构化推理，然后输出二元判断；3. 引入GSMClaims数据集和领域专用变体ThinknCheck-Science。
AI.result: 1. 在LLMAggreFact上达到78.1%平衡准确率，超越MiniCheck-7B（77.4%），参数减少7倍；2. 去除推理步骤后准确率降至57.5%；3. 在SciFact上达到64.7%平衡准确率，比MiniCheck-7B提升14.7%；4. ThinknCheck-Science在GSMClaims上达到61.0%准确率。
AI.conclusion: 显式的监督推理能够实现紧凑的验证器，在保持竞争力的同时保持资源高效和可解释性，结构化推理步骤对准确性至关重要。

title: From Guessing to Placeholding: A Cost-Theoretic Framework for Uncertainty-Aware Code Completion
summary: While Large Language Models (LLMs) have demonstrated exceptional proficiency in code completion, they typically adhere to a Hard Completion (HC) paradigm, compelling the generation of fully concrete code even amidst insufficient context. Our analysis of 3 million real-world interactions exposes the limitations of this strategy: 61% of the generated suggestions were either edited after acceptance or rejected despite exhibiting over 80% similarity to the user's subsequent code, suggesting that models frequently make erroneous predictions at specific token positions. Motivated by this observation, we propose Adaptive Placeholder Completion (APC), a collaborative framework that extends HC by strategically outputting explicit placeholders at high-entropy positions, allowing users to fill directly via IDE navigation. Theoretically, we formulate code completion as a cost-minimization problem under uncertainty. Premised on the observation that filling placeholders incurs lower cost than correcting errors, we prove the existence of a critical entropy threshold above which APC achieves strictly lower expected cost than HC. We instantiate this framework by constructing training data from filtered real-world edit logs and design a cost-based reward function for reinforcement learning. Extensive evaluations across 1.5B--14B parameter models demonstrate that APC reduces expected editing costs from 19% to 50% while preserving standard HC performance. Our work provides both a theoretical foundation and a practical training framework for uncertainty-aware code completion, demonstrating that adaptive abstention can be learned end-to-end without sacrificing conventional completion quality.

AI.tldr: 论文提出自适应占位符补全(APC)框架，通过在高熵位置输出显式占位符来替代传统硬补全，降低代码补全的预期编辑成本
AI.motivation: 传统LLM代码补全采用硬补全范式，即使在上下文不足时也强制生成完全具体的代码。分析300万次真实交互发现，61%的建议被编辑或拒绝，尽管与用户后续代码有80%以上相似度，表明模型在特定token位置经常做出错误预测
AI.method: 提出自适应占位符补全(APC)框架，将代码补全形式化为不确定性下的成本最小化问题。基于"填充占位符比纠正错误成本更低"的观察，证明存在临界熵阈值，高于该阈值时APC的预期成本严格低于硬补全。通过从真实编辑日志构建训练数据，设计基于成本的奖励函数进行强化学习
AI.result: 在1.5B-14B参数模型上的广泛评估表明，APC将预期编辑成本从19%降低到50%，同时保持标准硬补全性能
AI.conclusion: 该工作为不确定性感知的代码补全提供了理论基础和实用训练框架，证明自适应弃权可以通过端到端学习实现，而不牺牲传统补全质量

title: CORAL: Towards Autonomous Multi-Agent Evolution for Open-Ended Discovery
summary: Large language model (LLM)-based evolution is a promising approach for open-ended discovery, where progress requires sustained search and knowledge accumulation.
