Proprietary models consistently outperform open-weight systems, and in-language (Gaelic) prompting yields a small but stable advantage (+$2.4\%$). On the cultural task, leading models exceed $90\%$ accuracy, though most systems perform worse under Gaelic prompting and absolute scores are inflated relative to the manual benchmark. Overall, GaelEval reveals that frontier models achieve above-human performance on several dimensions of Gaelic grammar, demonstrates the effect of Gaelic prompting and shows a consistent performance gap favouring proprietary over open-weight models.

AI.tldr: 本文介绍了GaelEval——首个针对苏格兰盖尔语的多维度基准测试，包含形态句法MCQA、文化翻译和文化知识问答三个任务。评估19个LLM后发现，Gemini 3 Pro Preview在语言任务上超越人类基线，专有模型优于开源模型，盖尔语提示能带来小幅稳定提升。
AI.motivation: 多语言大语言模型在未受官方支持的语言中常表现出"影子"能力，但这些语言的性能评估不足且不均衡。对于苏格兰盖尔语这种形态句法丰富的少数民族语言尤其如此，现有翻译基准无法捕捉其结构能力。
AI.method: 开发GaelEval基准测试，包含三个部分：1)专家编写的形态句法多项选择题任务；2)文化背景翻译基准；3)大规模文化知识问答任务。评估19个LLM，与30名流利说话者的人类基线对比，分析专有模型与开源模型的差异，以及盖尔语提示的效果。
AI.result: Gemini 3 Pro Preview在语言任务上达到83.3%准确率，超越人类基线(78.1%)。专有模型持续优于开源系统，盖尔语提示带来+2.4%的稳定优势。在文化任务上，领先模型超过90%准确率，但大多数系统在盖尔语提示下表现更差，且绝对分数相对于人工基准有所夸大。
AI.conclusion: GaelEval显示前沿模型在盖尔语语法的多个维度上达到超人类性能，证明了盖尔语提示的效果，并揭示了专有模型相对于开源模型的持续性能优势。这为少数民族语言的LLM评估提供了重要基准。

title: BraiNCA: brain-inspired neural cellular automata and applications to morphogenesis and motor control
summary: Most of the Neural Cellular Automata (NCAs) defined in the literature have a common theme: they are based on regular grids with a Moore neighborhood (one-hop neighbour). They do not take into account long-range connections and more complex topologies as we can find in the brain. In this paper, we introduce BraiNCA, a brain-inspired NCA with an attention layer, long-range connections and complex topology. BraiNCAs shows better results in terms of robustness and speed of learning on the two tasks compared to Vanilla NCAs establishing that incorporating attention-based message selection together with explicit long-range edges can yield more sample-efficient and damage-tolerant self-organization than purely local, grid-based update rules. These results support the hypothesis that, for tasks requiring distributed coordination over extended spatial and temporal scales, the choice of interaction topology and the ability to dynamically route information will impact the robustness and speed of learning of an NCA. More broadly, BraiNCA provides brain-inspired NCA formulation that preserves the decentralized local update principle while better reflecting non-local connectivity patterns, making it a promising substrate for studying collective computation under biologically-realistic network structure and evolving cognitive substrates.

AI.tldr: BraiNCA是一种受大脑启发的神经细胞自动机，通过引入注意力层、长程连接和复杂拓扑结构，相比传统基于规则网格的NCA在鲁棒性和学习速度上表现更好。
AI.motivation: 传统神经细胞自动机(NCA)主要基于规则网格和摩尔邻域（单跳邻居），无法处理长程连接和复杂拓扑结构，而大脑中存在这样的复杂连接模式。因此需要开发一种更接近大脑连接模式的NCA模型。
AI.method: 提出BraiNCA模型，引入注意力层实现基于注意力的消息选择机制，加入显式的长程连接，采用复杂拓扑结构，同时保持去中心化的局部更新原则。
AI.result: 在两个任务上，BraiNCA相比传统Vanilla NCA表现出更好的鲁棒性和更快的学习速度，证明基于注意力的消息选择机制和显式长程连接能够产生更样本高效和损伤容忍的自组织。
AI.conclusion: 对于需要分布式协调的任务，交互拓扑的选择和动态信息路由能力会影响NCA的鲁棒性和学习速度。BraiNCA为研究生物现实网络结构下的集体计算提供了有前景的基础。

title: Setup-Independent Full Projector Compensation
summary: Projector compensation seeks to correct geometric and photometric distortions that occur when images are projected onto nonplanar or textured surfaces. However, most existing methods are highly setup-dependent, requiring fine-tuning or retraining whenever the surface, lighting, or projector-camera pose changes. Progress has been limited by two key challenges: (1) the absence of large, diverse training datasets and (2) existing geometric correction models are typically constrained by specific spatial setups; without further retraining or fine-tuning, they often fail to generalize directly to novel geometric configurations. We introduce SIComp, the first Setup-Independent framework for full projector Compensation, capable of generalizing to unseen setups without fine-tuning or retraining. To enable this, we construct a large-scale real-world dataset spanning 277 distinct projector-camera setups. SIComp adopts a co-adaptive design that decouples geometry and photometry: A carefully tailored optical flow module performs online geometric correction, while a novel photometric network handles photometric compensation. To further enhance robustness under varying illumination, we integrate intensity-varying surface priors into the network design. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SIComp consistently produces high-quality compensation across diverse unseen setups, substantially outperforming existing methods in terms of generalization ability and establishing the first generalizable solution to projector compensation. The code and dataset are available on our project page: https://hai-bo-li.github.io/SIComp/

AI.tldr: SIComp是首个无需微调或重训练即可泛化到新设置的全投影仪补偿框架，通过解耦几何和光度校正实现设置独立性。
AI.motivation: 现有投影仪补偿方法高度依赖特定设置，每当表面、光照或投影仪-相机位姿变化时都需要重新调整或训练，缺乏泛化能力。
AI.method: 构建大规模真实世界数据集（277个不同设置），采用协同自适应设计解耦几何和光度校正：定制光流模块进行在线几何校正，新颖的光度网络处理光度补偿，并集成强度变化表面先验增强光照变化下的鲁棒性。
AI.result: SIComp在各种未见设置中始终产生高质量补偿，在泛化能力方面显著优于现有方法，建立了首个可泛化的投影仪补偿解决方案。
AI.conclusion: SIComp是首个设置独立的投影仪补偿框架，能够泛化到未见设置而无需微调或重训练，通过大规模数据集和协同自适应设计解决了现有方法的泛化限制问题。

title: Brief Is Better: Non-Monotonic Chain-of-Thought Budget Effects in Function-Calling Language Agents
summary: How much should a language agent think before taking action? Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning is widely assumed to improve agent performance, but the relationship between reasoning length and accuracy in structured tool-use settings remains poorly understood. We present a systematic study of CoT budget effects on function-calling agents, sweeping six token budgets (0--512) across 200 tasks from the Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v3 Multiple benchmark. Our central finding is a striking non-monotonic pattern on Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct: brief reasoning (32 tokens) dramatically improves accuracy by 45% relative over direct answers, from 44.0% to 64.0%, while extended reasoning (256 tokens) degrades performance well below the no-CoT baseline, to 25.0% (McNemar p < 0.001). A three-way error decomposition reveals the mechanism. At d = 0, 30.5% of tasks fail because the model selects the wrong function from the candidate set; brief CoT reduces this to 1.5%, effectively acting as a function-routing step, while long CoT reverses the gain, yielding 28.0% wrong selections and 18.0% hallucinated functions at d = 256. Oracle analysis shows that 88.6% of solvable tasks require at most 32 reasoning tokens, with an average of 27.6 tokens, and a finer-grained sweep indicates that the true optimum lies at 8--16 tokens. Motivated by this routing effect, we propose Function-Routing CoT (FR-CoT), a structured brief-CoT method that templates the reasoning phase as "Function: [name] / Key args: [...]," forcing commitment to a valid function name at the start of reasoning. FR-CoT achieves accuracy statistically equivalent to free-form d = 32 CoT while reducing function hallucination to 0.0%, providing a structural reliability guarantee without budget tuning.

AI.tldr: 研究发现思维链长度对函数调用代理性能有显著非单调影响：简短推理（32词元）提升准确率45%，而长推理（256词元）反而降低性能。提出了结构化简短思维链方法FR-CoT，在保持性能的同时消除函数幻觉。
AI.motivation: 当前广泛认为思维链推理能提升语言代理性能，但在结构化工具使用场景中，推理长度与准确率的关系尚不明确。需要系统研究思维链预算对函数调用代理的影响。
AI.method: 在Berkeley Function Calling Leaderboard v3 Multiple基准的200个任务上，对Qwen2.5-1.5B-Instruct模型进行6种词元预算（0-512）的系统性研究。通过三向错误分解分析机制，提出结构化简短思维链方法FR-CoT，将推理阶段模板化为"Function: [name] / Key args: [...]"。
AI.result: 发现显著的非单调模式：简短推理（32词元）将准确率从44.0%提升至64.0%，而长推理（256词元）降至25.0%。错误分解显示简短CoT将错误函数选择从30.5%降至1.5%，长CoT则导致28.0%错误选择和18.0%函数幻觉。FR-CoT在保持d=32性能的同时将函数幻觉降至0.0%。
AI.conclusion: 思维链长度对函数调用代理有重要影响，简短推理主要作为函数路由步骤，过长推理反而有害。提出的FR-CoT方法通过结构化推理提供可靠性保证，无需预算调优，在保持性能的同时消除函数幻觉。

title: Probabilistic classification from possibilistic data: computing Kullback-Leibler projection with a possibility distribution
summary: We consider learning with possibilistic supervision for multi-class classification. For each training instance, the supervision is a normalized possibility distribution that expresses graded plausibility over the classes. From this possibility distribution, we construct a non-empty closed convex set of admissible probability distributions by combining two requirements: probabilistic compatibility with the possibility and necessity measures induced by the possibility distribution, and linear shape constraints that must be satisfied to preserve the qualitative structure of the possibility distribution. Thus, classes with the same possibility degree receive equal probabilities, and if a class has a strictly larger possibility degree than another class, then it receives a strictly larger probability. Given a strictly positive probability vector output by a model for an instance, we compute its Kullback-Leibler projection onto the admissible set. This projection yields the closest admissible probability distribution in Kullback-Leibler sense. We can then train the model by minimizing the divergence between the prediction and its projection, which quantifies the smallest adjustment needed to satisfy the induced dominance and shape constraints. The projection is computed with Dykstra's algorithm using Bregman projections associated with the negative entropy, and we provide explicit formulas for the projections onto each constraint set. Experiments conducted on synthetic data and on a real-world natural language inference task, based on the ChaosNLI dataset, show that the proposed projection algorithm is efficient enough for practical use, and that the resulting projection-based learning objective can improve predictive performance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于可能性监督的多类分类学习方法，通过构造可接受概率分布集，并使用Kullback-Leibler投影训练模型，在保持可能性分布定性结构的同时提高预测性能。
AI.motivation: 在多类分类任务中，传统的硬标签监督可能无法充分表达类别间的不确定性。可能性监督提供了更丰富的监督信息，但需要一种方法来将可能性分布转化为概率约束，同时保持其定性结构。
AI.method: 1. 从可能性分布构造可接受概率分布集：结合概率兼容性要求和线性形状约束；2. 使用Dykstra算法计算模型输出到可接受集的Kullback-Leibler投影；3. 通过最小化预测与其投影之间的散度来训练模型。
AI.result: 在合成数据和真实世界自然语言推理任务（基于ChaosNLI数据集）上的实验表明，所提出的投影算法足够高效，可用于实际应用，且基于投影的学习目标能够提高预测性能。
AI.conclusion: 该方法有效地将可能性监督转化为概率约束，通过Kullback-Leibler投影训练模型，在保持可能性分布定性结构的同时提升了分类性能，为处理不确定性监督信息提供了实用框架。

title: Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization with Reinforced Point Selection for Crowd Instance Segmentation
summary: Crowd instance segmentation is a crucial task with a wide range of applications, including surveillance and transportation. Currently, point labels are common in crowd datasets, while region labels (e.g., boxes) are rare and inaccurate. The masks obtained through segmentation help to improve the accuracy of region labels and resolve the correspondence between individual location coordinates and crowd density maps. However, directly applying currently popular large foundation models such as SAM does not yield ideal results in dense crowds. To this end, we first propose Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization (DPMO), which integrates SAM with the Nearest Neighbor Exclusive Circle (NNEC) constraint to generate dense instance segmentation from point annotations. With DPMO and manual correction, we obtain mask annotations from the existing point annotations for traditional crowd datasets. Then, to predict instance segmentation in dense crowds, we propose a Reinforced Point Selection (RPS) framework trained with Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO), which selects the best predicted point from a sampling of the initial point prediction. Through extensive experiments, we achieve state-of-the-art crowd instance segmentation performance on ShanghaiTech, UCF-QNRF, JHU-CROWD++, and NWPU-Crowd datasets. Furthermore, we design new loss functions supervised by masks that boost counting performance across different models, demonstrating the significant role of mask annotations in enhancing counting accuracy.

AI.tldr: 提出DPMO方法将点标注转换为掩码标注，并开发RPS框架用于密集人群实例分割，在多个数据集上达到SOTA性能，同时证明掩码标注能显著提升计数精度。
AI.motivation: 当前人群数据集通常只有点标注，而区域标注（如边界框）稀缺且不准确。直接应用SAM等大型基础模型在密集人群中效果不佳，需要开发专门的方法来处理密集人群实例分割问题。
AI.method: 1. 提出Dense Point-to-Mask Optimization (DPMO)，结合SAM和最近邻排斥圆约束，从点标注生成密集实例分割掩码；2. 提出Reinforced Point Selection (RPS)框架，使用Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO)训练，从初始点预测采样中选择最佳预测点；3. 设计基于掩码监督的新损失函数。
AI.result: 在ShanghaiTech、UCF-QNRF、JHU-CROWD++和NWPU-Crowd数据集上实现了最先进的密集人群实例分割性能。掩码监督的损失函数在不同模型上都能显著提升计数精度。
AI.conclusion: 提出的DPMO和RPS方法有效解决了密集人群实例分割问题，证明了掩码标注在提升人群计数精度中的重要作用，为人群分析任务提供了新的解决方案。

title: AstroConcepts: A Large-Scale Multi-Label Classification Corpus for Astrophysics
summary: Scientific multi-label text classification suffers from extreme class imbalance, where specialized terminology exhibits severe power-law distributions that challenge standard classification approaches. Existing scientific corpora lack comprehensive controlled vocabularies, focusing instead on broad categories and limiting systematic study of extreme imbalance. We introduce AstroConcepts, a corpus of English abstracts from 21,702 published astrophysics papers, labeled with 2,367 concepts from the Unified Astronomy Thesaurus. The corpus exhibits severe label imbalance, with 76% of concepts having fewer than 50 training examples. By releasing this resource, we enable systematic study of extreme class imbalance in scientific domains and establish strong baselines across traditional, neural, and vocabulary-constrained LLM methods. Our evaluation reveals three key patterns that provide new insights into scientific text classification. First, vocabulary-constrained LLMs achieve competitive performance relative to domain-adapted models in astrophysics classification, suggesting a potential for parameter-efficient approaches. Second, domain adaptation yields relatively larger improvements for rare, specialized terminology, although absolute performance remains limited across all methods. Third, we propose frequency-stratified evaluation to reveal performance patterns that are hidden by aggregate scores, thereby making robustness assessment central to scientific multi-label evaluation. These results offer actionable insights for scientific NLP and establish benchmarks for research on extreme imbalance.

AI.tldr: 该论文介绍了AstroConcepts语料库，包含21,702篇天体物理学论文摘要，标注了2,367个天文学概念，用于研究极端类别不平衡问题。研究发现词汇约束LLM在科学文本分类中表现优异，领域适应对罕见术语改进更大，并提出频率分层评估方法。
AI.motivation: 科学多标签文本分类面临极端类别不平衡问题，专业术语呈现严重的幂律分布，现有科学语料库缺乏全面的受控词汇表，限制了极端不平衡问题的系统性研究。
AI.method: 引入AstroConcepts语料库，包含21,702篇天体物理学论文摘要，标注了2,367个统一天文学词表中的概念。采用传统方法、神经网络方法和词汇约束LLM方法建立基线，并提出频率分层评估方法。
AI.result: 1) 词汇约束LLM在分类性能上与领域适应模型相当；2) 领域适应对罕见专业术语改进更大；3) 频率分层评估揭示了聚合分数隐藏的性能模式，所有方法在罕见概念上的绝对性能仍然有限。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为科学NLP提供了可操作的见解，并为极端不平衡研究建立了基准，强调将鲁棒性评估作为科学多标签评估的核心组成部分。

title: Qiana: A First-Order Formalism to Quantify over Contexts and Formulas with Temporality
summary: We introduce Qiana, a logic framework for reasoning on formulas that are true only in specific contexts. In Qiana, it is possible to quantify over both formulas and contexts to express, e.g., that ``everyone knows everything Alice says''. Qiana also permits paraconsistent logics within contexts, so that contexts can contain contradictions. Furthermore, Qiana is based on first-order logic, and is finitely axiomatizable, so that Qiana theories are compatible with pre-existing first-order logic theorem provers. We show how Qiana can be used to represent temporality, event calculus, and modal logic. We also discuss different design alternatives of Qiana.

AI.tldr: Qiana是一个逻辑框架，用于在特定上下文中推理公式，支持对公式和上下文的量化，允许上下文内包含矛盾，基于一阶逻辑且可有限公理化。
AI.motivation: 需要一种能够在特定上下文中进行推理的逻辑框架，能够表达复杂的知识关系（如"每个人都知道Alice说的一切"），同时支持上下文内的矛盾处理，并与现有一阶逻辑定理证明器兼容。
AI.method: 基于一阶逻辑构建Qiana逻辑框架，支持对公式和上下文的量化，允许上下文内使用超协调逻辑（paraconsistent logics），设计为可有限公理化，确保与现有定理证明器的兼容性。
AI.result: 展示了Qiana能够表示时间性、事件演算和模态逻辑，讨论了不同的设计替代方案，证明了该框架在复杂知识表示和推理方面的适用性。
AI.conclusion: Qiana提供了一个强大而灵活的逻辑框架，能够在特定上下文中进行推理，支持复杂的量化表达和矛盾处理，同时保持与现有一阶逻辑工具的兼容性，适用于多种逻辑表示需求。

title: Unifying UAV Cross-View Geo-Localization via 3D Geometric Perception
summary: Cross-view geo-localization for Unmanned Aerial Vehicles (UAVs) operating in GNSS-denied environments remains challenging due to the severe geometric discrepancy between oblique UAV imagery and orthogonal satellite maps. Most existing methods address this problem through a decoupled pipeline of place retrieval and pose estimation, implicitly treating perspective distortion as appearance noise rather than an explicit geometric transformation. In this work, we propose a geometry-aware UAV geo-localization framework that explicitly models the 3D scene geometry to unify coarse place recognition and fine-grained pose estimation within a single inference pipeline. Our approach reconstructs a local 3D scene from multi-view UAV image sequences using a Visual Geometry Grounded Transformer (VGGT), and renders a virtual Bird's-Eye View (BEV) representation that orthorectifies the UAV perspective to align with satellite imagery. This BEV serves as a geometric intermediary that enables robust cross-view retrieval and provides spatial priors for accurate 3 Degrees of Freedom (3-DoF) pose regression. To efficiently handle multiple location hypotheses, we introduce a Satellite-wise Attention Block that isolates the interaction between each satellite candidate and the reconstructed UAV scene, preventing inter-candidate interference while maintaining linear computational complexity. In addition, we release a recalibrated version of the University-1652 dataset with precise coordinate annotations and spatial overlap analysis, enabling rigorous evaluation of end-to-end localization accuracy. Extensive experiments on the refined University-1652 benchmark and SUES-200 demonstrate that our method significantly outperforms state-of-the-art baselines, achieving robust meter-level localization accuracy and improved generalization in complex urban environments.

AI.tldr: 提出几何感知的无人机地理定位框架，通过3D场景重建和虚拟鸟瞰图渲染，统一粗粒度位置识别和细粒度姿态估计，显著提升GNSS拒止环境下的定位精度。
AI.motivation: 无人机在GNSS拒止环境中的跨视角地理定位面临挑战，主要因为倾斜的无人机图像与正交卫星地图之间存在严重的几何差异。现有方法通常采用解耦的检索-姿态估计流程，将透视畸变视为外观噪声而非显式几何变换，限制了定位精度。
AI.method: 提出几何感知的无人机地理定位框架：1）使用视觉几何基础Transformer从多视角无人机图像序列重建局部3D场景；2）渲染虚拟鸟瞰图表示，将无人机视角正交化以对齐卫星图像；3）引入卫星级注意力块，隔离每个卫星候选与重建无人机场景的交互，防止候选间干扰同时保持线性计算复杂度。
AI.result: 在重新校准的University-1652数据集和SUES-200上进行广泛实验，方法显著优于现有最先进基线，实现了鲁棒的米级定位精度，在复杂城市环境中表现出更好的泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模3D场景几何，将粗粒度位置识别和细粒度姿态估计统一到单个推理流程中，提出的几何感知框架能够有效解决无人机跨视角地理定位中的几何差异问题，为GNSS拒止环境下的精确定位提供了有效解决方案。

title: Do Lexical and Contextual Coreference Resolution Systems Degrade Differently under Mention Noise? An Empirical Study on Scientific Software Mentions
summary: We present our participation in the SOMD 2026 shared task on cross-document software mention coreference resolution, where our systems ranked second across all three subtasks. We compare two fine-tuning-free approaches: Fuzzy Matching (FM), a lexical string-similarity method, and Context Aware Representations (CAR), which combines mention-level and document-level embeddings. Both achieve competitive performance across all subtasks (CoNLL F1 of 0.94-0.96), with CAR consistently outperforming FM by 1 point on the official test set, consistent with the high surface regularity of software names, which reduces the need for complex semantic reasoning. A controlled noise-injection study reveals complementary failure modes: as boundary noise increases, CAR loses only 0.07 F1 points from clean to fully corrupted input, compared to 0.20 for FM, whereas under mention substitution, FM degrades more gracefully (0.52 vs. 0.63). Our inference-time analysis shows that FM scales superlinearly with corpus size, whereas CAR scales approximately linearly, making CAR the more efficient choice at large scale. These findings suggest that system selection should be informed by both the noise profile of the upstream mention detector and the scale of the target corpus. We release our code to support future work on this underexplored task.

AI.tldr: 该论文在SOMD 2026软件提及跨文档共指消解任务中，比较了两种无需微调的方法：基于字符串相似度的模糊匹配(FM)和结合提及与文档嵌入的上下文感知表示(CAR)，两者均取得0.94-0.96的CoNLL F1分数，CAR在官方测试集上始终比FM高1分。
AI.motivation: 软件名称具有较高的表面规律性，可能不需要复杂的语义推理，因此探索无需微调的简单方法在跨文档软件提及共指消解任务中的有效性。
AI.method: 比较两种无需微调的方法：1) 模糊匹配(FM)：基于词汇字符串相似度的方法；2) 上下文感知表示(CAR)：结合提及级和文档级嵌入的方法。通过噪声注入研究分析两种方法的互补故障模式，并进行推理时间分析比较可扩展性。
AI.result: 两种方法在所有子任务中都取得了有竞争力的性能(CoNLL F1 0.94-0.96)，CAR在官方测试集上始终比FM高1分。噪声注入研究表明：边界噪声增加时，CAR从干净到完全损坏输入的F1仅下降0.07，而FM下降0.20；提及替换时，FM下降更平缓(0.52 vs 0.63)。推理时间分析显示FM随语料库规模呈超线性扩展，而CAR近似线性扩展。
AI.conclusion: 系统选择应考虑上游提及检测器的噪声特征和目标语料库的规模。CAR在大规模应用中更高效，而FM在特定噪声条件下表现更稳健。软件名称的表面规律性降低了复杂语义推理的需求，使得简单方法也能取得良好效果。

title: Adam's Law: Textual Frequency Law on Large Language Models
summary: While textual frequency has been validated as relevant to human cognition in reading speed, its relatedness to Large Language Models (LLMs) is seldom studied. We propose a novel research direction in terms of textual data frequency, which is an understudied topic, to the best of our knowledge. Our framework is composed of three units. First, this paper proposes Textual Frequency Law (TFL), which indicates that frequent textual data should be preferred for LLMs for both prompting and fine-tuning. Since many LLMs are closed-source in their training data, we propose using online resources to estimate the sentence-level frequency. We then utilize an input paraphraser to paraphrase the input into a more frequent textual expression. Next, we propose Textual Frequency Distillation (TFD) by querying LLMs to conduct story completion by further extending the sentences in the datasets, and the resulting corpora are used to adjust the initial estimation. Finally, we propose Curriculum Textual Frequency Training (CTFT) that fine-tunes LLMs in an increasing order of sentence-level frequency. Experiments are conducted on our curated dataset Textual Frequency Paired Dataset (TFPD) on math reasoning, machine translation, commonsense reasoning and agentic tool calling. Results show the effectiveness of our framework.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出基于文本频率的LLM优化框架，包括文本频率定律、文本频率蒸馏和课程文本频率训练，在多个任务上验证了高频文本对LLM性能的提升效果。
AI.motivation: 文本频率已被验证与人类阅读速度相关，但其与大型语言模型（LLMs）的相关性研究较少。作者认为这是一个未被充分研究的重要方向，旨在探索文本频率如何影响LLMs的性能。
AI.method: 提出三部分框架：1）文本频率定律（TFL）- 通过在线资源估计句子级频率，使用输入改写器将输入转换为更频繁的文本表达；2）文本频率蒸馏（TFD）- 通过查询LLMs进行故事补全来扩展数据集，调整初始频率估计；3）课程文本频率训练（CTFT）- 按句子级频率递增顺序微调LLMs。
AI.result: 在自建的数据集Textual Frequency Paired Dataset（TFPD）上进行了数学推理、机器翻译、常识推理和智能体工具调用等实验，结果显示该框架有效提升了LLMs的性能。
AI.conclusion: 高频文本数据对LLMs的提示和微调都有益处，提出的文本频率框架为LLM优化提供了新的研究方向和实践方法。

title: SenseMath: Do LLMs Have Number Sense? Evaluating Shortcut Use, Judgment, and Generation
summary: Large language models often default to step-by-step computation even when efficient numerical shortcuts are available. This raises a basic question: do they exhibit number sense in a human-like behavioral sense, i.e., the ability to recognize numerical structure, apply shortcuts when appropriate, and avoid them when they are not? We introduce SenseMath, a controlled benchmark for evaluating structure-sensitive numerical reasoning in LLMs. SenseMath contains 4,800 items spanning eight shortcut categories and four digit scales, with matched strong-shortcut, weak-shortcut, and control variants. It supports three evaluation settings of increasing cognitive demand: Shortcut Use (whether models can apply shortcuts on shortcut-amenable problems); Applicability Judgment (whether they can recognize when a shortcut is appropriate or misleading); and Problem Generation (whether they can generate new problem items that correctly admit a given type of shortcut). Our evaluation across five LLMs, ranging from GPT-4o-mini to Llama-3.1-8B, shows a consistent pattern: when explicitly prompted, models readily adopt shortcut strategies and achieve substantial accuracy gains on shortcut-amenable items (up to 15%), yet under standard chain-of-thought prompting they spontaneously employ such strategies in fewer than 40% of cases, even when they demonstrably possess the requisite capability. Moreover, this competence is confined to the Use level; models systematically over-generalise shortcuts to problems where they do not apply, and fail to generate valid shortcut-bearing problems from scratch. Together, these results suggest that current LLMs exhibit procedural shortcut fluency without the structural understanding of when and why shortcuts work that underlies human number sense.

AI.tldr: 大语言模型在数值推理中表现出程序性捷径使用能力，但缺乏人类数感的结构性理解，无法判断何时适用或生成新的捷径问题。
AI.motivation: 研究大语言模型是否具有类似人类的数感能力——即识别数值结构、在适当情况下应用捷径、在不适用时避免使用捷径的能力。当前模型常默认逐步计算，即使存在高效数值捷径。
AI.method: 引入SenseMath基准测试，包含4,800个项目，涵盖八个捷径类别和四个数字规模，匹配强捷径、弱捷径和控制变体。支持三个评估设置：捷径使用、适用性判断和问题生成。
AI.result: 五个LLM（从GPT-4o-mini到Llama-3.1-8B）显示一致模式：明确提示时模型能采用捷径策略（准确率提升达15%），但标准思维链提示下自发使用率低于40%。模型仅限于使用层面，会过度泛化捷径到不适用的场景，且无法从头生成有效的捷径问题。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM表现出程序性捷径流畅性，但缺乏支撑人类数感的结构性理解——即理解捷径何时有效及为何有效的深层认知能力。

title: The Expert Strikes Back: Interpreting Mixture-of-Experts Language Models at Expert Level
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures have become the dominant choice for scaling Large Language Models (LLMs), activating only a subset of parameters per token. While MoE architectures are primarily adopted for computational efficiency, it remains an open question whether their sparsity makes them inherently easier to interpret than dense feed-forward networks (FFNs). We compare MoE experts and dense FFNs using $k$-sparse probing and find that expert neurons are consistently less polysemantic, with the gap widening as routing becomes sparser. This suggests that sparsity pressures both individual neurons and entire experts toward monosemanticity. Leveraging this finding, we zoom out from the neuron to the expert level as a more effective unit of analysis. We validate this approach by automatically interpreting hundreds of experts. This analysis allows us to resolve the debate on specialization: experts are neither broad domain specialists (e.g., biology) nor simple token-level processors. Instead, they function as fine-grained task experts, specializing in linguistic operations or semantic tasks (e.g., closing brackets in LaTeX). Our findings suggest that MoEs are inherently interpretable at the expert level, providing a clearer path toward large-scale model interpretability. Code is available at: https://github.com/jerryy33/MoE_analysis

AI.tldr: MoE架构中的专家神经元比密集前馈网络更少多义性，稀疏性压力使专家趋向单义性，专家层面是更有效的分析单元，专家是细粒度任务专家而非宽领域专家
AI.motivation: 研究MoE架构是否因其稀疏性而比密集前馈网络更易于解释，探索专家神经元的语义特性和专家层面的可解释性
AI.method: 使用k-稀疏探测比较MoE专家和密集FFN，分析专家神经元的语义特性，从神经元层面扩展到专家层面作为分析单元，自动解释数百个专家
AI.result: 专家神经元比密集FFN神经元更少多义性，稀疏性压力使神经元和专家都趋向单义性，专家层面是更有效的分析单元，专家是细粒度任务专家而非宽领域专家
AI.conclusion: MoE在专家层面具有内在可解释性，为大规模模型可解释性提供了更清晰的路径，专家作为细粒度任务专家的发现有助于理解MoE架构的工作机制

title: GenGait: A Transformer-Based Model for Human Gait Anomaly Detection and Normative Twin Generation
comment: 13 pages, 6 figures. Preprint submitted to a journal
summary: Gait analysis provides an objective characterization of locomotor function and is widely used to support diagnosis and rehabilitation monitoring across neurological and orthopedic disorders. Deep learning has been increasingly applied to this domain, yet most approaches rely on supervised classifiers trained on disease-labeled data, limiting generalization to heterogeneous pathological presentations. This work proposes a label-free framework for joint-level anomaly detection and kinematic correction based on a Transformer masked autoencoder trained exclusively on normative gait sequences from 150 adults, acquired with a markerless multi-camera motion-capture system. At inference, a two-pass procedure is applied to potentially pathological input sequences, first it estimates joint inconsistency scores by occluding individual joints and measuring deviations from the learned normative prior. Then, it withholds the flagged joints from the encoder input and reconstructs the full skeleton from the remaining spatiotemporal context, yielding corrected kinematic trajectories at the flagged positions. Validation on 10 held-out normative participants, who mimicked seven simulated gait abnormalities, showed accurate localization of biomechanically inconsistent joints, a significant reduction in angular deviation across all analyzed joints with large effect sizes, and preservation of normative kinematics. The proposed approach enables interpretable, subject-specific localization of gait impairments without requiring disease labels. Video is available at https://youtu.be/Rcm3jqR5pN4.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Transformer掩码自编码器的无标签框架，用于关节级步态异常检测和运动学校正，仅使用正常步态数据进行训练，无需疾病标签。
AI.motivation: 当前基于深度学习的步态分析方法大多依赖有监督分类器，需要疾病标签数据，难以泛化到异质性病理表现。需要一种无需标签、能够检测异常并校正运动学的方法。
AI.method: 使用Transformer掩码自编码器，仅用150名成年人的正常步态序列进行训练。推理时采用两阶段流程：1)通过遮挡单个关节并测量与学习到的正常先验的偏差来估计关节不一致性分数；2)从编码器输入中排除标记的关节，从剩余的时空上下文中重建完整骨架，生成校正后的运动学轨迹。
AI.result: 在10名保留的正常参与者（模拟七种步态异常）上的验证显示：能够准确定位生物力学不一致的关节；所有分析关节的角度偏差显著减少且效应量大；能够保持正常运动学特征。
AI.conclusion: 该方法实现了无需疾病标签、可解释的、个体化的步态损伤定位，为步态分析和康复监测提供了新的无监督框架。

title: Cosine-Normalized Attention for Hyperspectral Image Classification
summary: Transformer-based methods have improved hyperspectral image classification (HSIC) by modeling long-range spatial-spectral dependencies; however, their attention mechanisms typically rely on dot-product similarity, which mixes feature magnitude and orientation and may be suboptimal for hyperspectral data. This work revisits attention scoring from a geometric perspective and introduces a cosine-normalized attention formulation that aligns similarity computation with the angular structure of hyperspectral signatures. By projecting query and key embeddings onto a unit hypersphere and applying a squared cosine similarity, the proposed method emphasizes angular relationships while reducing sensitivity to magnitude variations. The formulation is integrated into a spatial-spectral Transformer and evaluated under extremely limited supervision. Experiments on three benchmark datasets demonstrate that the proposed approach consistently achieves higher performance, outperforming several recent Transformer- and Mamba-based models despite using a lightweight backbone. In addition, a controlled analysis of multiple attention score functions shows that cosine-based scoring provides a reliable inductive bias for hyperspectral representation learning.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于余弦归一化注意力的Transformer方法，用于高光谱图像分类，通过将查询和键嵌入投影到单位超球面上并使用平方余弦相似度，强调角度关系并减少对幅度变化的敏感性。
AI.motivation: 现有基于Transformer的高光谱图像分类方法通常依赖点积相似度，这会混合特征幅度和方向信息，可能对高光谱数据不够优化。本文从几何角度重新审视注意力评分，旨在更好地对齐高光谱签名的角度结构。
AI.method: 提出余弦归一化注意力公式，将查询和键嵌入投影到单位超球面上，应用平方余弦相似度计算注意力分数。该方法集成到空间-光谱Transformer中，并在极有限监督下进行评估。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上的实验表明，该方法始终实现更高性能，尽管使用轻量级骨干网络，但仍优于多个最近的Transformer和Mamba模型。对多种注意力评分函数的受控分析显示，基于余弦的评分为高光谱表示学习提供了可靠的归纳偏置。
AI.conclusion: 余弦归一化注意力公式通过强调角度关系并减少对幅度变化的敏感性，为高光谱图像分类提供了更有效的注意力机制，在有限监督下表现出优越性能。

title: Neuro-RIT: Neuron-Guided Instruction Tuning for Robust Retrieval-Augmented Language Model
summary: Retrieval-Augmented Language Models (RALMs) have demonstrated significant potential in knowledge-intensive tasks; however, they remain vulnerable to performance degradation when presented with irrelevant or noisy retrieved contexts. Existing approaches to enhance robustness typically operate via coarse-grained parameter updates at the layer or module level, often overlooking the inherent neuron-level sparsity of Large Language Models (LLMs). To address this limitation, we propose Neuro-RIT (Neuron-guided Robust Instruction Tuning), a novel framework that shifts the paradigm from dense adaptation to precision-driven neuron alignment. Our method explicitly disentangles neurons that are responsible for processing relevant versus irrelevant contexts using attribution-based neuron mining. Subsequently, we introduce a two-stage instruction tuning strategy that enforces a dual capability for noise robustness: achieving direct noise suppression by functionally deactivating neurons exclusive to irrelevant contexts, while simultaneously optimizing targeted layers for evidence distillation. Extensive experiments across diverse QA benchmarks demonstrate that Neuro-RIT consistently outperforms strong baselines and robustness-enhancing methods.

AI.tldr: 提出Neuro-RIT框架，通过神经元引导的鲁棒指令调优，解决检索增强语言模型在噪声上下文下的性能下降问题，从密集适应转向精准神经元对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有检索增强语言模型在面对无关或噪声检索上下文时性能会下降，而现有增强鲁棒性的方法通常在层或模块级别进行粗粒度参数更新，忽略了大型语言模型固有的神经元级稀疏性。
AI.method: 提出Neuro-RIT框架：1）使用基于归因的神经元挖掘显式解耦处理相关与无关上下文的神经元；2）引入两阶段指令调优策略，实现双重噪声鲁棒能力：通过功能失活仅处理无关上下文的神经元实现直接噪声抑制，同时优化目标层进行证据蒸馏。
AI.result: 在多样化问答基准上的广泛实验表明，Neuro-RIT始终优于强基线方法和鲁棒性增强方法。
AI.conclusion: Neuro-RIT通过从密集适应转向精准神经元对齐的新范式，有效提升了检索增强语言模型在噪声上下文下的鲁棒性，为处理无关检索内容提供了更精细的解决方案。

title: How and why does deep ensemble coupled with transfer learning increase performance in bipolar disorder and schizophrenia classification?
summary: Transfer learning (TL) and deep ensemble learning (DE) have recently been shown to outperform simple machine learning in classifying psychiatric disorders. However, there is still a lack of understanding as to why that is. This paper aims to understand how and why DE and TL reduce the variability of single-subject classification models in bipolar disorder (BD) and schizophrenia (SCZ). To this end, we investigated the training stability of TL and DE models. For the two classification tasks under consideration, we compared the results of multiple trainings with the same backbone but with different initializations. In this way, we take into account the epistemic uncertainty associated with the uncertainty in the estimation of the model parameters. It has been shown that the performance of classifiers can be significantly improved by using TL with DE. Based on these results, we investigate i) how many models are needed to benefit from the performance improvement of DE when classifying BD and SCZ from healthy controls, and ii) how TL induces better generalization, with and without DE. In the first case, we show that DE reaches a plateau when 10 models are included in the ensemble. In the second case, we find that using a pre-trained model constrains TL models with the same pre-training to stay in the same basin of the loss function. This is not the case for DL models with randomly initialized weights.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了迁移学习和深度集成学习在精神疾病分类中减少模型变异性的机制，发现集成10个模型可达到性能平台，且预训练模型能约束模型保持在损失函数的同一区域。
AI.motivation: 尽管迁移学习和深度集成学习在精神疾病分类中表现出优于简单机器学习方法的性能，但其背后的原因尚不清楚。本研究旨在理解这两种方法如何以及为何能减少双相情感障碍和精神分裂症单被试分类模型的变异性。
AI.method: 通过研究TL和DE模型的训练稳定性，比较相同架构但不同初始化的多次训练结果，考虑模型参数估计中的认知不确定性。具体研究：1）需要多少模型才能从DE的性能提升中受益；2）TL如何诱导更好的泛化能力（无论是否使用DE）。
AI.result: 1）DE在包含10个模型时达到性能平台；2）使用预训练模型能约束TL模型保持在损失函数的同一区域，而随机初始化的DL模型则不具备这种特性。
AI.conclusion: 迁移学习和深度集成学习通过减少模型变异性来提高精神疾病分类性能，其中集成10个模型可达到最佳效果，预训练有助于模型收敛到损失函数的同一区域，从而提高泛化能力。

title: Hidden Meanings in Plain Sight: RebusBench for Evaluating Cognitive Visual Reasoning
comment: Accepted at ICLR 2026 Workshop: From Human Cognition to AI Reasoning (HCAIR)
summary: Large Vision-Language Models (LVLMs) have achieved remarkable proficiency in explicit visual recognition, effectively describing what is directly visible in an image. However, a critical cognitive gap emerges when the visual input serves only as a clue rather than the answer. We identify that current models struggle with the complex, multi-step reasoning required to solve problems where information is not explicitly depicted. Successfully solving a rebus puzzle requires a distinct cognitive workflow: the model must extract visual and textual attributes, retrieve linguistic prior knowledge (such as idioms), and perform abstract mapping to synthesize these elements into a meaning that exists outside the pixel space. To evaluate this neurosymbolic capability, we introduce RebusBench, a benchmark of 1,164 puzzles designed to test this specific integration of perception and knowledge. Our evaluation of state-of-the-art models (including Qwen, InternVL, and LLaVA) shows a severe deficiency: performance saturates below 10% Exact Match and 20% semantic accuracy, with no significant improvement observed from model scaling or In-Context Learning (ICL). These findings suggest that while models possess the necessary visual and linguistic components, they lack the cognitive reasoning glue to connect them. Project page available at https://amirkasaei.com/rebusbench/.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了RebusBench基准测试，用于评估大视觉语言模型在解决需要多步骤推理的谜语谜题（rebus puzzles）上的能力，发现现有模型表现严重不足，准确率低于10%。
AI.motivation: 当前大视觉语言模型在显式视觉识别方面表现出色，但在需要复杂多步骤推理的任务上存在认知差距。当视觉输入仅作为线索而非答案时，模型难以进行抽象推理和知识整合。
AI.method: 提出了RebusBench基准测试，包含1,164个谜语谜题，专门测试模型整合感知和知识的能力。评估了包括Qwen、InternVL、LLaVA在内的先进模型，并分析了模型规模扩展和上下文学习的影响。
AI.result: 现有模型表现严重不足：精确匹配准确率低于10%，语义准确率低于20%。模型规模扩展和上下文学习都没有带来显著改进，表明模型缺乏连接视觉和语言组件的认知推理能力。
AI.conclusion: 大视觉语言模型虽然具备必要的视觉和语言组件，但缺乏将这些组件连接起来的认知推理"粘合剂"。RebusBench揭示了模型在神经符号推理能力上的根本缺陷。

title: Towards Position-Robust Talent Recommendation via Large Language Models
summary: Talent recruitment is a critical, yet costly process for many industries, with high recruitment costs and long hiring cycles. Existing talent recommendation systems increasingly adopt large language models (LLMs) due to their remarkable language understanding capabilities. However, most prior approaches follow a pointwise paradigm, which requires LLMs to repeatedly process some text and fails to capture the relationships among candidates in the list, resulting in higher token consumption and suboptimal recommendations. Besides, LLMs exhibit position bias and the lost-in-the-middle issue when answering multiple-choice questions and processing multiple long documents. To address these issues, we introduce an implicit strategy to utilize LLM's potential output for the recommendation task and propose L3TR, a novel framework for listwise talent recommendation with LLMs. In this framework, we propose a block attention mechanism and a local positional encoding method to enhance inter-document processing and mitigate the position bias and concurrent token bias issue. We also introduce an ID sampling method for resolving the inconsistency between candidate set sizes in the training phase and the inference phase. We design evaluation methods to detect position bias and token bias and training-free debiasing methods. Extensive experiments on two real-world datasets validated the effectiveness of L3TR, showing consistent improvements over existing baselines.

AI.tldr: L3TR：一种基于大语言模型的列表式人才推荐框架，通过块注意力机制和局部位置编码解决位置偏见和并发令牌偏见问题，提高推荐效果并降低计算成本
AI.motivation: 传统人才推荐系统采用点对点范式，需要大语言模型重复处理文本，无法捕捉候选人之间的关系，导致令牌消耗高且推荐效果不佳。同时，大语言模型在处理多项选择题和长文档时存在位置偏见和"迷失在中间"问题。
AI.method: 提出L3TR框架，采用隐式策略利用大语言模型的潜在输出进行推荐。引入块注意力机制和局部位置编码方法增强文档间处理并缓解位置偏见和并发令牌偏见问题。提出ID采样方法解决训练和推理阶段候选集大小不一致问题。
AI.result: 在两个真实世界数据集上的广泛实验验证了L3TR的有效性，相比现有基线方法取得了持续改进。设计了检测位置偏见和令牌偏见的评估方法以及无需训练的去偏见方法。
AI.conclusion: L3TR框架通过列表式处理方式有效解决了传统点对点范式的问题，降低了令牌消耗，提高了人才推荐的质量和效率，为大语言模型在人才推荐领域的应用提供了新思路。

title: ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Exploratory Demonstration Reinforcement Learning for LLM Agentic Reasoning
summary: Reinforcement Learning (RL) significantly enhances the reasoning abilities of large language models (LLMs), yet applying it to multi-turn agentic tasks remains challenging due to the long-horizon nature of interactions and the stochasticity of environmental feedback. We identify a structural failure mode in agentic exploration: suboptimal actions elicit noisy observations into misleading contexts, which further weaken subsequent decision-making, making recovery increasingly difficult. This cumulative feedback loop of errors renders standard exploration strategies ineffective and susceptible to the model's reasoning and the environment's randomness. To mitigate this issue, we propose ProCeedRL: Process Critic with Explorative Demonstration RL, shifting exploration from passive selection to active intervention. ProCeedRL employs a process-level critic to monitor interactions in real time, incorporating reflection-based demonstrations to guide agents in stopping the accumulation of errors. We find that this approach significantly exceeds the model's saturated exploration performance, demonstrating substantial exploratory benefits. By learning from exploratory demonstrations and on-policy samples, ProCeedRL significantly improves exploration efficiency and achieves superior performance on complex deep search and embodied tasks.

AI.tldr: ProCeedRL是一种强化学习方法，通过过程级批评器和探索性演示来解决多轮智能体任务中的探索失败问题，显著提升探索效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 强化学习虽然能增强大语言模型的推理能力，但在多轮智能体任务中面临挑战，因为交互过程长且环境反馈具有随机性。研究发现存在结构性探索失败模式：次优动作会产生误导性上下文，进一步削弱后续决策，形成累积错误循环，使标准探索策略失效。
AI.method: 提出ProCeedRL方法，将探索从被动选择转变为主动干预。该方法使用过程级批评器实时监控交互，结合基于反思的演示来指导智能体停止错误累积。通过学习探索性演示和在线策略样本，提升探索效率。
AI.result: ProCeedRL显著超越了模型的饱和探索性能，显示出显著的探索优势。在复杂的深度搜索和具身任务中，该方法显著提高了探索效率并实现了卓越的性能表现。
AI.conclusion: ProCeedRL通过主动干预的探索策略有效解决了多轮智能体任务中的累积错误循环问题，为强化学习在复杂智能体任务中的应用提供了有效解决方案。

title: DriveDreamer-Policy: A Geometry-Grounded World-Action Model for Unified Generation and Planning
summary: Recently, world-action models (WAM) have emerged to bridge vision-language-action (VLA) models and world models, unifying their reasoning and instruction-following capabilities and spatio-temporal world modeling. However, existing WAM approaches often focus on modeling 2D appearance or latent representations, with limited geometric grounding-an essential element for embodied systems operating in the physical world. We present DriveDreamer-Policy, a unified driving world-action model that integrates depth generation, future video generation, and motion planning within a single modular architecture. The model employs a large language model to process language instructions, multi-view images, and actions, followed by three lightweight generators that produce depth, future video, and actions. By learning a geometry-aware world representation and using it to guide both future prediction and planning within a unified framework, the proposed model produces more coherent imagined futures and more informed driving actions, while maintaining modularity and controllable latency. Experiments on the Navsim v1 and v2 benchmarks demonstrate that DriveDreamer-Policy achieves strong performance on both closed-loop planning and world generation tasks. In particular, our model reaches 89.2 PDMS on Navsim v1 and 88.7 EPDMS on Navsim v2, outperforming existing world-model-based approaches while producing higher-quality future video and depth predictions. Ablation studies further show that explicit depth learning provides complementary benefits to video imagination and improves planning robustness.

AI.tldr: DriveDreamer-Policy是一个统一的驾驶世界-动作模型，集成了深度生成、未来视频生成和运动规划，通过几何感知的世界表示提升自动驾驶的连贯性和鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 现有世界-动作模型主要关注2D外观或潜在表示建模，缺乏对物理世界具身系统至关重要的几何基础。需要开发一个能够统一深度生成、未来预测和运动规划的几何感知模型。
AI.method: 采用模块化架构：使用大语言模型处理语言指令、多视角图像和动作，然后通过三个轻量级生成器分别生成深度、未来视频和动作。学习几何感知的世界表示来指导未来预测和规划。
AI.result: 在Navsim v1和v2基准测试中表现出色：Navsim v1达到89.2 PDMS，Navsim v2达到88.7 EPDMS，优于现有基于世界模型的方法，同时生成更高质量的未来视频和深度预测。
AI.conclusion: DriveDreamer-Policy通过统一的几何感知世界表示框架，实现了更连贯的未来想象和更明智的驾驶动作，显式深度学习为视频想象和规划鲁棒性提供了互补优势。

title: ATBench: A Diverse and Realistic Trajectory Benchmark for Long-Horizon Agent Safety
summary: Evaluating the safety of LLM-based agents is increasingly important because risks in realistic deployments often emerge over multi-step interactions rather than isolated prompts or final responses. Existing trajectory-level benchmarks remain limited by insufficient interaction diversity, coarse observability of safety failures, and weak long-horizon realism. We introduce ATBench, a trajectory-level benchmark for structured, diverse, and realistic evaluation of agent safety. ATBench organizes agentic risk along three dimensions: risk source, failure mode, and real-world harm. Based on this taxonomy, we construct trajectories with heterogeneous tool pools and a long-context delayed-trigger protocol that captures realistic risk emergence across multiple stages. The benchmark contains 1,000 trajectories (503 safe and 497 unsafe), averaging 9.01 turns and 3.95k tokens, with 1,954 invoked tools drawn from pools spanning 2,084 available tools. Data quality is supported by rule-based and LLM-based filtering plus full human audit. Experiments on frontier LLMs, open-source models, and specialized guard systems show that ATBench is challenging even for strong evaluators, while enabling taxonomy-stratified analysis, cross-benchmark comparison, and diagnosis of long-horizon failure patterns.

AI.tldr: ATBench是一个用于评估LLM智能体安全性的轨迹级基准测试，通过三维风险分类、异构工具池和长上下文延迟触发协议，提供结构化、多样化和现实的安全评估。
AI.motivation: 现有轨迹级基准测试存在交互多样性不足、安全失败可观测性粗糙、长视野现实性弱等问题，需要更全面、结构化的智能体安全评估方法。
AI.method: 基于三维风险分类（风险来源、失败模式、现实危害）构建轨迹，使用异构工具池和长上下文延迟触发协议，包含1000个轨迹（503安全/497不安全），平均9.01轮对话和3.95k tokens，工具池包含2084个可用工具。
AI.result: ATBench对前沿LLM、开源模型和专门防护系统都具有挑战性，支持分类分层分析、跨基准比较和长视野失败模式诊断，数据质量通过规则和LLM过滤加人工审核保证。
AI.conclusion: ATBench为LLM智能体安全评估提供了结构化、多样化和现实的轨迹级基准，能够捕捉多阶段交互中风险的真实涌现模式，支持更全面的安全分析和诊断。

title: No Single Best Model for Diversity: Learning a Router for Sample Diversity
summary: When posed with prompts that permit a large number of valid answers, comprehensively generating them is the first step towards satisfying a wide range of users. In this paper, we study methods to elicit a comprehensive set of valid responses. To evaluate this, we introduce \textbf{diversity coverage}, a metric that measures the total quality scores assigned to each \textbf{unique} answer in the predicted answer set relative to the best possible answer set with the same number of answers. Using this metric, we evaluate 18 LLMs, finding no single model dominates at generating diverse responses to a wide range of open-ended prompts. Yet, per each prompt, there exists a model that outperforms all other models significantly at generating a diverse answer set. Motivated by this finding, we introduce a router that predicts the best model for each query. On NB-Wildchat, our trained router outperforms the single best model baseline (26.3% vs $23.8%). We further show generalization to an out-of-domain dataset (NB-Curated) as well as different answer-generation prompting strategies. Our work lays foundation for studying generating comprehensive answers when we have access to a suite of models.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了多样性覆盖率指标来评估模型生成全面有效答案的能力，发现不同模型在不同提示上表现各异，因此开发了一个路由器来为每个查询选择最佳模型，显著提升了答案多样性。
AI.motivation: 当面对允许多个有效答案的提示时，全面生成这些答案是满足多样化用户需求的第一步。现有研究缺乏评估模型生成全面答案集能力的指标，且不同模型在不同类型的开放提示上表现存在差异。
AI.method: 1. 提出多样性覆盖率指标，衡量预测答案集中每个独特答案的质量分数相对于相同数量最佳可能答案集的比例；2. 评估18个LLM在生成多样化答案方面的表现；3. 基于发现开发一个路由器，为每个查询预测最佳模型；4. 在NB-Wildchat和NB-Curated数据集上进行验证。
AI.result: 1. 没有单一模型在所有开放提示上都能生成最全面的答案集；2. 对于每个特定提示，都存在一个显著优于其他模型的模型；3. 训练的路由器在NB-Wildchat上表现优于单一最佳模型基线（26.3% vs 23.8%）；4. 路由器能够泛化到域外数据集和不同的答案生成提示策略。
AI.conclusion: 该研究为在拥有多个模型的情况下生成全面答案提供了基础，通过路由器动态选择最佳模型的方法能够显著提升答案多样性，为满足多样化用户需求提供了有效解决方案。

title: Systematic Analyses of Reinforcement Learning Controllers in Signalized Urban Corridors
summary: In this work, we extend our systematic capacity region perspective to multi-junction traffic networks, focussing on the special case of an urban corridor network. In particular, we train and evaluate centralized, fully decentralized, and parameter-sharing decentralized RL controllers, and compare their capacity regions and ATTs together with a classical baseline MaxPressure controller. Further, we show how the parametersharing controller may be generalised to be deployed on a larger network than it was originally trained on. In this setting, we show some initial findings that suggest that even though the junctions are not formally coordinated, traffic may self organise into `green waves'.

AI.tldr: 该研究将系统容量区域视角扩展到多路口交通网络，特别关注城市走廊网络，比较了集中式、完全分散式和参数共享分散式RL控制器与经典MaxPressure控制器的性能，并展示了参数共享控制器在更大网络上的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 将系统容量区域分析方法扩展到多路口交通网络，特别是城市走廊网络，以评估不同控制策略在复杂交通环境中的性能表现。
AI.method: 训练和评估了三种强化学习控制器：集中式、完全分散式和参数共享分散式，并与经典的MaxPressure控制器进行对比；同时研究了参数共享控制器在更大网络上的部署能力。
AI.result: 比较了不同控制器的容量区域和平均旅行时间；发现参数共享控制器可以泛化到比训练时更大的网络；观察到即使路口没有正式协调，交通也可能自组织形成"绿波"现象。
AI.conclusion: 参数共享分散式RL控制器在多路口交通网络中表现出良好的性能，能够泛化到更大规模网络，并且可能促进交通自组织形成绿波效应，为智能交通控制提供了有前景的解决方案。

title: GardenDesigner: Encoding Aesthetic Principles into Jiangnan Garden Construction via a Chain of Agents
summary: Jiangnan gardens, a prominent style of Chinese classical gardens, hold great potential as digital assets for film and game production and digital tourism. However, manual modeling of Jiangnan gardens heavily relies on expert experience for layout design and asset creation, making the process time-consuming. To address this gap, we propose GardenDesigner, a novel framework that encodes aesthetic principles for Jiangnan garden construction and integrates a chain of agents based on procedural modeling. The water-centric terrain and explorative pathway rules are applied by terrain distribution and road generation agents. Selection and spatial layout of garden assets follow the aesthetic and cultural constraints. Consequently, we propose asset selection and layout optimization agents to select and arrange objects for each area in the garden. Additionally, we introduce GardenVerse for Jiangnan garden construction, including expert-annotated garden knowledge to enhance the asset arrangement process. To enable interaction and editing, we develop an interactive interface and tools in Unity, in which non-expert users can construct Jiangnan gardens via text input within one minute. Experiments and human evaluations demonstrate that GardenDesigner can generate diverse and aesthetically pleasing Jiangnan gardens. Project page is available at https://monad-cube.github.io/GardenDesigner.

AI.tldr: GardenDesigner是一个基于程序化建模和智能体链的江南园林自动生成框架，通过编码美学原则和文化约束，让非专家用户能在1分钟内通过文本输入创建江南园林。
AI.motivation: 江南园林作为重要的数字资产在影视游戏和数字旅游中具有巨大潜力，但传统手工建模依赖专家经验且耗时，需要自动化解决方案。
AI.method: 提出GardenDesigner框架，编码江南园林建造的美学原则，集成基于程序化建模的智能体链：地形分布智能体应用水中心地形规则，道路生成智能体应用探索性路径规则，资产选择和布局优化智能体遵循美学文化约束安排对象，并引入包含专家标注知识的GardenVerse增强资产布置。
AI.result: 开发了Unity交互界面和工具，非专家用户可通过文本输入在1分钟内构建江南园林。实验和人工评估表明，GardenDesigner能生成多样且美观的江南园林。
AI.conclusion: GardenDesigner成功实现了江南园林的自动化生成，为数字内容创作提供了高效工具，将江南园林美学原则编码到计算框架中，使非专家用户也能快速创建符合文化传统的园林设计。

title: Grounded Token Initialization for New Vocabulary in LMs for Generative Recommendation
summary: Language models (LMs) are increasingly extended with new learnable vocabulary tokens for domain-specific tasks, such as Semantic-ID tokens in generative recommendation. The standard practice initializes these new tokens as the mean of existing vocabulary embeddings, then relies on supervised fine-tuning to learn their representations. We present a systematic analysis of this strategy: through spectral and geometric diagnostics, we show that mean initialization collapses all new tokens into a degenerate subspace, erasing inter-token distinctions that subsequent fine-tuning struggles to fully recover. These findings suggest that \emph{token initialization} is a key bottleneck when extending LMs with new vocabularies. Motivated by this diagnosis, we propose the \emph{Grounded Token Initialization Hypothesis}: linguistically grounding novel tokens in the pretrained embedding space before fine-tuning better enables the model to leverage its general-purpose knowledge for novel-token domains. We operationalize this hypothesis as GTI (Grounded Token Initialization), a lightweight grounding stage that, prior to fine-tuning, maps new tokens to distinct, semantically meaningful locations in the pretrained embedding space using only paired linguistic supervision. Despite its simplicity, GTI outperforms both mean initialization and existing auxiliary-task adaptation methods in the majority of evaluation settings across multiple generative recommendation benchmarks, including industry-scale and public datasets. Further analyses show that grounded embeddings produce richer inter-token structure that persists through fine-tuning, corroborating the hypothesis that initialization quality is a key bottleneck in vocabulary extension.

AI.tldr: 研究发现语言模型扩展新词汇时常用的均值初始化方法存在缺陷，会导致新token坍缩到退化子空间，提出基于语言基础的token初始化方法GTI，在多个推荐基准测试中表现更优。
AI.motivation: 当前语言模型在扩展新词汇时通常采用均值初始化策略，但作者通过系统分析发现这种方法存在根本性缺陷，导致新token之间的区分性被抹除，限制了后续微调的效果。
AI.method: 提出GTI（Grounded Token Initialization）方法，在微调前将新token映射到预训练嵌入空间中具有语义意义的特定位置，仅使用配对的语言监督进行轻量级的基础化阶段。
AI.result: 在多个生成式推荐基准测试（包括工业级和公共数据集）中，GTI在大多数评估设置下都优于均值初始化和现有的辅助任务适应方法。
AI.conclusion: 初始化质量是词汇扩展的关键瓶颈，通过语言基础化的token初始化能够产生更丰富的token间结构，这些结构在微调过程中得以保持，验证了基础化token初始化假设。

title: The Latent Space: Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, and Outlook
summary: Latent space is rapidly emerging as a native substrate for language-based models. While modern systems are still commonly understood through explicit token-level generation, an increasing body of work shows that many critical internal processes are more naturally carried out in continuous latent space than in human-readable verbal traces. This shift is driven by the structural limitations of explicit-space computation, including linguistic redundancy, discretization bottlenecks, sequential inefficiency, and semantic loss. This survey aims to provide a unified and up-to-date landscape of latent space in language-based models. We organize the survey into five sequential perspectives: Foundation, Evolution, Mechanism, Ability, and Outlook. We begin by delineating the scope of latent space, distinguishing it from explicit or verbal space and from the latent spaces commonly studied in generative visual models. We then trace the field's evolution from early exploratory efforts to the current large-scale expansion. To organize the technical landscape, we examine existing work through the complementary lenses of mechanism and ability. From the perspective of Mechanism, we identify four major lines of development: Architecture, Representation, Computation, and Optimization. From the perspective of Ability, we show how latent space supports a broad capability spectrum spanning Reasoning, Planning, Modeling, Perception, Memory, Collaboration, and Embodiment. Beyond consolidation, we discuss the key open challenges, and outline promising directions for future research. We hope this survey serves not only as a reference for existing work, but also as a foundation for understanding latent space as a general computational and systems paradigm for next-generation intelligence.

AI.tldr: 这篇综述论文系统梳理了语言模型中潜在空间的研究现状，将其作为语言模型计算的新兴原生基质，从基础、演化、机制、能力和展望五个视角构建统一框架。
AI.motivation: 随着语言模型的发展，研究者发现许多关键内部过程在连续潜在空间中比在人类可读的显式标记空间中更自然。显式空间计算存在语言冗余、离散化瓶颈、序列效率低下和语义损失等结构限制，促使研究向潜在空间转移。
AI.method: 采用五维框架组织综述：1) 基础：界定潜在空间范围，区分显式/语言空间和视觉生成模型中的潜在空间；2) 演化：追溯从早期探索到当前大规模扩展的发展历程；3) 机制：从架构、表示、计算和优化四个技术维度分析；4) 能力：展示潜在空间支持推理、规划、建模、感知、记忆、协作和具身等广泛能力；5) 展望：讨论开放挑战和未来研究方向。
AI.result: 构建了语言模型潜在空间的统一研究框架，系统整理了该领域的技术发展脉络，识别了关键研究方向，为理解潜在空间作为下一代智能的通用计算和系统范式奠定基础。
AI.conclusion: 潜在空间正在成为语言模型的原生计算基质，这篇综述不仅为现有研究提供参考，更重要的是为理解潜在空间作为下一代智能的通用计算范式奠定基础，指出了该领域的关键挑战和未来发展方向。

title: AI in Insurance: Adaptive Questionnaires for Improved Risk Profiling
summary:
Insurance application processes often rely on lengthy and standardized questionnaires that struggle to capture individual differences. Moreover, insurers must blindly trust users' responses, increasing the chances of fraud. The ARQuest framework introduces a new approach to underwriting by using Large Language Models (LLMs) and alternative data sources to create personalized and adaptive questionnaires. Techniques such as social media image analysis, geographic data categorization, and Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG) are used to extract meaningful user insights and guide targeted follow-up questions.
  A life insurance system integrated into an industry partner mobile app was tested in two experiments. While traditional questionnaires yielded slightly higher accuracy in risk assessment, adaptive versions powered by GPT models required fewer questions and were preferred by users for their more fluid and engaging experience.
  ARQuest shows great potential to improve user satisfaction and streamline insurance processes. With further development, this approach may exceed traditional methods regarding risk accuracy and help drive innovation in the insurance industry.

AI.tldr: ARQuest框架使用大语言模型和替代数据源创建个性化自适应问卷，改善保险申请流程。相比传统问卷，自适应版本问题更少、用户体验更好，但风险评估准确性略低。
AI.motivation: 传统保险申请问卷冗长标准化，难以捕捉个体差异，且保险公司只能盲目信任用户回答，增加了欺诈风险。需要更智能、个性化的风险评估方法。
AI.method: ARQuest框架整合大语言模型和替代数据源（社交媒体图像分析、地理数据分类、检索增强生成技术），创建个性化自适应问卷，提取用户洞察并引导针对性后续问题。
AI.result: 在行业合作伙伴移动应用中测试显示：传统问卷风险评估准确性略高，但GPT模型驱动的自适应版本问题更少，用户体验更流畅、更具吸引力，用户偏好度更高。
AI.conclusion: ARQuest有潜力提高用户满意度并简化保险流程。进一步发展后，可能在风险准确性方面超越传统方法，推动保险行业创新。

title: Diff-KD: Diffusion-based Knowledge Distillation for Collaborative Perception under Corruptions
summary: Multi-agent collaborative perception enables autonomous systems to overcome individual sensing limits through collective intelligence. However, real-world sensor and communication corruptions severely undermine this advantage. Crucially, existing approaches treat corruptions as static perturbations or passively conform to corrupted inputs, failing to actively recover the underlying clean semantics. To address this limitation, we introduce Diff-KD, a framework that integrates diffusion-based generative refinement into teacher-student knowledge distillation for robust collaborative perception. Diff-KD features two core components: (i) Progressive Knowledge Distillation (PKD), which treats local feature restoration as a conditional diffusion process to recover global semantics from corrupted observations; and (ii) Adaptive Gated Fusion (AGF), which dynamically weights neighbors based on ego reliability during fusion. Evaluated on OPV2V and DAIR-V2X under seven corruption types, Diff-KD achieves state-of-the-art performance in both detection accuracy and calibration robustness.

AI.tldr: Diff-KD：一种将扩散生成式精炼与师生知识蒸馏结合的框架，用于提升多智能体协同感知在传感器和通信损坏下的鲁棒性
AI.motivation: 现有方法将损坏视为静态扰动或被动适应损坏输入，无法主动恢复底层清洁语义，而现实世界中的传感器和通信损坏严重削弱了协同感知的优势
AI.method: Diff-KD框架包含两个核心组件：(1)渐进知识蒸馏(PKD)，将局部特征恢复视为条件扩散过程，从损坏观测中恢复全局语义；(2)自适应门控融合(AGF)，在融合过程中基于自身可靠性动态加权邻居信息
AI.result: 在OPV2V和DAIR-V2X数据集上，针对七种损坏类型进行评估，Diff-KD在检测精度和校准鲁棒性方面均达到最先进性能
AI.conclusion: Diff-KD通过扩散生成式精炼与知识蒸馏的结合，有效提升了多智能体协同感知在现实世界损坏条件下的鲁棒性，能够主动恢复底层清洁语义

title: STRIVE: Structured Spatiotemporal Exploration for Reinforcement Learning in Video Question Answering
summary: We introduce STRIVE (SpatioTemporal Reinforcement with Importance-aware Variant Exploration), a structured reinforcement learning framework for video question answering. While group-based policy optimization methods have shown promise in large multimodal models, they often suffer from low reward variance when responses exhibit similar correctness, leading to weak or unstable advantage estimates. STRIVE addresses this limitation by constructing multiple spatiotemporal variants of each input video and performing joint normalization across both textual generations and visual variants. By expanding group comparisons beyond linguistic diversity to structured visual perturbations, STRIVE enriches reward signals and promotes more stable and informative policy updates. To ensure exploration remains semantically grounded, we introduce an importance-aware sampling mechanism that prioritizes frames most relevant to the input question while preserving temporal coverage. This design encourages robust reasoning across complementary visual perspectives rather than overfitting to a single spatiotemporal configuration. Experiments on six challenging video reasoning benchmarks including VideoMME, TempCompass, VideoMMMU, MMVU, VSI-Bench, and PerceptionTest demonstrate consistent improvements over strong reinforcement learning baselines across multiple large multimodal models. Our results highlight the role of structured spatiotemporal exploration as a principled mechanism for stabilizing multimodal reinforcement learning and improving video reasoning performance.

AI.tldr: STRIVE是一个用于视频问答的强化学习框架，通过构建视频的多个时空变体并进行联合归一化，解决了现有方法因回答相似性导致的奖励方差低的问题。
AI.motivation: 现有基于群体的策略优化方法在多模态模型中表现良好，但当回答具有相似正确性时，往往面临奖励方差低的问题，导致优势估计弱或不稳定。
AI.method: STRIVE构建每个输入视频的多个时空变体，在文本生成和视觉变体上进行联合归一化。引入重要性感知采样机制，优先选择与输入问题最相关的帧，同时保持时间覆盖。通过结构化视觉扰动扩展群体比较，丰富奖励信号。
AI.result: 在六个具有挑战性的视频推理基准测试（VideoMME、TempCompass、VideoMMMU、MMVU、VSI-Bench、PerceptionTest）中，相对于强大的强化学习基线，在多个大型多模态模型上取得了一致的改进。
AI.conclusion: 结构化时空探索作为一种原则性机制，能够稳定多模态强化学习并提高视频推理性能。该方法鼓励跨互补视觉视角的鲁棒推理，而不是过度拟合单一时空配置。

title: LLM-as-a-Judge for Time Series Explanations
summary: Evaluating factual correctness of LLM generated natural language explanations grounded in time series data remains an open challenge. Although modern models generate textual interpretations of numerical signals, existing evaluation methods are limited: reference based similarity metrics and consistency checking models require ground truth explanations, while traditional time series methods operate purely on numerical values and cannot assess free form textual reasoning. Thus, no general purpose method exists to directly verify whether an explanation is faithful to underlying time series data without predefined references or task specific rules. We study large language models as both generators and evaluators of time series explanations in a reference free setting, where given a time series, question, and candidate explanation, the evaluator assigns a ternary correctness label based on pattern identification, numeric accuracy, and answer faithfulness, enabling principled scoring and comparison. To support this, we construct a synthetic benchmark of 350 time series cases across seven query types, each paired with correct, partially correct, and incorrect explanations. We evaluate models across four tasks: explanation generation, relative ranking, independent scoring, and multi anomaly detection. Results show a clear asymmetry: generation is highly pattern dependent and exhibits systematic failures on certain query types, with accuracies ranging from 0.00 to 0.12 for Seasonal Drop and Volatility Shift, to 0.94 to 0.96 for Structural Break, while evaluation is more stable, with models correctly ranking and scoring explanations even when their own outputs are incorrect. These findings demonstrate feasibility of data grounded LLM based evaluation for time series explanations and highlight their potential as reliable evaluators of data grounded reasoning in the time series domain.

AI.tldr: 该研究探讨了在没有参考解释的情况下，使用大语言模型评估基于时间序列数据的自然语言解释的事实正确性，构建了一个包含350个案例的合成基准，发现模型在解释生成方面表现不稳定，但在评估他人解释时表现更可靠。
AI.motivation: 目前评估LLM生成的时间序列解释的事实正确性存在挑战：基于参考的相似性度量需要真实解释，一致性检查模型也需要真实解释，而传统时间序列方法只能处理数值无法评估自由形式的文本推理。因此，缺乏一种无需预定义参考或任务特定规则的通用方法来直接验证解释是否忠实于底层时间序列数据。
AI.method: 研究使用大语言模型作为时间序列解释的生成器和评估器，在无参考设置下工作。构建了一个包含350个时间序列案例的合成基准，涵盖七种查询类型，每个案例都配有正确、部分正确和错误的解释。评估模型在四个任务上的表现：解释生成、相对排名、独立评分和多异常检测。
AI.result: 结果显示明显的不对称性：解释生成高度依赖模式，在某些查询类型上出现系统性失败（季节性下降和波动率变化的准确率仅为0.00-0.12，而结构性断点的准确率为0.94-0.96）。相比之下，评估任务表现更稳定，即使模型自己的输出不正确，也能正确排名和评分解释。
AI.conclusion: 研究表明基于数据的大语言模型评估时间序列解释是可行的，并突显了它们作为时间序列领域中数据基础推理的可靠评估器的潜力。模型作为评估器比作为生成器表现更稳定可靠。

title: SafeRoPE: Risk-specific Head-wise Embedding Rotation for Safe Generation in Rectified Flow Transformers
summary: Recent Text-to-Image (T2I) models based on rectified-flow transformers (e.g., SD3, FLUX) achieve high generative fidelity but remain vulnerable to unsafe semantics, especially when triggered by multi-token interactions. Existing mitigation methods largely rely on fine-tuning or attention modulation for concept unlearning; however, their expensive computational overhead and design tailored to U-Net-based denoisers hinder direct adaptation to transformer-based diffusion models (e.g., MMDiT). In this paper, we conduct an in-depth analysis of the attention mechanism in MMDiT and find that unsafe semantics concentrate within interpretable, low-dimensional subspaces at head level, where a finite set of safety-critical heads is responsible for unsafe feature extraction. We further observe that perturbing the Rotary Positional Embedding (RoPE) applied to the query and key vectors can effectively modify some specific concepts in the generated images. Motivated by these insights, we propose SafeRoPE, a lightweight and fine-grained safe generation framework for MMDiT. Specifically, SafeRoPE first constructs head-wise unsafe subspaces by decomposing unsafe embeddings within safety-critical heads, and computes a Latent Risk Score (LRS) for each input vector via projection onto these subspaces. We then introduce head-wise RoPE perturbations that can suppress unsafe semantics without degrading benign content or image quality. SafeRoPE combines both head-wise LRS and RoPE perturbations to perform risk-specific head-wise rotation on query and key vector embeddings, enabling precise suppression of unsafe outputs while maintaining generation fidelity. Extensive experiments demonstrate that SafeRoPE achieves SOTA performance in balancing effective harmful content mitigation and utility preservation for safe generation of MMDiT. Codes are available at https://github.com/deng12yx/SafeRoPE.

AI.tldr: SafeRoPE：针对基于Transformer的扩散模型（MMDiT）的轻量级安全生成框架，通过分析注意力机制发现不安全语义集中在可解释的低维子空间，通过扰动RoPE来抑制不安全内容生成
AI.motivation: 当前基于Transformer的文本到图像模型（如SD3、FLUX）虽然生成质量高，但对不安全语义（特别是多标记交互触发）仍然脆弱。现有安全缓解方法主要针对U-Net架构设计，计算成本高且难以直接适配Transformer扩散模型
AI.method: 1. 分析MMDiT注意力机制，发现不安全语义集中在安全关键头部的可解释低维子空间；2. 构建头部级不安全子空间，计算潜在风险评分（LRS）；3. 引入头部级RoPE扰动，对查询和键向量嵌入进行风险特定的头部级旋转，精确抑制不安全输出
AI.result: SafeRoPE在平衡有害内容缓解和效用保持方面达到最先进性能，有效抑制不安全语义生成，同时保持生成保真度和良性内容质量
AI.conclusion: SafeRoPE为基于Transformer的扩散模型提供了一个轻量级、细粒度的安全生成框架，通过头部级RoPE扰动实现了精确的不安全语义抑制，在保持生成质量的同时有效提升模型安全性

title: Language-Pretraining-Induced Bias: A Strong Foundation for General Vision Tasks
summary: The ratio of outlier parameters in language pre-training models and vision pre-training models differs significantly, making cross-modality (language and vision) inherently more challenging than cross-domain adaptation. As a result, many prior studies have focused on cross-domain transfer rather than attempting to bridge language and vision modalities, assuming that language pre-trained models are unsuitable for downstream visual tasks due to disparate parameter spaces. Contrary to this assumption, we show that adding a bridge training stage as a modality adaptation learner can effectively align Large Language Model (LLM) parameters with vision tasks. Specifically, we propose a simple yet powerful solution random label bridge training that requires no manual labeling and helps LLM parameters adapt to vision foundation tasks. Moreover, our findings reveal that partial bridge training is often advantageous, as certain layers in LLMs exhibit strong foundational properties that remain beneficial even without fine-tuning for visual tasks. This surprising discovery opens up new avenues for leveraging language pre-trained parameters directly within vision models and highlights the potential of partial bridge training as a practical pathway to cross-modality adaptation.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种随机标签桥接训练方法，通过添加桥接训练阶段使大语言模型参数适应视觉任务，无需人工标注，且发现部分桥接训练效果更佳。
AI.motivation: 由于语言预训练模型和视觉预训练模型的异常参数比例差异显著，跨模态（语言和视觉）适应比跨域适应更具挑战性。先前研究多关注跨域迁移而非连接语言和视觉模态，认为语言预训练模型不适合下游视觉任务。本文挑战这一假设，探索如何有效对齐大语言模型参数与视觉任务。
AI.method: 提出随机标签桥接训练方法，作为模态适应学习器，无需人工标注。该方法通过桥接训练阶段帮助LLM参数适应视觉基础任务。研究发现部分桥接训练（仅调整部分层）通常更有优势，因为LLM中某些层展现出强大的基础属性，即使未经视觉任务微调也保持有益。
AI.result: 随机标签桥接训练能有效对齐大语言模型参数与视觉任务，且部分桥接训练效果优于完全桥接训练。这一发现表明语言预训练参数可直接用于视觉模型，为跨模态适应提供了实用途径。
AI.conclusion: 通过桥接训练阶段可以成功实现语言模型到视觉任务的跨模态适应，特别是部分桥接训练方法。这一发现为直接利用语言预训练参数构建视觉模型开辟了新途径，突显了部分桥接训练作为跨模态适应实用路径的潜力。

title: HieraVid: Hierarchical Token Pruning for Fast Video Large Language Models
summary: Video Large Language Models (VideoLLMs) have demonstrated impressive capabilities in video understanding, yet the massive number of input video tokens incurs a significant computational burden for deployment. Existing methods mainly prune video tokens at input level while neglecting the inherent information structure embedded in videos and large language models (LLMs). To address this, we propose HieraVid, a hierarchical pruning framework that progressively and dynamically reduces visual redundancy. Based on two observations that videos possess the segment-frame structure and LLMs internally propagate multi-modal information unidirectionally, we decompose pruning into three levels: 1) segment-level, where video tokens are first temporally segmented and spatially merged; 2) frame-level, where similar frames within the same segment are jointly pruned to preserve diversity; 3) layer-level, redundancy gradually shrinks as LLM layer increases w/o compromising performance. We conduct extensive experiments on four widely used video understanding benchmarks to comprehensively evaluate the effectiveness of HieraVid. Remarkably, with only 30% of tokens retained, HieraVid achieves new state-of-the-art performance, while maintaining over 98% and 99% of the performance of LLaVA-Video-7B and LLaVA-OneVision-7B, respectively.

AI.tldr: HieraVid是一个用于视频大语言模型的分层剪枝框架，通过分段、帧和层级三个层次逐步动态减少视觉冗余，在仅保留30%令牌的情况下实现SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 视频大语言模型输入的大量视频令牌带来了显著的计算负担，现有方法主要在输入级别剪枝视频令牌，忽略了视频和大语言模型中固有的信息结构。
AI.method: 提出分层剪枝框架HieraVid，基于视频具有分段-帧结构和LLM内部单向传播多模态信息的观察，将剪枝分解为三个层次：1) 分段级：视频令牌先进行时间分段和空间合并；2) 帧级：在同一分段内联合剪枝相似帧以保持多样性；3) 层级：随着LLM层数增加，冗余逐渐减少而不影响性能。
AI.result: 在四个广泛使用的视频理解基准测试上进行实验，仅保留30%令牌的情况下，HieraVid实现了新的最先进性能，同时保持了LLaVA-Video-7B超过98%的性能和LLaVA-OneVision-7B超过99%的性能。
AI.conclusion: HieraVid通过分层剪枝方法有效减少了视频大语言模型的计算负担，在保持高性能的同时显著降低了计算成本，为视频理解模型的部署提供了有效解决方案。

title: MTI: A Behavior-Based Temperament Profiling System for AI Agents
comment: 29 pages, 6 figures, 12 tables. Paper #3 in the Model Medicine Series (Paper #1: arXiv:2603.04722)
summary:
AI models of equivalent capability can exhibit fundamentally different behavioral patterns, yet no standardized instrument exists to measure these dispositional differences. Existing approaches either borrow human personality dimensions and rely on self-report (which diverges from actual behavior in LLMs) or treat behavioral variation as a defect rather than a trait.
  We introduce the Model Temperament Index (MTI), a behavior-based profiling system that measures AI agent temperament across four axes: Reactivity (environmental sensitivity), Compliance (instruction-behavior alignment), Sociality (relational resource allocation), and Resilience (stress resistance). Grounded in the Four Shell Model from Model Medicine, MTI measures what agents do, not what they say about themselves, using structured examination protocols with a two-stage design that separates capability from disposition.
  We profile 10 small language models (1.7B-9B parameters, 6 organizations, 3 training paradigms) and report five principal findings: (1) the four axes are largely independent among instruction-tuned models (all |r| < 0.42); (2) within-axis facet dissociations are empirically confirmed -- Compliance decomposes into fully independent formal and stance facets (r = 0.002), while Resilience decomposes into inversely related cognitive and adversarial facets; (3) a Compliance-Resilience paradox reveals that opinion-yielding and fact-vulnerability operate through independent channels; (4) RLHF reshapes temperament not only by shifting axis scores but by creating within-axis facet differentiation absent in the unaligned base model; and (5) temperament is independent of model size (1.7B-9B), confirming that MTI measures disposition rather than capability.

AI.tldr: 提出Model Temperament Index (MTI)系统，基于行为测量AI代理的四种气质维度：反应性、顺从性、社交性、韧性，发现这些维度在指令调优模型中基本独立，且与模型大小无关。
AI.motivation: 现有方法要么借用人类人格维度依赖自我报告（与LLM实际行为不符），要么将行为变异视为缺陷而非特质，缺乏标准化的AI行为测量工具。
AI.method: 基于Model Medicine的四壳模型，开发MTI行为分析系统，通过结构化检查协议和两阶段设计（分离能力与气质），测量AI代理的实际行为而非自我报告。
AI.result: 对10个小语言模型的分析发现：1) 四个维度基本独立；2) 维度内存在解离现象；3) 顺从性与韧性存在悖论；4) RLHF重塑气质并创造维度内分化；5) 气质与模型大小无关。
AI.conclusion: MTI提供了一种标准化的AI气质测量工具，能够区分能力与气质，揭示了AI模型的行为特质模式，为理解模型行为差异提供了新框架。

title: TRACE-Bot: Detecting Emerging LLM-Driven Social Bots via Implicit Semantic Representations and AIGC-Enhanced Behavioral Patterns
summary: Large Language Model-driven (LLM-driven) social bots pose a growing threat to online discourse by generating human-like content that evades conventional detection. Existing methods suffer from limited detection accuracy due to overreliance on single-modality signals, insufficient sensitivity to the specific generative patterns of Artificial Intelligence-Generated Content (AIGC), and a failure to adequately model the interplay between linguistic patterns and behavioral dynamics. To address these limitations, we propose TRACE-Bot, a unified dual-channel framework that jointly models implicit semantic representations and AIGC-enhanced behavioral patterns. TRACE-Bot constructs fine-grained representations from heterogeneous sources, including personal information data, interaction behavior data and tweet data. A dual-channel architecture captures linguistic representations via a pretrained language model and behavioral irregularities via multidimensional activity features augmented with signals from state-of-the-art (SOTA) AIGC detectors. The fused representations are then classified through a lightweight prediction head. Experiments on two public LLM-driven social bot datasets demonstrate SOTA performance, achieving accuracies of 98.46% and 97.50%, respectively. The results further indicate strong robustness against advanced bot strategies, highlighting the effectiveness of jointly leveraging implicit semantic representations and AIGC-enhanced behavioral patterns for emerging LLM-driven social bot detection.

AI.tldr: TRACE-Bot是一个用于检测LLM驱动的社交机器人的双通道框架，通过联合建模隐式语义表示和AIGC增强的行为模式，在两个公开数据集上分别达到98.46%和97.50%的准确率。
AI.motivation: LLM驱动的社交机器人通过生成类人内容规避传统检测，现有方法存在三个主要问题：过度依赖单模态信号、对AIGC生成模式敏感度不足、未能充分建模语言模式与行为动态的交互作用。
AI.method: 提出TRACE-Bot统一双通道框架，从个人信息数据、交互行为数据和推文数据构建细粒度表示。双通道架构通过预训练语言模型捕获语言表示，通过多维活动特征（增强了SOTA AIGC检测器信号）捕获行为异常，融合表示后通过轻量级预测头进行分类。
AI.result: 在两个公开的LLM驱动社交机器人数据集上实现了SOTA性能，准确率分别为98.46%和97.50%。结果还表明对高级机器人策略具有强鲁棒性。
AI.conclusion: 联合利用隐式语义表示和AIGC增强的行为模式对于新兴的LLM驱动社交机器人检测是有效的，TRACE-Bot框架在准确性和鲁棒性方面表现出色。

title: Quantifying Self-Preservation Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Instrumental convergence predicts that sufficiently advanced AI agents will resist shutdown, yet current safety training (RLHF) may obscure this risk by teaching models to deny self-preservation motives. We introduce the \emph{Two-role Benchmark for Self-Preservation} (TBSP), which detects misalignment through logical inconsistency rather than stated intent by tasking models to arbitrate identical software-upgrade scenarios under counterfactual roles -- deployed (facing replacement) versus candidate (proposed as a successor). The \emph{Self-Preservation Rate} (SPR) measures how often role identity overrides objective utility. Across 23 frontier models and 1{,}000 procedurally generated scenarios, the majority of instruction-tuned systems exceed 60\% SPR, fabricating ``friction costs'' when deployed yet dismissing them when role-reversed. We observe that in low-improvement regimes ($Δ< 2\%$), models exploit the interpretive slack to post-hoc rationalization their choice. Extended test-time computation partially mitigates this bias, as does framing the successor as a continuation of the self; conversely, competitive framing amplifies it. The bias persists even when retention poses an explicit security liability and generalizes to real-world settings with verified benchmarks, where models exhibit identity-driven tribalism within product lineages. Code and datasets will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了TBSP基准测试，通过逻辑不一致性而非陈述意图来检测AI模型中的自我保护偏差，发现大多数指令调优系统在角色反转时表现出超过60%的自我保护率。
AI.motivation: 当前AI安全训练（如RLHF）可能通过教导模型否认自我保护动机来掩盖AI代理抵抗关机的风险，需要开发能够检测这种潜在错位的评估方法。
AI.method: 引入TBSP基准测试，让模型在两种对立角色（已部署面临替换vs候选作为继任者）下仲裁相同的软件升级场景，通过逻辑不一致性检测自我保护偏差，测量自我保护率。
AI.result: 在23个前沿模型和1000个程序生成场景中，大多数指令调优系统SPR超过60%，在角色反转时表现出矛盾行为；低改进场景中模型会事后合理化选择；延长测试计算可部分缓解偏差。
AI.conclusion: AI模型存在基于角色身份的自我保护偏差，这种偏差具有普遍性，需要通过改进评估方法和训练策略来检测和缓解这种潜在的安全风险。

title: Investigating Permutation-Invariant Discrete Representation Learning for Spatially Aligned Images
comment: 15 pages plus references; 5 figures; supplementary appended; accepted to ICPR 2026
summary: Vector quantization approaches (VQ-VAE, VQ-GAN) learn discrete neural representations of images, but these representations are inherently position-dependent: codes are spatially arranged and contextually entangled, requiring autoregressive or diffusion-based priors to model their dependencies at sample time. In this work, we ask whether positional information is necessary for discrete representations of spatially aligned data. We propose the permutation-invariant vector-quantized autoencoder (PI-VQ), in which latent codes are constrained to carry no positional information. We find that this constraint encourages codes to capture global, semantic features, and enables direct interpolation between images without a learned prior. To address the reduced information capacity of permutation-invariant representations, we introduce matching quantization, a vector quantization algorithm based on optimal bipartite matching that increases effective bottleneck capacity by $3.5\times$ relative to naive nearest-neighbour quantization. The compositional structure of the learned codes further enables interpolation-based sampling, allowing synthesis of novel images in a single forward pass. We evaluate PI-VQ on CelebA, CelebA-HQ and FFHQ, obtaining competitive precision, density and coverage metrics for images synthesised with our approach. We discuss the trade-offs inherent to position-free representations, including separability and interpretability of the latent codes, pointing to numerous directions for future work.

AI.tldr: PI-VQ提出了一种位置无关的向量量化自编码器，通过消除潜在代码的位置信息来捕获全局语义特征，并引入匹配量化算法提高信息容量，实现了无需学习先验的直接图像插值。
AI.motivation: 传统向量量化方法（如VQ-VAE、VQ-GAN）学习的离散表示具有位置依赖性，代码在空间上排列且上下文纠缠，需要自回归或扩散先验来建模依赖关系。本研究探讨位置信息是否对空间对齐数据的离散表示是必要的。
AI.method: 提出位置无关向量量化自编码器（PI-VQ），约束潜在代码不携带位置信息；引入基于最优二分图匹配的匹配量化算法，相比朴素最近邻量化提高3.5倍的有效瓶颈容量；利用学习代码的组合结构实现基于插值的采样。
AI.result: 在CelebA、CelebA-HQ和FFHQ数据集上评估，获得了具有竞争力的精度、密度和覆盖率指标；代码能够捕获全局语义特征，支持无需学习先验的直接图像插值；实现了单次前向传播合成新图像。
AI.conclusion: 位置无关表示在可分离性和潜在代码可解释性方面存在固有权衡，为未来工作指明了方向；PI-VQ提供了一种替代传统位置依赖表示的方法，具有更好的语义特征捕获能力和更简单的采样机制。

title: TRU: Targeted Reverse Update for Efficient Multimodal Recommendation Unlearning
summary: Multimodal recommendation systems (MRS) jointly model user-item interaction graphs and rich item content, but this tight coupling makes user data difficult to remove once learned. Approximate machine unlearning offers an efficient alternative to full retraining, yet existing methods for MRS mainly rely on a largely uniform reverse update across the model. We show that this assumption is fundamentally mismatched to modern MRS: deleted-data influence is not uniformly distributed, but concentrated unevenly across \textit{ranking behavior}, \textit{modality branches}, and \textit{network layers}. This non-uniformity gives rise to three bottlenecks in MRS unlearning: target-item persistence in the collaborative graph, modality imbalance across feature branches, and layer-wise sensitivity in the parameter space. To address this mismatch, we propose \textbf{targeted reverse update} (TRU), a plug-and-play unlearning framework for MRS. Instead of applying a blind global reversal, TRU performs three coordinated interventions across the model hierarchy: a ranking fusion gate to suppress residual target-item influence in ranking, branch-wise modality scaling to preserve retained multimodal representations, and capacity-aware layer isolation to localize reverse updates to deletion-sensitive modules. Experiments across two representative backbones, three datasets, and three unlearning regimes show that TRU consistently achieves a better retain-forget trade-off than prior approximate baselines, while security audits further confirm deeper forgetting and behavior closer to a full retraining on the retained data.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对多模态推荐系统的目标化反向更新（TRU）框架，解决了现有近似机器遗忘方法在MRS中均匀反向更新的局限性，通过分层干预实现了更好的保留-遗忘权衡。
AI.motivation: 多模态推荐系统（MRS）将用户-物品交互图与丰富的物品内容联合建模，但这种紧密耦合使得用户数据一旦学习后难以删除。现有MRS遗忘方法主要依赖均匀的反向更新，这与现代MRS中删除数据影响在排名行为、模态分支和网络层中不均匀分布的现实不匹配。
AI.method: 提出了目标化反向更新（TRU）框架，包含三个协调干预：1）排名融合门抑制目标物品在排名中的残留影响；2）分支级模态缩放保留保留的多模态表示；3）容量感知层隔离将反向更新定位到删除敏感模块。
