AI.result: 在两个代表性骨干网络、三个数据集和三种遗忘机制上的实验表明，TRU相比现有近似基线方法，在保留-遗忘权衡方面表现更优，安全审计进一步确认了更深的遗忘效果和更接近完整重训练的行为。
AI.conclusion: TRU框架通过识别和解决MRS遗忘中的三个瓶颈（目标物品在协作图中的持久性、特征分支间的模态不平衡、参数空间中的层敏感性），实现了更有效的多模态推荐系统机器遗忘。

title: FaCT-GS: Fast and Scalable CT Reconstruction with Gaussian Splatting
summary: Gaussian Splatting (GS) has emerged as a dominating technique for image rendering and has quickly been adapted for the X-ray Computed Tomography (CT) reconstruction task. However, despite being on par or better than many of its predecessors, the benefits of GS are typically not substantial enough to motivate a transition from well-established reconstruction algorithms. This paper addresses the most significant remaining limitations of the GS-based approach by introducing FaCT-GS, a framework for fast and flexible CT reconstruction. Enabled by an in-depth optimization of the voxelization and rasterization pipelines, our new method is significantly faster than its predecessors and scales well with projection and output volume size. Furthermore, the improved voxelization enables rapid fitting of Gaussians to pre-existing volumes, which can serve as a prior for warm-starting the reconstruction, or simply as an alternative, compressed representation. FaCT-GS is over 4X faster than the State of the Art GS CT reconstruction on standard 512x512 projections, and over 13X faster on 2k projections. Implementation available at: https://github.com/PaPieta/fact-gs.

AI.tldr: FaCT-GS是一种基于高斯泼溅的快速灵活CT重建框架，通过优化体素化和光栅化流程，在速度和可扩展性上显著超越现有方法，支持从现有体积快速拟合高斯作为先验。
AI.motivation: 虽然高斯泼溅技术在CT重建中表现出色，但其优势尚不足以推动从成熟算法过渡。现有GS方法仍存在显著限制，需要更快速、灵活的重建方案。
AI.method: 提出FaCT-GS框架，通过深度优化体素化和光栅化流程，实现快速CT重建。改进的体素化支持从现有体积快速拟合高斯，可作为先验或压缩表示。
AI.result: 在标准512x512投影上比现有最佳GS CT重建快4倍以上，在2k投影上快13倍以上。具有良好的投影和输出体积尺寸可扩展性。
AI.conclusion: FaCT-GS解决了GS方法在CT重建中的主要限制，提供了快速灵活的重建方案，支持从现有体积快速拟合高斯作为先验，显著提升了重建效率。

title: VISTA: Visualization of Token Attribution via Efficient Analysis
summary: Understanding how Large Language Models (LLMs) process information from prompts remains a significant challenge. To shed light on this "black box," attention visualization techniques have been developed to capture neuron-level perceptions and interpret how models focus on different parts of input data. However, many existing techniques are tailored to specific model architectures, particularly within the Transformer family, and often require backpropagation, resulting in nearly double the GPU memory usage and increased computational cost. A lightweight, model-agnostic approach for attention visualization remains lacking. In this paper, we introduce a model-agnostic token importance visualization technique to better understand how generative AI systems perceive and prioritize information from input text, without incurring additional computational cost. Our method leverages perturbation-based strategies combined with a three-matrix analytical framework to generate relevance maps that illustrate token-level contributions to model predictions. The framework comprises: (1) the Angular Deviation Matrix, which captures shifts in semantic direction; (2) the Magnitude Deviation Matrix, which measures changes in semantic intensity; and (3) the Dimensional Importance Matrix, which evaluates contributions across individual vector dimensions. By systematically removing each token and measuring the resulting impact across these three complementary dimensions, we derive a composite importance score that provides a nuanced and mathematically grounded measure of token significance. To support reproducibility and foster wider adoption, we provide open-source implementations of all proposed and utilized explainability techniques, with code and resources publicly available at https://github.com/Infosys/Infosys-Responsible-AI-Toolkit

AI.tldr: 提出了一种模型无关的token重要性可视化技术，通过扰动策略和三矩阵分析框架生成相关性图，无需额外计算成本
AI.motivation: 现有注意力可视化技术通常针对特定Transformer架构，需要反向传播导致GPU内存使用翻倍和计算成本增加，缺乏轻量级、模型无关的方法
AI.method: 基于扰动策略结合三矩阵分析框架：角度偏差矩阵捕捉语义方向变化，幅度偏差矩阵测量语义强度变化，维度重要性矩阵评估各向量维度贡献，通过系统移除token并测量影响得到复合重要性分数
AI.result: 开发了开源实现，代码和资源已在GitHub公开，支持可重复性和广泛采用
AI.conclusion: 提出了一种无需额外计算成本的模型无关token重要性可视化技术，通过三矩阵分析框架提供数学基础扎实的token重要性度量，有助于理解生成式AI系统如何处理输入信息

title: From High-Dimensional Spaces to Verifiable ODD Coverage for Safety-Critical AI-based Systems
summary: While Artificial Intelligence (AI) offers transformative potential for operational performance, its deployment in safety-critical domains such as aviation requires strict adherence to rigorous certification standards. Current EASA guidelines mandate demonstrating complete coverage of the AI/ML constituent's Operational Design Domain (ODD) -- a requirement that demands proof that no critical gaps exist within defined operational boundaries. However, as systems operate within high-dimensional parameter spaces, existing methods struggle to provide the scalability and formal grounding necessary to satisfy the completeness criterion. Currently, no standardized engineering method exists to bridge the gap between abstract ODD definitions and verifiable evidence. This paper addresses this void by proposing a method that integrates parameter discretization, constraint-based filtering, and criticality-based dimension reduction into a structured, multi-step ODD coverage verification process. Grounded in gathered simulation data from prior research on AI-based mid-air collision avoidance research, this work demonstrates a systematic engineering approach to defining and achieving coverage metrics that satisfy EASA's demand for completeness. Ultimately, this method enables the validation of ODD coverage in higher dimensions, advancing a Safety-by-Design approach while complying with EASA's standards.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种用于验证AI系统在安全关键领域（如航空）中操作设计域（ODD）完整覆盖的方法，以满足EASA认证标准
AI.motivation: 当前AI系统在航空等安全关键领域部署时，需要满足EASA对操作设计域（ODD）完整覆盖的严格要求，但现有方法缺乏可扩展性和形式化基础，无法证明高维参数空间中不存在关键缺口
AI.method: 提出了一种结构化多步骤ODD覆盖验证方法，整合参数离散化、基于约束的过滤和基于关键性的维度约简技术
AI.result: 基于先前AI空中防撞研究的仿真数据，该方法展示了如何系统化地定义和实现满足EASA完整性要求的覆盖度量
AI.conclusion: 该方法能够在更高维度上验证ODD覆盖，推进"安全设计"方法，同时符合EASA标准，填补了抽象ODD定义与可验证证据之间的工程方法空白

title: Semantic Richness or Geometric Reasoning? The Fragility of VLM's Visual Invariance
summary: This work investigates the fundamental fragility of state-of-the-art Vision-Language Models (VLMs) under basic geometric transformations. While modern VLMs excel at semantic tasks such as recognizing objects in canonical orientations and describing complex scenes, they exhibit systematic failures at a more fundamental level: lack of robust spatial invariance and equivariance required to reliably determine object identity under simple rotations, scaling, and identity transformations. We demonstrate this limitation through a systematic evaluation across diverse visual domains, including symbolic sketches, natural photographs, and abstract art. Performance drops sharply as semantic content becomes sparse, and this behavior is observed across architectures, model capacities, and prompting strategies. Overall, our results reveal a systematic gap between semantic understanding and spatial reasoning in current VLMs, highlighting the need for stronger geometric grounding in future multimodal systems.

AI.tldr: 研究发现当前最先进的视觉语言模型在基本几何变换下存在系统性脆弱性，缺乏可靠的空间不变性和等变性，导致在简单旋转、缩放和恒等变换下物体识别性能大幅下降。
AI.motivation: 尽管现代视觉语言模型在语义任务上表现出色，但本研究旨在揭示它们在更基础层面上的系统性缺陷：缺乏对基本几何变换的鲁棒性，这暴露了语义理解与空间推理之间的差距。
AI.method: 通过系统评估方法，在不同视觉领域（符号草图、自然照片、抽象艺术）测试VLMs对几何变换（旋转、缩放、恒等变换）的鲁棒性，涵盖不同架构、模型容量和提示策略。
AI.result: 性能随着语义内容稀疏而急剧下降，这种脆弱性在不同架构、模型容量和提示策略中普遍存在，表明当前VLMs缺乏可靠的空间不变性和等变性。
AI.conclusion: 当前视觉语言模型在语义理解与空间推理之间存在系统性差距，凸显了未来多模态系统需要更强的几何基础来提升对基本几何变换的鲁棒性。

title: De Jure: Iterative LLM Self-Refinement for Structured Extraction of Regulatory Rules
summary: Regulatory documents encode legally binding obligations that LLM-based systems must respect. Yet converting dense, hierarchically structured legal text into machine-readable rules remains a costly, expert-intensive process. We present De Jure, a fully automated, domain-agnostic pipeline for extracting structured regulatory rules from raw documents, requiring no human annotation, domain-specific prompting, or annotated gold data. De Jure operates through four sequential stages: normalization of source documents into structured Markdown; LLM-driven semantic decomposition into structured rule units; multi-criteria LLM-as-a-judge evaluation across 19 dimensions spanning metadata, definitions, and rule semantics; and iterative repair of low-scoring extractions within a bounded regeneration budget, where upstream components are repaired before rule units are evaluated. We evaluate De Jure across four models on three regulatory corpora spanning finance, healthcare, and AI governance. On the finance domain, De Jure yields consistent and monotonic improvement in extraction quality, reaching peak performance within three judge-guided iterations. De Jure generalizes effectively to healthcare and AI governance, maintaining high performance across both open- and closed-source models. In a downstream compliance question-answering evaluation via RAG, responses grounded in De Jure extracted rules are preferred over prior work in 73.8% of cases at single-rule retrieval depth, rising to 84.0% under broader retrieval, confirming that extraction fidelity translates directly into downstream utility. These results demonstrate that explicit, interpretable evaluation criteria can substitute for human annotation in complex regulatory domains, offering a scalable and auditable path toward regulation-grounded LLM alignment.

AI.tldr: De Jure是一个全自动、领域无关的管道，用于从原始监管文档中提取结构化规则，无需人工标注或领域特定提示，通过四阶段流程实现高质量规则提取。
AI.motivation: 监管文档包含LLM系统必须遵守的法律义务，但将密集、层次化的法律文本转换为机器可读规则仍然是一个昂贵且需要专家参与的过程，需要自动化解决方案来降低成本和提高可扩展性。
AI.method: De Jure采用四阶段管道：1) 将源文档标准化为结构化Markdown；2) LLM驱动的语义分解为结构化规则单元；3) 多标准LLM-as-a-judge评估（19个维度）；4) 在有限再生预算内迭代修复低质量提取，优先修复上游组件。
AI.result: 在金融、医疗和AI治理三个监管领域评估显示：金融领域提取质量持续单调提升，三次迭代达到峰值性能；在医疗和AI治理领域保持高性能；下游合规问答评估中，基于De Jure提取规则的响应在73.8%-84.0%情况下优于先前工作。
AI.conclusion: 明确的、可解释的评估标准可以替代复杂监管领域的人工标注，为基于监管的LLM对齐提供了可扩展且可审计的路径，提取保真度直接转化为下游实用性。

title: Combining Boundary Supervision and Segment-Level Regularization for Fine-Grained Action Segmentation
comment: Accepted by CVPR2026 Workshop "AI-driven Skilled Activity Understanding, Assessment & Feedback Generation (SAUAFG)"
summary: Recent progress in Temporal Action Segmentation (TAS) has increasingly relied on complex architectures, which can hinder practical deployment. We present a lightweight dual-loss training framework that improves fine-grained segmentation quality with only one additional output channel and two auxiliary loss terms, requiring minimal architectural modification. Our approach combines a boundary-regression loss that promotes accurate temporal localization via a single-channel boundary prediction and a CDF-based segment-level regularization loss that encourages coherent within-segment structure by matching cumulative distributions over predicted and ground-truth segments. The framework is architecture-agnostic and can be integrated into existing TAS models (e.g., MS-TCN, C2F-TCN, FACT) as a training-time loss function. Across three benchmark datasets, the proposed method improves segment-level consistency and boundary quality, yielding higher F1 and Edit scores across three different models. Frame-wise accuracy remains largely unchanged, highlighting that precise segmentation can be achieved through simple loss design rather than heavier architectures or inference-time refinements.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级双损失训练框架，仅需一个额外输出通道和两个辅助损失项，即可提升时序动作分割的细粒度分割质量，无需复杂架构修改。
AI.motivation: 当前时序动作分割方法过度依赖复杂架构，不利于实际部署。需要一种轻量级方法在不显著增加模型复杂度的情况下提升分割质量。
AI.method: 提出双损失训练框架：1) 边界回归损失通过单通道边界预测提升时间定位精度；2) 基于CDF的片段级正则化损失通过匹配预测片段和真实片段的累积分布来鼓励片段内结构一致性。该框架与架构无关，可作为训练时损失函数集成到现有TAS模型中。
AI.result: 在三个基准数据集上，该方法提高了片段级一致性和边界质量，在三种不同模型上均获得更高的F1和Edit分数。帧级精度基本保持不变，表明通过简单损失设计而非复杂架构或推理时优化即可实现精确分割。
AI.conclusion: 通过轻量级双损失训练框架，仅需最小架构修改即可显著提升时序动作分割质量，为实际部署提供了高效解决方案。

title: MAR-MAER: Metric-Aware and Ambiguity-Adaptive Autoregressive Image Generation
summary: Autoregressive (AR) models have demonstrated significant success in the realm of text-to-image generation. However, they usually face two major challenges. Firstly, the generated images may not always meet the quality standards expected by humans. Furthermore, these models face difficulty when dealing with ambiguous prompts that could be interpreted in several valid ways. To address these issues, we introduce MAR-MAER, an innovative hierarchical autoregressive framework. It combines two main components. It is a metric-aware embedding regularization method. The other one is a probabilistic latent model used for handling ambiguous semantics. Our method utilizes a lightweight projection head, which is trained with an adaptive kernel regression loss function. This aligns the model's internal representations with human-preferred quality metrics, such as CLIPScore and HPSv2. As a result, the embedding space that is learned more accurately reflects human judgment. We are also introducing a conditional variational module. This approach incorporates an aspect of controlled randomness within the hierarchical token generation process. This capability allows the model to produce a diverse array of coherent images based on ambiguous or open-ended prompts. We conducted extensive experiments using COCO and a newly developed Ambiguous-Prompt Benchmark. The results show that MAR-MAER achieves excellent performance in both metric consistency and semantic flexibility. It exceeds the baseline Hi-MAR model's performance, showing an improvement of +1.6 in CLIPScore and +5.3 in HPSv2. For unclear inputs, it produces a notably wider range of outputs. These findings have been confirmed through both human evaluation and automated metrics.

AI.tldr: MAR-MAER是一个创新的分层自回归框架，通过度量感知嵌入正则化和概率潜在模型，解决了文本到图像生成中的图像质量不足和模糊提示处理问题。
AI.motivation: 自回归模型在文本到图像生成中面临两大挑战：生成的图像质量可能不符合人类期望，以及难以处理具有多种有效解释的模糊提示。
AI.method: 提出MAR-MAER分层自回归框架，包含度量感知嵌入正则化（使用轻量级投影头和自适应核回归损失函数）和条件变分模块（用于处理模糊语义的概率潜在模型）。
AI.result: 在COCO和新开发的Ambiguous-Prompt Benchmark上实验，MAR-MAER在度量一致性和语义灵活性方面表现优异，相比基线Hi-MAR模型，CLIPScore提升+1.6，HPSv2提升+5.3，对模糊输入能产生更广泛的输出多样性。
AI.conclusion: MAR-MAER通过结合度量对齐和概率建模，显著提升了文本到图像生成的质量和多样性，特别是在处理模糊提示时表现出色。

title: When to ASK: Uncertainty-Gated Language Assistance for Reinforcement Learning
comment: In Proceedings of International Joint Conference on Neural Networks (IJCNN)
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) agents often struggle with out-of-distribution (OOD) scenarios, leading to high uncertainty and random behavior. While language models (LMs) contain valuable world knowledge, larger ones incur high computational costs, hindering real-time use, and exhibit limitations in autonomous planning. We introduce Adaptive Safety through Knowledge (ASK), which combines smaller LMs with trained RL policies to enhance OOD generalization without retraining. ASK employs Monte Carlo Dropout to assess uncertainty and queries the LM for action suggestions only when uncertainty exceeds a set threshold. This selective use preserves the efficiency of existing policies while leveraging the language model's reasoning in uncertain situations. In experiments on the FrozenLake environment, ASK shows no improvement in-domain, but demonstrates robust navigation in transfer tasks, achieving a reward of 0.95. Our findings indicate that effective neuro-symbolic integration requires careful orchestration rather than simple combination, highlighting the need for sufficient model scale and effective hybridization mechanisms for successful OOD generalization.

AI.tldr: ASK框架结合小型语言模型与强化学习策略，通过选择性查询语言模型来增强OOD泛化能力，无需重新训练
AI.motivation: 强化学习代理在分布外场景中表现不佳，而大型语言模型计算成本高且自主规划能力有限，需要一种高效结合两者的方法
AI.method: 使用蒙特卡洛Dropout评估不确定性，仅在不确定性超过阈值时查询语言模型获取行动建议，保持现有策略效率的同时利用语言模型推理
AI.result: 在FrozenLake环境中，域内无改进，但在迁移任务中实现鲁棒导航，获得0.95的奖励
AI.conclusion: 有效的神经符号集成需要精心编排而非简单组合，需要足够的模型规模和有效的混合机制来实现成功的OOD泛化

title: GeoAI Agency Primitives
summary: We present ongoing research on agency primitives for GeoAI assistants -- core capabilities that connect Foundation models to the artifact-centric, human-in-the-loop workflows where GIS practitioners actually work. Despite advances in satellite image captioning, visual question answering, and promptable segmentation, these capabilities have not translated into productivity gains for practitioners who spend most of their time producing vector layers, raster maps, and cartographic products. The gap is not model capability alone but the absence of an agency layer that supports iterative collaboration. We propose a vocabulary of $9$ primitives for such a layer -- including navigation, perception, geo-referenced memory, and dual modeling -- along with a benchmark that measures human productivity. Our goal is a vocabulary that makes agentic assistance in GIS implementable, testable, and comparable.

AI.tldr: 该研究提出了9种用于地理AI助手的代理原语，旨在连接基础模型与GIS实践者实际工作流程，解决当前AI能力未转化为实际生产力的问题。
AI.motivation: 尽管卫星图像描述、视觉问答和可提示分割等技术有所进展，但这些能力并未转化为GIS实践者的生产力提升。实践者大部分时间用于制作矢量图层、栅格地图和制图产品。问题不仅在于模型能力，更在于缺乏支持迭代协作的代理层。
AI.method: 提出了包含9种原语的词汇表，包括导航、感知、地理参考记忆和双重建模等，用于构建代理层。同时创建了衡量人类生产力的基准测试。
AI.result: 研究正在进行中，目标是建立一个使GIS中的代理辅助可实施、可测试和可比较的词汇表。
AI.conclusion: 需要建立连接基础模型与GIS实际工作流程的代理原语层，通过标准化的词汇表和基准测试来推动地理AI助手在实际工作中的生产力提升。

title: Answering the Wrong Question: Reasoning Trace Inversion for Abstention in LLMs
summary: For Large Language Models (LLMs) to be reliably deployed, models must effectively know when not to answer: abstain. Reasoning models, in particular, have gained attention for impressive performance on complex tasks. However, reasoning models have been shown to have worse abstention abilities. Taking the vulnerabilities of reasoning models into account, we propose our Query Misalignment Framework. Hallucinations resulting in failed abstention can be reinterpreted as LLMs answering the wrong question (rather than answering a question incorrectly). Based on this framework, we develop a new class of state-of-the-art abstention methods called Trace Inversion. First, we generate the reasoning trace of a model. Based on only the trace, we then reconstruct the most likely query that the model responded to. Finally, we compare the initial query with the reconstructed query. Low similarity score between the initial query and reconstructed query suggests that the model likely answered the question incorrectly and is flagged to abstain. Extensive experiments demonstrate that Trace Inversion effectively boosts abstention performance in four frontier LLMs across nine abstention QA datasets, beating competitive baselines in 33 out of 36 settings.

AI.tldr: 提出Trace Inversion方法，通过比较原始查询与从模型推理轨迹重构的查询之间的相似度来判断是否应该弃权，显著提升了推理模型的弃权能力。
AI.motivation: 大型语言模型在部署时需要有效判断何时不应回答（弃权）。推理模型虽然在复杂任务上表现优异，但弃权能力较差。模型幻觉导致的弃权失败可以重新解释为模型回答了错误的问题，而不是错误地回答了问题。
AI.method: 提出查询不对齐框架和Trace Inversion方法：1）生成模型的推理轨迹；2）仅基于推理轨迹重构模型最可能回答的查询；3）比较原始查询与重构查询的相似度，低相似度表明模型可能回答了错误问题，标记为弃权。
AI.result: 在四个前沿LLM和九个弃权QA数据集上的广泛实验表明，Trace Inversion有效提升了弃权性能，在36个设置中33个击败了竞争基线方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过将幻觉重新解释为回答错误问题而非错误回答问题，提出的Trace Inversion方法显著改善了推理模型的弃权能力，为LLM的可靠部署提供了新方法。

title: A3R: Agentic Affordance Reasoning via Cross-Dimensional Evidence in 3D Gaussian Scenes
summary: Affordance reasoning in 3D Gaussian scenes aims to identify the region that supports the action specified by a given text instruction in complex environments. Existing methods typically cast this problem as one-shot prediction from static scene observations, assuming sufficient evidence is already available for reasoning. However, in complex 3D scenes, many failure cases arise not from weak prediction capacity, but from incomplete task-relevant evidence under fixed observations. To address this limitation, we reformulate fine-grained affordance reasoning as a sequential evidence acquisition process, where ambiguity is progressively reduced through complementary 3D geometric and 2D semantic evidence. Building on this formulation, we propose A3R, an agentic affordance reasoning framework that enables an MLLM-based policy to iteratively select evidence acquisition actions and update the affordance belief through cross-dimensional evidence acquisition. To optimize such sequential decision making, we further introduce a GRPO-based policy learning strategy that improves evidence acquisition efficiency and reasoning accuracy. Extensive experiments on scene-level benchmarks show that A3R consistently surpasses static one-shot baselines, demonstrating the advantage of agentic cross-dimensional evidence acquisition for fine-grained affordance reasoning in complex 3D Gaussian scenes.

AI.tldr: A3R：一种用于3D高斯场景中细粒度可供性推理的智能体框架，通过跨维度证据获取的序列决策过程，相比静态单次预测方法有显著优势。
AI.motivation: 现有方法将3D高斯场景中的可供性推理视为静态单次预测问题，假设已有足够证据。但在复杂3D场景中，许多失败案例源于固定观测下任务相关证据的不完整性，而非预测能力不足。
AI.method: 将细粒度可供性推理重新表述为序列证据获取过程，提出A3R框架：基于MLLM的策略迭代选择证据获取动作，通过跨维度（3D几何和2D语义）证据获取更新可供性信念，并采用GRPO策略学习方法优化序列决策。
AI.result: 在场景级基准测试中，A3R持续超越静态单次预测基线方法，证明了智能体跨维度证据获取在复杂3D高斯场景中细粒度可供性推理方面的优势。
AI.conclusion: 将可供性推理重新表述为序列证据获取过程，通过智能体跨维度证据获取方法，能够有效解决复杂3D场景中证据不完整的问题，显著提高推理准确性。

title: GS^2: Graph-based Spatial Distribution Optimization for Compact 3D Gaussian Splatting
summary: 3D Gaussian Splatting (3DGS) has demonstrated breakthrough performance in novel view synthesis and real-time rendering. Nevertheless, its practicality is constrained by the high memory cost due to a huge number of Gaussian points. Many pruning-based 3DGS variants have been proposed for memory saving, but often compromise spatial consistency and may lead to rendering artifacts. To address this issue, we propose graph-based spatial distribution optimization for compact 3D Gaussian Splatting (GS\textasciicircum2), which enhances reconstruction quality by optimizing the spatial distribution of Gaussian points. Specifically, we introduce an evidence lower bound (ELBO)-based adaptive densification strategy that automatically controls the densification process. In addition, an opacity-aware progressive pruning strategy is proposed to further reduce memory consumption by dynamically removing low-opacity Gaussian points. Furthermore, we propose a graph-based feature encoding module to adjust the spatial distribution via feature-guided point shifting. Extensive experiments validate that GS\textasciicircum2 achieves a compact Gaussian representation while delivering superior rendering quality. Compared with 3DGS, it achieves higher PSNR with only about 12.5\% Gaussian points. Furthermore, it outperforms all compared baselines in both rendering quality and memory efficiency.

AI.tldr: GS^2提出基于图的空间分布优化方法，通过ELBO自适应致密化、透明度感知剪枝和特征引导点位移，在减少高斯点数量的同时提升3DGS的渲染质量
AI.motivation: 3D高斯泼溅（3DGS）在实时渲染方面表现出色，但大量高斯点导致高内存消耗。现有剪枝方法虽然节省内存，但会损害空间一致性并产生渲染伪影
AI.method: 1) 基于证据下界（ELBO）的自适应致密化策略，自动控制致密化过程；2) 透明度感知渐进剪枝策略，动态移除低透明度高斯点；3) 基于图的特征编码模块，通过特征引导的点位移调整空间分布
AI.result: GS^2仅使用约12.5%的高斯点就实现了比原始3DGS更高的PSNR，在渲染质量和内存效率方面均优于所有基线方法
AI.conclusion: 提出的图基空间分布优化方法能够在保持紧凑高斯表示的同时提供卓越的渲染质量，解决了3DGS内存消耗高的问题

title: The Self Driving Portfolio: Agentic Architecture for Institutional Asset Management
summary: Agentic AI shifts the investor's role from analytical execution to oversight. We present an agentic strategic asset allocation pipeline in which approximately 50 specialized agents produce capital market assumptions, construct portfolios using over 20 competing methods, and critique and vote on each other's output. A researcher agent proposes new portfolio construction methods not yet represented, and a meta-agent compares past forecasts against realized returns and rewrites agent code and prompts to improve future performance. The entire pipeline is governed by the Investment Policy Statement--the same document that guides human portfolio managers can now constrain and direct autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种基于智能代理的资产配置系统，其中约50个专业代理生成市场假设、构建投资组合，并通过相互评审和投票优化决策，最终由投资政策声明统一管理。
AI.motivation: 随着AI代理技术的发展，投资者角色正从分析执行转向监督。研究旨在探索如何利用多代理系统实现战略资产配置的自动化，同时保持人类投资经理的监督和控制能力。
AI.method: 构建了一个包含约50个专业代理的管道系统：1）生成资本市场假设；2）使用20多种竞争方法构建投资组合；3）代理相互评审和投票；4）研究代理提出新方法；5）元代理比较历史预测与实际回报，并重写代理代码和提示以改进性能。
AI.result: 系统实现了完全自主的战略资产配置流程，投资政策声明能够有效约束和指导自主代理，类似于人类投资经理的管理框架。
AI.conclusion: 智能代理系统能够将投资者角色从分析执行转变为监督，通过多代理协作、相互评审和持续改进机制，实现高效、透明的资产配置决策，同时保持与人类投资框架的一致性。

title: Novel Memory Forgetting Techniques for Autonomous AI Agents: Balancing Relevance and Efficiency
summary: Long-horizon conversational agents require persistent memory for coherent reasoning, yet uncontrolled accumulation causes temporal decay and false memory propagation. Benchmarks such as LOCOMO and LOCCO report performance degradation from 0.455 to 0.05 across stages, while MultiWOZ shows 78.2% accuracy with 6.8% false memory rate under persistent retention. This work introduces an adaptive budgeted forgetting framework that regulates memory through relevanceguided scoring and bounded optimization. The approach integrates recency, frequency, and semantic alignment to maintain stability under constrained context. Comparative analysis demonstrates improved long-horizon F1 beyond 0.583 baseline levels, higher retention consistency, and reduced false memory behavior without increasing context usage. These findings confirm that structured forgetting preserves reasoning performance while preventing unbounded memory growth in extended conversational settings.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种自适应预算遗忘框架，通过相关性引导评分和有界优化来调节记忆，解决长对话中记忆累积导致的性能下降和虚假记忆传播问题。
AI.motivation: 长对话智能体需要持久记忆进行连贯推理，但不受控制的记忆积累会导致时间衰减和虚假记忆传播。现有基准测试显示性能显著下降，如LOCOMO和LOCCO中性能从0.455降至0.05，MultiWOZ中准确率为78.2%但虚假记忆率达6.8%。
AI.method: 提出自适应预算遗忘框架，通过相关性引导评分和有界优化来调节记忆。该方法整合了时效性、频率和语义对齐，在受限上下文中保持稳定性。
AI.result: 该方法在长对话F1分数上超过0.583的基线水平，提高了记忆保持一致性，减少了虚假记忆行为，且未增加上下文使用量。验证了结构化遗忘在保持推理性能的同时防止无限制记忆增长的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 结构化遗忘能够保持推理性能，同时防止在扩展对话设置中无限制的记忆增长，为长对话智能体的记忆管理提供了有效解决方案。

title: ProVG: Progressive Visual Grounding via Language Decoupling for Remote Sensing Imagery
summary: Remote sensing visual grounding (RSVG) aims to localize objects in remote sensing imagery according to natural language expressions. Previous methods typically rely on sentence-level vision-language alignment, which struggles to exploit fine-grained linguistic cues, such as \textit{spatial relations} and \textit{object attributes}, that are crucial for distinguishing objects with similar characteristics. Importantly, these cues play distinct roles across different grounding stages and should be leveraged accordingly to provide more explicit guidance. In this work, we propose \textbf{ProVG}, a novel RSVG framework that improves localization accuracy by decoupling language expressions into global context, spatial relations, and object attributes. To integrate these linguistic cues, ProVG employs a simple yet effective progressive cross-modal modulator, which dynamically modulates visual attention through a \textit{survey-locate-verify} scheme, enabling coarse-to-fine vision-language alignment. In addition, ProVG incorporates a cross-scale fusion module to mitigate the large-scale variations in remote sensing imagery, along with a language-guided calibration decoder to refine cross-modal alignment during prediction. A unified multi-task head further enables ProVG to support both referring expression comprehension and segmentation tasks. Extensive experiments on two benchmarks, \textit{i.e.}, RRSIS-D and RISBench, demonstrate that ProVG consistently outperforms existing methods, achieving new state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: ProVG是一个用于遥感视觉定位的新框架，通过将语言表达解耦为全局上下文、空间关系和对象属性，采用渐进式跨模态调制器实现从粗到细的视觉-语言对齐，显著提升了定位精度。
AI.motivation: 现有遥感视觉定位方法通常依赖句子级别的视觉-语言对齐，难以利用细粒度语言线索（如空间关系和对象属性），而这些线索对于区分具有相似特征的物体至关重要。不同定位阶段这些线索发挥不同作用，需要相应利用以提供更明确的指导。
AI.method: 1. 将语言表达解耦为全局上下文、空间关系和对象属性三个部分；2. 采用渐进式跨模态调制器，通过"调查-定位-验证"方案动态调制视觉注意力；3. 引入跨尺度融合模块处理遥感图像的大尺度变化；4. 使用语言引导的校准解码器在预测时细化跨模态对齐；5. 统一的多任务头支持指称表达理解和分割任务。
AI.result: 在RRSIS-D和RISBench两个基准测试上的广泛实验表明，ProVG持续优于现有方法，达到了新的最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: ProVG通过解耦语言表达和渐进式跨模态调制，有效利用了细粒度语言线索，显著提升了遥感视觉定位的准确性，为处理遥感图像中的大尺度变化和复杂语言描述提供了有效解决方案。

title: Beyond the Assistant Turn: User Turn Generation as a Probe of Interaction Awareness in Language Models
summary: Standard LLM benchmarks evaluate the assistant turn: the model generates a response to an input, a verifier scores correctness, and the analysis ends. This paradigm leaves unmeasured whether the LLM encodes any awareness of what follows the assistant response. We propose user-turn generation as a probe of this gap: given a conversation context of user query and assistant response, we let a model generate under the user role. If the model's weights encode interaction awareness, the generated user turn will be a grounded follow-up that reacts to the preceding context. Through experiments across $11$ open-weight LLMs (Qwen3.5, gpt-oss, GLM) and $5$ datasets (math reasoning, instruction following, conversation), we show that interaction awareness is decoupled from task accuracy. In particular, within the Qwen3.5 family, GSM8K accuracy scales from $41\%$ ($0.8$B) to $96.8\%$ ($397$B-A$17$B), yet genuine follow-up rates under deterministic generation remain near zero. In contrast, higher temperature sampling reveals interaction awareness is latent with follow up rates reaching $22\%$. Controlled perturbations validate that the proposed probe measures a real property of the model, and collaboration-oriented post-training on Qwen3.5-2B demonstrates an increase in follow-up rates. Our results show that user-turn generation captures a dimension of LLM behavior, interaction awareness, that is unexplored and invisible with current assistant-only benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 论文提出用户轮次生成作为衡量LLM交互意识的新方法，发现交互意识与任务准确性解耦，即使在数学推理准确率很高的模型中，真正的后续对话生成率也接近零，但通过高温采样可以揭示潜在的交互意识。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准测试只评估助手轮次（模型对输入的响应），而忽略了模型是否对助手响应后的后续交互有意识。这种范式无法测量LLM是否编码了对话交互的连续性意识。
AI.method: 提出用户轮次生成作为探针：给定包含用户查询和助手响应的对话上下文，让模型以用户角色生成后续内容。如果模型权重编码了交互意识，生成的用户轮次将是基于上下文的合理后续反应。在11个开源LLM和5个数据集上进行实验，使用确定性生成和高温采样两种方式，并通过受控扰动验证测量有效性。
AI.result: 发现交互意识与任务准确性解耦：在Qwen3.5家族中，GSM8K准确率从41%（0.8B）到96.8%（397B-A17B）不等，但确定性生成下的真正后续对话率接近零。高温采样显示交互意识是潜在的，后续对话率可达22%。受控扰动验证了探针测量的是模型的真实属性，协作导向的后训练能提高后续对话率。
AI.conclusion: 用户轮次生成捕捉了LLM行为的一个新维度——交互意识，这一维度在当前仅关注助手轮次的基准测试中未被探索且不可见。该研究揭示了LLM能力评估需要超越传统准确性指标，考虑对话连续性和交互意识。

title: SHARC: Reference point driven Spherical Harmonic Representation for Complex Shapes
summary: We propose SHARC, a novel framework that synthesizes arbitrary, genus-agnostic shapes by means of a collection of Spherical Harmonic (SH) representations of distance fields. These distance fields are anchored at optimally placed reference points in the interior volume of the surface in a way that maximizes learning of the finer details of the surface. To achieve this, we employ a cost function that jointly maximizes sparsity and centrality in terms of positioning, as well as visibility of the surface from their location. For each selected reference point, we sample the visible distance field to the surface geometry via ray-casting and compute the SH coefficients using the Fast Spherical Harmonic Transform (FSHT). To enhance geometric fidelity, we apply a configurable low-pass filter to the coefficients and refine the output using a local consistency constraint based on proximity. Evaluation of SHARC against state-of-the-art methods demonstrates that the proposed method outperforms existing approaches in both reconstruction accuracy and time efficiency without sacrificing model parsimony. The source code is available at https://github.com/POSE-Lab/SHARC.

AI.tldr: SHARC提出了一种基于球谐函数表示距离场的新框架，通过优化放置内部参考点来合成任意拓扑形状，在重建精度和时间效率上优于现有方法。
AI.motivation: 现有形状合成方法在保持几何细节和计算效率方面存在局限，需要一种能够处理任意拓扑结构（无论亏格如何）且能高效学习表面精细细节的方法。
AI.method: SHARC框架使用球谐函数表示距离场，通过优化放置内部参考点来最大化表面细节学习。采用联合成本函数优化参考点的稀疏性、中心性和可见性，对每个参考点通过光线投射采样距离场并计算球谐系数，应用可配置低通滤波和基于邻近性的局部一致性约束进行细化。
AI.result: SHARC在重建精度和时间效率方面均优于现有最先进方法，同时保持了模型的简洁性，能够有效合成任意拓扑形状。
AI.conclusion: SHARC提供了一种高效且准确的形状合成方法，通过球谐函数表示和优化参考点放置，能够处理任意拓扑结构并保持几何细节，在重建质量和计算效率方面都有显著优势。

title: Cross-Scale MAE: A Tale of Multi-Scale Exploitation in Remote Sensing
summary: Remote sensing images present unique challenges to image analysis due to the extensive geographic coverage, hardware limitations, and misaligned multi-scale images. This paper revisits the classical multi-scale representation learning problem but under the general framework of self-supervised learning for remote sensing image understanding. We present Cross-Scale MAE, a self-supervised model built upon the Masked Auto-Encoder (MAE).During pre-training, Cross-Scale MAE employs scale augmentation techniques and enforces cross-scale consistency constraints through both contrastive and generative losses to ensure consistent and meaningful representations well-suited for a wide range of downstream tasks. Further, our implementation leverages the xFormers library to accelerate network pre-training on a single GPU while maintaining the quality of learned representations. Experimental evaluations demonstrate that Cross-Scale MAE exhibits superior performance compared to standard MAE and other state-of-the-art remote sensing MAE methods.

AI.tldr: Cross-Scale MAE：基于MAE的自监督学习框架，通过尺度增强和跨尺度一致性约束，为遥感图像理解提供更好的多尺度表征学习
AI.motivation: 遥感图像具有覆盖范围广、硬件限制、多尺度图像不对齐等独特挑战，需要重新审视多尺度表征学习问题，特别是在自监督学习框架下
AI.method: 基于Masked Auto-Encoder构建Cross-Scale MAE，采用尺度增强技术，通过对比损失和生成损失实施跨尺度一致性约束，利用xFormers库加速单GPU预训练
AI.result: 实验评估表明，Cross-Scale MAE相比标准MAE和其他最先进的遥感MAE方法表现出更优越的性能
AI.conclusion: Cross-Scale MAE为遥感图像理解提供了一种有效的自监督多尺度表征学习方法，能够学习到一致且有意义的表征，适用于广泛的下游任务

title: FTPFusion: Frequency-Aware Infrared and Visible Video Fusion with Temporal Perturbation
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion plays a critical role in intelligent surveillance and low-light monitoring. However, maintaining temporal stability while preserving spatial detail remains a fundamental challenge. Existing methods either focus on frame-wise enhancement with limited temporal modeling or rely on heavy spatio-temporal aggregation that often sacrifices high-frequency details. In this paper, we propose FTPFusion, a frequency-aware infrared and visible video fusion method based on temporal perturbation and sparse cross-modal interaction. Specifically, FTPFusion decomposes the feature representations into high-frequency and low-frequency components for collaborative modeling. The high-frequency branch performs sparse cross-modal spatio-temporal interaction to capture motion-related context and complementary details. The low-frequency branch introduces a temporal perturbation strategy to enhance robustness against complex video variations, such as flickering, jitter, and local misalignment. Furthermore, we design an offset-aware temporal consistency constraint to explicitly stabilize cross-frame representations under temporal disturbances. Extensive experiments on multiple public benchmarks demonstrate that FTPFusion consistently outperforms state-of-the-art methods across multiple metrics in both spatial fidelity and temporal consistency. The source code will be available at https://github.com/ixilai/FTPFusion.

AI.tldr: FTPFusion是一种基于频率分解的红外与可见光视频融合方法，通过时域扰动和稀疏跨模态交互解决时空稳定性问题
AI.motivation: 红外与可见光视频融合在智能监控和低光监测中至关重要，但现有方法在保持时间稳定性的同时保留空间细节方面存在挑战。现有方法要么侧重于有限时间建模的逐帧增强，要么依赖于牺牲高频细节的繁重时空聚合。
AI.method: FTPFusion将特征表示分解为高频和低频分量进行协同建模。高频分支执行稀疏跨模态时空交互以捕捉运动相关上下文和互补细节；低频分支引入时域扰动策略以增强对复杂视频变化（如闪烁、抖动和局部错位）的鲁棒性；并设计了偏移感知时间一致性约束来显式稳定时域扰动下的跨帧表示。
AI.result: 在多个公共基准测试上的广泛实验表明，FTPFusion在空间保真度和时间一致性方面均优于现有最先进方法。
AI.conclusion: FTPFusion通过频率分解、时域扰动和稀疏跨模态交互，有效解决了红外与可见光视频融合中的时空稳定性问题，在保持空间细节的同时实现了更好的时间一致性。

title: Light-ResKAN: A Parameter-Sharing Lightweight KAN with Gram Polynomials for Efficient SAR Image Recognition
summary: Synthetic Aperture Radar (SAR) image recognition is vital for disaster monitoring, military reconnaissance, and ocean observation. However, large SAR image sizes hinder deep learning deployment on resource-constrained edge devices, and existing lightweight models struggle to balance high-precision feature extraction with low computational requirements. The emerging Kolmogorov-Arnold Network (KAN) enhances fitting by replacing fixed activations with learnable ones, reducing parameters and computation. Inspired by KAN, we propose Light-ResKAN to achieve a better balance between precision and efficiency. First, Light-ResKAN modifies ResNet by replacing convolutions with KAN convolutions, enabling adaptive feature extraction for SAR images. Second, we use Gram Polynomials as activations, which are well-suited for SAR data to capture complex non-linear relationships. Third, we employ a parameter-sharing strategy: each kernel shares parameters per channel, preserving unique features while reducing parameters and FLOPs. Our model achieves 99.09%, 93.01%, and 97.26% accuracy on MSTAR, FUSAR-Ship, and SAR-ACD datasets, respectively. Experiments on MSTAR resized to $1024 \times 1024$ show that compared to VGG16, our model reduces FLOPs by $82.90 \times$ and parameters by $163.78 \times$. This work establishes an efficient solution for edge SAR image recognition.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Light-ResKAN模型，通过将ResNet中的卷积替换为KAN卷积，使用Gram多项式作为激活函数，并采用参数共享策略，在保持SAR图像识别精度的同时大幅降低计算量和参数量，适用于资源受限的边缘设备。
AI.motivation: SAR图像识别在灾害监测、军事侦察和海洋观测中至关重要，但大尺寸SAR图像阻碍了深度学习在资源受限边缘设备上的部署，现有轻量级模型难以平衡高精度特征提取与低计算需求之间的矛盾。
AI.method: 1) 将ResNet中的卷积替换为KAN卷积，实现自适应特征提取；2) 使用Gram多项式作为激活函数，适合SAR数据捕捉复杂非线性关系；3) 采用参数共享策略：每个核按通道共享参数，在减少参数和FLOPs的同时保留独特特征。
AI.result: 在MSTAR、FUSAR-Ship和SAR-ACD数据集上分别达到99.09%、93.01%和97.26%的准确率。在1024×1024的MSTAR数据集上，相比VGG16，FLOPs减少82.90倍，参数量减少163.78倍。
AI.conclusion: Light-ResKAN模型在保持高精度的同时显著降低了计算复杂度和参数量，为边缘设备上的SAR图像识别提供了高效的解决方案。

title: Night Eyes: A Reproducible Framework for Constellation-Based Corneal Reflection Matching
summary: Corneal reflection (glint) detection plays an important role in pupil-corneal reflection (P-CR) eye tracking, but in practice it is often handled as heuristics embedded within larger systems, making reproducibility difficult across hardware setups. We introduce a 2D geometry-driven, constellation-based pipeline for mulit-glint detection and matching, focusing on reproducibility and clear evaluation. Inspired by lost-in-space star identification, we treat glints as structured constellations rather than independent blobs. We propose a Similarity-Layout Alignment (SLA) procedure which adapts constellation matching to the specific constraints of multi-LED eye tracking. The framework brings together controlled over-detection, adaptive candidate fallback, appearance-aware scoring, and optional semantic layout priors while keeping detection and correspondence explicitly separated. Evaluated on a public multi-LED dataset, the system provides stable identity-preserving correspondence under noisy conditions. We release code, presets, and evaluation scripts to enable transparent replication, comparison, and dataset annotation.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了一种基于2D几何和星座匹配的多光斑检测与匹配方法，用于瞳孔-角膜反射眼动追踪，强调可复现性和明确评估。
AI.motivation: 角膜反射（光斑）检测在P-CR眼动追踪中很重要，但实践中常作为启发式方法嵌入大系统中，导致不同硬件设置下难以复现。需要一种可复现、评估清晰的解决方案。
AI.method: 提出2D几何驱动的星座式多光斑检测与匹配流程，将光斑视为结构化星座而非独立斑点。采用相似性-布局对齐（SLA）程序，将星座匹配适配到多LED眼动追踪的特定约束。框架包含受控过检测、自适应候选回退、外观感知评分和可选语义布局先验，同时保持检测与对应关系明确分离。
AI.result: 在公开多LED数据集上评估，系统在噪声条件下提供稳定的身份保持对应关系。作者发布了代码、预设和评估脚本以实现透明复现、比较和数据集标注。
AI.conclusion: 该几何驱动的星座式方法为多光斑检测与匹配提供了可复现、评估清晰的解决方案，有助于提升P-CR眼动追踪系统的可靠性和跨硬件一致性。

title: Learning Spatial Structure from Pre-Beamforming Per-Antenna Range-Doppler Radar Data via Visibility-Aware Cross-Modal Supervision
summary: Automotive radar perception pipelines commonly construct angle-domain representations via beamforming before applying learning-based models. This work instead investigates a representational question: can meaningful spatial structure be learned directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna range-Doppler (RD) measurements? Experiments are conducted on a 6-TX x 8-RX (48 virtual antennas) commodity automotive radar employing an A/B chirp-sequence frequency-modulated continuous-wave (CS-FMCW) transmit scheme, in which the effective transmit aperture varies between chirps (single-TX vs. multi-TX), enabling controlled analysis of chirp-dependent transmit configurations. We operate on pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors using a dual-chirp shared-weight encoder trained in an end-to-end, fully data-driven manner, and evaluate spatial recoverability using bird's-eye-view (BEV) occupancy as a geometric probe rather than a performance-driven objective. Supervision is visibility-aware and cross-modal, derived from LiDAR with explicit modeling of the radar field-of-view and occlusion-aware LiDAR observability via ray-based visibility. Through chirp ablations (A-only, B-only, A+B), range-band analysis, and physics-aligned baselines, we assess how transmit configurations affect geometric recoverability. The results indicate that spatial structure can be learned directly from pre-beamforming per-antenna RD tensors without explicit angle-domain construction or hand-crafted signal-processing stages.

AI.tldr: 该研究探索了直接从波束形成前的天线级距离-多普勒张量中学习空间结构的可行性，绕过了传统的角度域表示构建过程。
AI.motivation: 汽车雷达感知流程通常先通过波束形成构建角度域表示，再应用学习模型。本研究质疑这种传统流程的必要性，探索能否直接从波束形成前的天线级原始数据中学习有意义的空间结构。
AI.method: 使用6发射×8接收（48虚拟天线）商用汽车雷达，采用A/B啁啾序列FMCW传输方案。设计双啁啾共享权重编码器，端到端数据驱动训练。使用鸟瞰图占用率作为几何探针，监督信号来自激光雷达，考虑雷达视场和遮挡感知的激光雷达可观测性。
AI.result: 通过啁啾消融实验（仅A、仅B、A+B）、距离带分析和物理对齐基线评估，结果表明可以直接从波束形成前的天线级RD张量中学习空间结构，无需显式的角度域构建或手工信号处理阶段。
AI.conclusion: 空间结构可以直接从波束形成前的天线级距离-多普勒测量中学习，这为汽车雷达感知提供了新的表示学习范式，绕过了传统的角度域表示构建流程。

title: Rethinking Representations for Cross-Domain Infrared Small Target Detection: A Generalizable Perspective from the Frequency Domain
comment: The code will be released at https://github.com/fuyimin96/S2CPNet upon acceptance
summary: The accurate target-background separation in infrared small target detection (IRSTD) highly depends on the discriminability of extracted representations. However, most existing methods are confined to domain-consistent settings, while overlooking whether such discriminability can generalize to unseen domains. In practice, distribution shifts between training and testing data are inevitable due to variations in observational conditions and environmental factors. Meanwhile, the intrinsic indistinctiveness of infrared small targets aggravates overfitting to domain-specific patterns. Consequently, the detection performance of models trained on source domains can be severely degraded when deployed in unseen domains. To address this challenge, we propose a spatial-spectral collaborative perception network (S$^2$CPNet) for cross-domain IRSTD. Moving beyond conventional spatial learning pipelines, we rethink IRSTD representations from a frequency perspective and reveal inconsistencies in spectral phase as the primary manifestation of domain discrepancies. Based on this insight, we develop a phase rectification module (PRM) to derive generalizable target awareness. Then, we employ an orthogonal attention mechanism (OAM) in skip connections to preserve positional information while refining informative representations. Moreover, the bias toward domain-specific patterns is further mitigated through selective style recomposition (SSR). Extensive experiments have been conducted on three IRSTD datasets, and the proposed method consistently achieves state-of-the-art performance under diverse cross-domain settings.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出S²CPNet网络用于跨域红外小目标检测，通过相位校正模块解决域差异问题，在三个数据集上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 现有红外小目标检测方法大多局限于域一致设置，忽略了模型在未见域上的泛化能力。实际应用中，由于观测条件和环境因素的变化，训练和测试数据之间的分布偏移不可避免。同时，红外小目标固有的模糊性加剧了对域特定模式的过拟合，导致模型在未见域上性能严重下降。
AI.method: 提出空间-频谱协同感知网络(S²CPNet)：1) 从频率角度重新思考红外小目标表示，发现频谱相位不一致是域差异的主要表现；2) 开发相位校正模块(PRM)以获得可泛化的目标感知；3) 在跳跃连接中使用正交注意力机制(OAM)在保留位置信息的同时细化信息表示；4) 通过选择性风格重组(SSR)进一步缓解对域特定模式的偏差。
AI.result: 在三个红外小目标检测数据集上进行了大量实验，所提方法在多种跨域设置下始终达到最先进的性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过从频率角度分析域差异，提出S²CPNet网络有效解决了跨域红外小目标检测问题，相位校正模块和选择性风格重组策略显著提升了模型在未见域上的泛化能力。

title: MAVFusion: Efficient Infrared and Visible Video Fusion via Motion-Aware Sparse Interaction
summary: Infrared and visible video fusion combines the object saliency from infrared images with the texture details from visible images to produce semantically rich fusion results. However, most existing methods are designed for static image fusion and cannot effectively handle frame-to-frame motion in videos. Current video fusion methods improve temporal consistency by introducing interactions across frames, but they often require high computational cost. To mitigate these challenges, we propose MAVFusion, an end-to-end video fusion framework featuring a motion-aware sparse interaction mechanism that enhances efficiency while maintaining superior fusion quality. Specifically, we leverage optical flow to identify dynamic regions in multi-modal sequences, adaptively allocating computationally intensive cross-modal attention to these sparse areas to capture salient transitions and facilitate inter-modal information exchange. For static background regions, a lightweight weak interaction module is employed to maintain structural and appearance integrity. By decoupling the processing of dynamic and static regions, MAVFusion simultaneously preserves temporal consistency and fine-grained details while significantly accelerating inference. Extensive experiments demonstrate that MAVFusion achieves state-of-the-art performance on multiple infrared and visible video benchmarks, achieving a speed of 14.16\,FPS at $640 \times 480$ resolution. The source code will be available at https://github.com/ixilai/MAVFusion.

AI.tldr: MAVFusion是一个用于红外与可见光视频融合的端到端框架，通过运动感知稀疏交互机制，在保持高质量融合的同时显著提升计算效率。
AI.motivation: 现有方法多为静态图像融合设计，无法有效处理视频帧间运动；现有视频融合方法虽然通过跨帧交互提高了时间一致性，但计算成本过高。
AI.method: 提出运动感知稀疏交互机制：利用光流识别多模态序列中的动态区域，自适应地将计算密集的跨模态注意力分配到这些稀疏区域；对静态背景区域使用轻量级弱交互模块；通过解耦动态和静态区域的处理来平衡效率和质量。
AI.result: 在多个红外与可见光视频基准测试中达到最先进性能，在640×480分辨率下实现14.16 FPS的速度，同时保持了时间一致性和细节完整性。
AI.conclusion: MAVFusion通过运动感知稀疏交互机制，在保持高质量视频融合的同时显著提升了计算效率，为红外与可见光视频融合提供了有效的解决方案。

title: Ego-Grounding for Personalized Question-Answering in Egocentric Videos
summary: We present the first systematic analysis of multimodal large language models (MLLMs) in personalized question-answering requiring ego-grounding - the ability to understand the camera-wearer in egocentric videos. To this end, we introduce MyEgo, the first egocentric VideoQA dataset designed to evaluate MLLMs' ability to understand, remember, and reason about the camera wearer. MyEgo comprises 541 long videos and 5K personalized questions asking about "my things", "my activities", and "my past". Benchmarking reveals that competitive MLLMs across variants, including open-source vs. proprietary, thinking vs. non-thinking, small vs. large scales all struggle on MyEgo. Top closed- and open-source models (e.g., GPT-5 and Qwen3-VL) achieve only~46% and 36% accuracy, trailing human performance by near 40% and 50% respectively. Surprisingly, neither explicit reasoning nor model scaling yield consistent improvements. Models improve when relevant evidence is explicitly provided, but gains drop over time, indicating limitations in tracking and remembering "me" and "my past". These findings collectively highlight the crucial role of ego-grounding and long-range memory in enabling personalized QA in egocentric videos. We hope MyEgo and our analyses catalyze further progress in these areas for egocentric personalized assistance. Data and code are available at https://github.com/Ryougetsu3606/MyEgo

AI.tldr: 本文提出了MyEgo数据集，这是首个用于评估多模态大语言模型在自我中心视频中个性化问答能力的基准，发现现有模型在理解、记忆和推理"我"相关信息方面存在显著不足。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大语言模型在自我中心视频的个性化问答任务中表现不佳，缺乏对相机佩戴者（"我"）的理解、记忆和推理能力，这限制了它们在个性化辅助应用中的实用性。
AI.method: 作者创建了MyEgo数据集，包含541个长视频和5K个个性化问题，涵盖"我的物品"、"我的活动"和"我的过去"三类问题。通过该数据集系统评估了开源与闭源、思考与非思考、不同规模的各种MLLM模型。
AI.result: 所有测试模型在MyEgo上表现均不理想：顶级闭源模型（如GPT-5）准确率仅约46%，开源模型（如Qwen3-VL）约36%，分别落后人类表现近40%和50%。显式推理和模型缩放未能带来一致改进，提供相关证据时模型有所提升但随时间增益下降。
AI.conclusion: 研究强调了自我中心接地和长程记忆在自我中心视频个性化问答中的关键作用，MyEgo数据集和相关分析将推动该领域发展，为个性化辅助应用奠定基础。

title: SDesc3D: Towards Layout-Aware 3D Indoor Scene Generation from Short Descriptions
summary: 3D indoor scene generation conditioned on short textual descriptions provides a promising avenue for interactive 3D environment construction without the need for labor-intensive layout specification. Despite recent progress in text-conditioned 3D scene generation, existing works suffer from poor physical plausibility and insufficient detail richness in such semantic condensation cases, largely due to their reliance on explicit semantic cues about compositional objects and their spatial relationships. This limitation highlights the need for enhanced 3D reasoning capabilities, particularly in terms of prior integration and spatial anchoring.Motivated by this, we propose SDesc3D, a short-text conditioned 3D indoor scene generation framework, that leverages multi-view structural priors and regional functionality implications to enable 3D layout reasoning under sparse textual guidance.Specifically, we introduce a Multi-view scene prior augmentation that enriches underspecified textual inputs with aggregated multi-view structural knowledge, shifting from inaccessible semantic relation cues to multi-view relational prior aggregation. Building on this, we design a Functionality-aware layout grounding, employing regional functionality grounding for implicit spatial anchors and conducting hierarchical layout reasoning to enhance scene organization and semantic plausibility.Furthermore, an Iterative reflection-rectification scheme is employed for progressive structural plausibility refinement via self-rectification.Extensive experiments show that our method outperforms existing approaches on short-text conditioned 3D indoor scene generation.Code will be publicly available.

AI.tldr: SDesc3D是一个基于短文本描述的3D室内场景生成框架，通过多视角结构先验和区域功能推理来解决现有方法在物理合理性和细节丰富性方面的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有基于文本的3D场景生成方法在短文本条件下存在物理合理性差和细节不足的问题，主要因为它们过度依赖明确的物体组合和空间关系语义线索，缺乏有效的3D推理能力。
AI.method: 提出三个核心技术：1) 多视角场景先验增强，通过聚合多视角结构知识丰富稀疏文本输入；2) 功能感知布局定位，利用区域功能进行隐式空间锚定和分层布局推理；3) 迭代反思-修正方案，通过自修正进行渐进式结构合理性优化。
AI.result: 实验表明，该方法在短文本条件下的3D室内场景生成任务上优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: SDesc3D通过整合多视角结构先验和功能推理，有效提升了短文本条件下3D场景生成的物理合理性和语义一致性，为交互式3D环境构建提供了更有效的解决方案。

title: NearID: Identity Representation Learning via Near-identity Distractors
summary: When evaluating identity-focused tasks such as personalized generation and image editing, existing vision encoders entangle object identity with background context, leading to unreliable representations and metrics. We introduce the first principled framework to address this vulnerability using Near-identity (NearID) distractors, where semantically similar but distinct instances are placed on the exact same background as a reference image, eliminating contextual shortcuts and isolating identity as the sole discriminative signal. Based on this principle, we present the NearID dataset (19K identities, 316K matched-context distractors) together with a strict margin-based evaluation protocol. Under this setting, pre-trained encoders perform poorly, achieving Sample Success Rates (SSR), a strict margin-based identity discrimination metric, as low as 30.7% and often ranking distractors above true cross-view matches. We address this by learning identity-aware representations on a frozen backbone using a two-tier contrastive objective enforcing the hierarchy: same identity > NearID distractor > random negative. This improves SSR to 99.2%, enhances part-level discrimination by 28.0%, and yields stronger alignment with human judgments on DreamBench++, a human-aligned benchmark for personalization. Project page: https://gorluxor.github.io/NearID/

AI.tldr: 提出NearID框架，通过语义相似但身份不同的干扰项消除背景捷径，专注于身份识别评估，构建NearID数据集并开发两阶段对比学习方法来提升身份感知表示。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉编码器在身份相关任务（如个性化生成和图像编辑）中，将对象身份与背景上下文纠缠在一起，导致不可靠的表示和评估指标。需要消除背景捷径，专注于纯粹的身份识别能力。
AI.method: 1) 提出NearID干扰项框架：将语义相似但身份不同的实例放在与参考图像完全相同的背景上，消除上下文捷径；2) 构建NearID数据集（19K身份，316K匹配背景干扰项）；3) 开发两阶段对比学习目标：在冻结骨干网络上学习身份感知表示，强制层次结构：相同身份 > NearID干扰项 > 随机负样本。
AI.result: 1) 预训练编码器在NearID设置下表现不佳，样本成功率（SSR）低至30.7%；2) 提出的两阶段对比学习方法将SSR提升至99.2%；3) 部件级识别能力提升28.0%；4) 在DreamBench++人类对齐基准上获得更好的人类判断对齐。
AI.conclusion: NearID框架有效解决了视觉编码器中身份与背景纠缠的问题，通过严格的评估协议和对比学习方法显著提升了身份感知表示能力，为个性化生成和图像编辑等任务提供了更可靠的评估基础。

title: Interactive Tracking: A Human-in-the-Loop Paradigm with Memory-Augmented Adaptation
summary: Existing visual trackers mainly operate in a non-interactive, fire-and-forget manner, making them impractical for real-world scenarios that require human-in-the-loop adaptation. To overcome this limitation, we introduce Interactive Tracking, a new paradigm that allows users to guide the tracker at any time using natural language commands. To support research in this direction, we make three main contributions. First, we present InteractTrack, the first large-scale benchmark for interactive tracking, containing 150 videos with dense bounding box annotations and timestamped language instructions. Second, we propose a comprehensive evaluation protocol and evaluate 25 representative trackers, showing that state-of-the-art methods fail in interactive scenarios; strong performance on conventional benchmarks does not transfer. Third, we introduce Interactive Memory-Augmented Tracking (IMAT), a new baseline that employs a dynamic memory mechanism to learn from user feedback and update tracking behavior accordingly. Our benchmark, protocol, and baseline establish a foundation for developing more intelligent, adaptive, and collaborative tracking systems, bridging the gap between automated perception and human guidance. The full benchmark, tracking results, and analysis are available at https://github.com/NorahGreen/InteractTrack.git.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出了交互式跟踪新范式，创建了首个大规模交互式跟踪基准InteractTrack，评估了25个代表性跟踪器，并提出了基于动态记忆机制的IMAT基线方法。
AI.motivation: 现有视觉跟踪器主要在非交互式、发射后不管的模式下工作，不适用于需要人在回路适应的真实世界场景。为了克服这一限制，需要开发能够接受用户自然语言指令引导的交互式跟踪系统。
AI.method: 提出了交互式跟踪新范式，创建了包含150个视频、密集边界框标注和时间戳语言指令的InteractTrack基准。设计了全面的评估协议，评估了25个代表性跟踪器。提出了IMAT（交互式记忆增强跟踪）基线方法，采用动态记忆机制从用户反馈中学习并相应更新跟踪行为。
AI.result: 评估显示最先进的跟踪方法在交互场景中表现失败，传统基准上的强性能无法迁移到交互场景。提出的IMAT方法为交互式跟踪提供了有效的基线。
AI.conclusion: 该研究建立的基准、协议和基线为开发更智能、自适应和协作的跟踪系统奠定了基础，弥合了自动感知和人类指导之间的差距。

title: Attention at Rest Stays at Rest: Breaking Visual Inertia for Cognitive Hallucination Mitigation
summary: Like a body at rest that stays at rest, we find that visual attention in multimodal large language models (MLLMs) exhibits pronounced inertia, remaining largely static once settled during early decoding steps and failing to support the compositional understanding required for cognitive inference. While existing hallucination mitigation methods mainly target perceptual hallucinations concerning object existence or attributes, they remain inadequate for such cognitive hallucinations that require inter-object relational deduction. Through token-wise attention analysis, we identify this visual inertia as a key factor: attention to semantically critical regions remains persistently focused and fails to dynamically support relational inference. We thereby propose a training-free Inertia-aware Visual Excitation (IVE) method that breaks this inertial pattern by modeling cognitive inference as the dynamic responsiveness of visual attention. Specifically, IVE selects visual tokens that are dynamically emerging relative to historical attention trends while distinguishing tokens exhibiting inertial behavior. To further facilitate compositional inference, IVE introduces an inertia-aware penalty that discourages over-concentration and limits the persistence of attention within localized regions. Extensive experiments show that IVE is effective across various base MLLMs and multiple hallucination benchmarks, particularly for cognitive hallucinations.

AI.tldr: 多模态大语言模型的视觉注意力存在惯性问题，导致认知推理能力受限，本文提出无需训练的惯性感知视觉激发方法来解决这一问题。
AI.motivation: 研究发现多模态大语言模型的视觉注意力存在明显的惯性现象，一旦在早期解码步骤中稳定下来，就会保持静态，无法支持认知推理所需的组合理解。现有的幻觉缓解方法主要针对对象存在或属性的感知幻觉，但对需要对象间关系推理的认知幻觉效果有限。
AI.method: 提出无需训练的惯性感知视觉激发方法，通过将认知推理建模为视觉注意力的动态响应来打破惯性模式。该方法选择相对于历史注意力趋势动态涌现的视觉标记，同时区分表现出惯性行为的标记。为促进组合推理，引入惯性感知惩罚机制，防止注意力过度集中和局部区域的持续关注。
AI.result: 大量实验表明，IVE方法在各种基础多模态大语言模型和多个幻觉基准测试中都有效，特别是在认知幻觉方面表现突出。
AI.conclusion: 视觉注意力惯性是多模态大语言模型中认知幻觉的关键因素，提出的IVE方法能够有效打破这种惯性模式，显著提升模型在认知推理任务中的表现。

title: Resonance4D: Frequency-Domain Motion Supervision for Preset-Free Physical Parameter Learning in 4D Dynamic Physical Scene Simulation
summary: Physics-driven 4D dynamic simulation from static 3D scenes remains constrained by an overlooked contradiction: reliable motion supervision often relies on online video diffusion or optical-flow pipelines whose computational cost exceeds that of the simulator itself. Existing methods further simplify inverse physical modeling by optimizing only partial material parameters, limiting realism in scenes with complex materials and dynamics. We present Resonance4D, a physics-driven 4D dynamic simulation framework that couples 3D Gaussian Splatting with the Material Point Method through lightweight yet physically expressive supervision. Our key insight is that dynamic consistency can be enforced without dense temporal generation by jointly constraining motion in complementary domains. To this end, we introduce Dual-domain Motion Supervision (DMS), which combines spatial structural consistency for local deformation with frequency-domain spectral consistency for oscillatory and global dynamic patterns, substantially reducing training cost and memory overhead while preserving physically meaningful motion cues. To enable stable full-parameter physical recovery, we further combine zero-shot text-prompted segmentation with simulation-guided initialization to automatically decompose Gaussians into object-part-level regions and support joint optimization of full material parameters. Experiments on both synthetic and real scenes show that Resonance4D achieves strong physical fidelity and motion consistency while reducing peak GPU memory from over 35\,GB to around 20\,GB, enabling high-fidelity physics-driven 4D simulation on a single consumer-grade GPU.

AI.tldr: Resonance4D是一个物理驱动的4D动态模拟框架，通过结合3D高斯泼溅和物质点法，在单个消费级GPU上实现高保真物理模拟，显著降低内存消耗。
AI.motivation: 现有物理驱动的4D动态模拟方法存在两个主要问题：1) 运动监督依赖计算成本高的在线视频扩散或光流管道；2) 仅优化部分材料参数限制了复杂材料和动态场景的真实性。
AI.method: 提出双域运动监督(DMS)，结合空间结构一致性（局部变形）和频域谱一致性（振荡和全局动态模式），减少训练成本和内存开销。同时结合零样本文本提示分割与模拟引导初始化，将高斯分解为对象部分级区域，支持全材料参数的联合优化。
AI.result: 在合成和真实场景实验中，Resonance4D实现了强大的物理保真度和运动一致性，同时将峰值GPU内存从超过35GB降低到约20GB，使高保真物理驱动的4D模拟能够在单个消费级GPU上运行。
AI.conclusion: Resonance4D通过轻量级但物理表达力强的监督方法，解决了现有4D动态模拟中的计算成本和参数优化限制问题，为复杂材料和动态场景提供了高效且真实的物理模拟解决方案。

title: MTLSI-Net: A Linear Semantic Interaction Network for Parameter-Efficient Multi-Task Dense Prediction
comment: accepted by ICME 2026, to be published
summary: Multi-task dense prediction aims to perform multiple pixel-level tasks simultaneously. However, capturing global cross-task interactions remains non-trivial due to the quadratic complexity of standard self-attention on high-resolution features. To address this limitation, we propose a Multi-Task Linear Semantic Interaction Network (MTLSI-Net), which facilitates cross-task interaction through linear attention. Specifically, MTLSI-Net incorporates three key components: a Multi-Task Multi-scale Query Linear Fusion Block, which captures cross-task dependencies across multiple scales with linear complexity using a shared global context matrix; a Semantic Token Distiller that compresses redundant features into compact semantic tokens, distilling essential cross-task knowledge; and a Cross-Window Integrated attention Block that injects global semantics into local features via a dual-branch architecture, preserving both global consistency and spatial precision. These components collectively enable the network to capture comprehensive cross-task interactions at linear complexity with reduced parameters. Extensive experiments on NYUDv2 and PASCAL-Context demonstrate that MTLSI-Net achieves state-of-the-art performance, validating its effectiveness and efficiency in multi-task learning.

AI.tldr: MTLSI-Net提出了一种线性复杂度的多任务密集预测网络，通过线性注意力机制解决跨任务交互的二次复杂度问题，在NYUDv2和PASCAL-Context数据集上达到SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 多任务密集预测需要在像素级别同时执行多个任务，但标准自注意力机制在高分辨率特征上具有二次复杂度，难以有效捕获全局跨任务交互。
AI.method: 提出MTLSI-Net网络，包含三个核心组件：1) 多任务多尺度查询线性融合块，使用共享全局上下文矩阵以线性复杂度捕获多尺度跨任务依赖；2) 语义令牌蒸馏器，将冗余特征压缩为紧凑语义令牌，蒸馏关键跨任务知识；3) 跨窗口集成注意力块，通过双分支架构将全局语义注入局部特征，保持全局一致性和空间精度。
AI.result: 在NYUDv2和PASCAL-Context数据集上的大量实验表明，MTLSI-Net实现了最先进的性能，验证了其在多任务学习中的有效性和效率。
AI.conclusion: MTLSI-Net通过线性注意力机制成功解决了多任务密集预测中跨任务交互的复杂度问题，能够在保持全局一致性和空间精度的同时，以线性复杂度和更少参数实现全面的跨任务交互。

title: ProDiG: Progressive Diffusion-Guided Gaussian Splatting for Aerial to Ground Reconstruction
summary: Generating ground-level views and coherent 3D site models from aerial-only imagery is challenging due to extreme viewpoint changes, missing intermediate observations, and large scale variations. Existing methods either refine renderings post-hoc, often producing geometrically inconsistent results, or rely on multi-altitude ground-truth, which is rarely available. Gaussian Splatting and diffusion-based refinements improve fidelity under small variations but fail under wide aerial-to-ground gaps. To address these limitations, we introduce ProDiG (Progressive Altitude Gaussian Splatting), a diffusion-guided framework that progressively transforms aerial 3D representations toward ground-level fidelity. ProDiG synthesizes intermediate-altitude views and refines the Gaussian representation at each stage using a geometry-aware causal attention module that injects epipolar structure into reference-view diffusion. A distance-adaptive Gaussian module dynamically adjusts Gaussian scale and opacity based on camera distance, ensuring stable reconstruction across large viewpoint gaps. Together, these components enable progressive, geometrically grounded refinement without requiring additional ground-truth viewpoints. Extensive experiments on synthetic and real-world datasets demonstrate that ProDiG produces visually realistic ground-level renderings and coherent 3D geometry, significantly outperforming existing approaches in terms of visual quality, geometric consistency, and robustness to extreme viewpoint changes.

AI.tldr: ProDiG：一种渐进式扩散引导框架，通过几何感知因果注意力和距离自适应高斯模块，将航空3D表示逐步转换为地面级保真度，无需额外地面真值视角。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在从航空图像生成地面视角和连贯3D场景模型时面临挑战，包括极端视角变化、中间观测缺失和大尺度变化。现有方法要么后处理渲染导致几何不一致，要么依赖多高度地面真值数据（通常难以获取）。高斯泼溅和扩散细化在小变化下有效，但在宽航空-地面差距下失败。
AI.method: 提出ProDiG（渐进高度高斯泼溅）框架：1）合成中间高度视角；2）使用几何感知因果注意力模块将极线结构注入参考视图扩散，细化每个阶段的高斯表示；3）距离自适应高斯模块根据相机距离动态调整高斯尺度和不透明度，确保大视角差距下的稳定重建。
AI.result: 在合成和真实数据集上的广泛实验表明，ProDiG能生成视觉逼真的地面级渲染和连贯3D几何，在视觉质量、几何一致性和对极端视角变化的鲁棒性方面显著优于现有方法。
AI.conclusion: ProDiG通过渐进式扩散引导框架，无需额外地面真值视角，实现了从航空到地面视角的几何一致转换，解决了极端视角变化下的3D场景重建问题。

title: Are VLMs Lost Between Sky and Space? LinkS$^2$Bench for UAV-Satellite Dynamic Cross-View Spatial Intelligence
summary: Synergistic spatial intelligence between UAVs and satellites is indispensable for emergency response and security operations, as it uniquely integrates macro-scale global coverage with dynamic, real-time local perception. However, the capacity of Vision-Language Models (VLMs) to master this complex interplay remains largely unexplored. This gap persists primarily because existing benchmarks are confined to isolated Unmanned Aerial Vehicle (UAV) videos or static satellite imagery, failing to evaluate the dynamic local-to-global spatial mapping essential for comprehensive cross-view reasoning. To bridge this gap, we introduce LinkS$^2$Bench, the first comprehensive benchmark designed to evaluate VLMs' wide-area, dynamic cross-view spatial intelligence. LinkS$^2$Bench links 1,022 minutes of dynamic UAV footage with high-resolution satellite imagery covering over 200 km$^2$. Through an LMM-assisted pipeline and rigorous human annotation, we constructed 17.9k high-quality question-answer pairs comprising 12 fine-grained tasks across four dimensions: perception, localization, relation, and reasoning. Evaluations of 18 representative VLMs reveal a substantial gap compared to human baselines, identifying accurate cross-view dynamic alignment as the critical bottleneck. To alleviate this, we design a Cross-View Alignment Adapter, demonstrating that explicit alignment significantly improves model performance. Furthermore, fine-tuning experiments underscore the potential of LinkS$^2$Bench in advancing VLM adaptation for complex spatial reasoning.

AI.tldr: LinkS²Bench：首个评估视觉语言模型在无人机-卫星跨视图空间智能的基准，包含17.9k高质量问答对，覆盖12个细粒度任务，揭示了现有模型在动态跨视图对齐方面的显著差距。
AI.motivation: 无人机与卫星的协同空间智能对应急响应和安全操作至关重要，但现有基准局限于孤立的无人机视频或静态卫星图像，无法评估动态局部到全局的空间映射能力，这一研究空白亟待填补。
AI.method: 构建LinkS²Bench基准，将1,022分钟动态无人机视频与覆盖200+ km²的高分辨率卫星图像关联；通过LMM辅助流程和人工标注创建17.9k高质量问答对，涵盖感知、定位、关系和推理四个维度的12个任务；设计跨视图对齐适配器来改善模型性能。
AI.result: 评估18个代表性VLM显示，与人类基线相比存在显著差距，准确跨视图动态对齐是关键瓶颈；跨视图对齐适配器显著提升模型性能；微调实验证明LinkS²Bench在推进VLM适应复杂空间推理方面的潜力。
AI.conclusion: LinkS²Bench填补了评估VLM跨视图空间智能的空白，揭示了动态对齐的关键挑战，提出的对齐适配器有效改善性能，为推进复杂空间推理的VLM研究提供了重要基准和方向。

title: IndoorCrowd: A Multi-Scene Dataset for Human Detection, Segmentation, and Tracking with an Automated Annotation Pipeline
comment: Accepted at Conference on Computer Vision and Pattern Recognition Workshops 2026
summary: Understanding human behaviour in crowded indoor environments is central to surveillance, smart buildings, and human-robot interaction, yet existing datasets rarely capture real-world indoor complexity at scale. We introduce IndoorCrowd, a multi-scene dataset for indoor human detection, instance segmentation, and multi-object tracking, collected across four campus locations (ACS-EC, ACS-EG, IE-Central, R-Central). It comprises $31$ videos ($9{,}913$ frames at $5$fps) with human-verified, per-instance segmentation masks. A $620$-frame control subset benchmarks three foundation-model auto-annotators: SAM3, GroundingSAM, and EfficientGroundingSAM, against human labels using Cohen's $κ$, AP, precision, recall, and mask IoU. A further $2{,}552$-frame subset supports multi-object tracking with continuous identity tracks in MOTChallenge format. We establish detection, segmentation, and tracking baselines using YOLOv8n, YOLOv26n, and RT-DETR-L paired with ByteTrack, BoT-SORT, and OC-SORT. Per-scene analysis reveals substantial difficulty variation driven by crowd density, scale, and occlusion: ACS-EC, with $79.3\%$ dense frames and a mean instance scale of $60.8$px, is the most challenging scene. The project page is available at https://sheepseb.github.io/IndoorCrowd/.

AI.tldr: IndoorCrowd是一个大规模室内人群数据集，包含31个视频、9913帧，用于人体检测、实例分割和多目标跟踪，在四个校园场景中收集，并评估了三种基础模型自动标注器的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有数据集很少能大规模捕捉真实室内环境的复杂性，而理解拥挤室内环境中的人类行为对于监控、智能建筑和人机交互至关重要。
AI.method: 在四个校园位置收集31个视频（9913帧，5fps），提供人工验证的实例分割掩码。使用620帧控制子集评估SAM3、GroundingSAM和EfficientGroundingSAM三种基础模型自动标注器，使用Cohen's κ、AP、精确率、召回率和掩码IoU指标。另外2552帧子集支持多目标跟踪，采用MOTChallenge格式。使用YOLOv8n、YOLOv26n、RT-DETR-L与ByteTrack、BoT-SORT、OC-SORT建立检测、分割和跟踪基线。
AI.result: 场景分析显示难度差异显著，受人群密度、尺度和遮挡影响。ACS-EC场景最具挑战性，79.3%为密集帧，平均实例尺度为60.8像素。建立了检测、分割和跟踪的基准性能。
AI.conclusion: IndoorCrowd数据集填补了大规模真实室内人群数据集的空白，为室内人类行为理解提供了重要资源，并展示了不同场景下的性能差异，有助于推动监控、智能建筑和人机交互领域的研究。

title: Efficient Reasoning via Thought Compression for Language Segmentation
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) reasoning has significantly improved the performance of large multimodal models in language-guided segmentation, yet its prohibitive computational cost, stemming from generating verbose rationales, limits real-world applicability. We introduce WISE (Wisdom from Internal Self-Exploration), a novel paradigm for efficient reasoning guided by the principle of \textit{thinking twice -- once for learning, once for speed}. WISE trains a model to generate a structured sequence: a concise rationale, the final answer, and then a detailed explanation. By placing the concise rationale first, our method leverages autoregressive conditioning to enforce that the concise rationale acts as a sufficient summary for generating the detailed explanation. This structure is reinforced by a self-distillation objective that jointly rewards semantic fidelity and conciseness, compelling the model to internalize its detailed reasoning into a compact form. At inference, the detailed explanation is omitted. To address the resulting conditional distribution shift, our inference strategy, WISE-S, employs a simple prompting technique that injects a brevity-focused instruction into the user's query. This final adjustment facilitates the robust activation of the learned concise policy, unlocking the full benefits of our framework. Extensive experiments show that WISE-S achieves state-of-the-art zero-shot performance on the ReasonSeg benchmark with 58.3 cIoU, while reducing the average reasoning length by nearly \textbf{5$\times$} -- from 112 to just 23 tokens. Code is available at \href{https://github.com/mrazhou/WISE}{WISE}.

AI.tldr: WISE提出了一种高效的多模态推理范式，通过"思考两次"原则：训练时先生成简洁理由、答案和详细解释，推理时只生成简洁理由，大幅减少计算成本。
AI.motivation: 现有的思维链推理虽然提升了多模态模型在语言引导分割任务上的性能，但生成冗长理由的计算成本过高，限制了实际应用。需要一种既能保持推理能力又能显著降低计算开销的方法。
AI.method: WISE采用"思考两次"原则：训练时让模型生成结构化序列（简洁理由→答案→详细解释），通过自回归条件强制简洁理由作为详细解释的充分摘要。使用自蒸馏目标联合奖励语义保真度和简洁性。推理时使用WISE-S策略，通过简洁性指令提示激活学习到的简洁策略。
AI.result: 在ReasonSeg基准测试中，WISE-S实现了58.3 cIoU的零样本性能，达到最先进水平，同时将平均推理长度从112个token减少到23个token，减少了近5倍。
AI.conclusion: WISE通过"思考两次"范式成功实现了高效推理，在保持高性能的同时大幅降低了计算成本，为多模态模型的实际部署提供了可行的解决方案。

title: Jagle: Building a Large-Scale Japanese Multimodal Post-Training Dataset for Vision-Language Models
summary: Developing vision-language models (VLMs) that generalize across diverse tasks requires large-scale training datasets with diverse content. In English, such datasets are typically constructed by aggregating and curating numerous existing visual question answering (VQA) resources. However, this strategy does not readily extend to other languages, where VQA datasets remain limited in both scale and domain coverage, posing a major obstacle to building high-quality multilingual and non-English VLMs. In this work, we introduce Jagle, the largest Japanese multimodal post-training dataset to date, comprising approximately 9.2 million instances across diverse tasks. Rather than relying on existing VQA datasets, we collect heterogeneous source data, including images, image-text pairs, and PDF documents, and generate VQA pairs through multiple strategies such as VLM-based QA generation, translation, and text rendering. Experiments demonstrate that a 2.2B model trained with Jagle achieves strong performance on Japanese tasks, surpassing InternVL3.5-2B in average score across ten Japanese evaluation tasks and approaching within five points of Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct. Furthermore, combining Jagle with FineVision does not degrade English performance; instead, it improves English performance compared to training with FineVision alone. To facilitate reproducibility and future research, we release the dataset, trained models, and code.

AI.tldr: Jagle是迄今为止最大的日本多模态后训练数据集，包含约920万个实例，通过多种策略生成VQA对，用于训练高质量的日语视觉语言模型。
AI.motivation: 构建高质量的多语言和非英语视觉语言模型面临的主要障碍是其他语言的VQA数据集在规模和领域覆盖上都有限，无法像英语那样通过聚合现有VQA资源来构建训练数据集。
AI.method: 收集异构源数据（图像、图文对、PDF文档），通过多种策略生成VQA对：基于VLM的QA生成、翻译和文本渲染，构建了包含约920万个实例的日本多模态数据集。
AI.result: 使用Jagle训练的2.2B模型在日语任务上表现强劲，在十个日本评估任务中平均得分超过InternVL3.5-2B，接近Qwen3-VL-2B-Instruct的5分以内。结合FineVision训练不仅不降低英语性能，反而比单独使用FineVision表现更好。
AI.conclusion: Jagle数据集成功解决了日语VQA数据稀缺的问题，为构建高质量日语视觉语言模型提供了有效解决方案，同时发布了数据集、训练模型和代码以促进可重复性和未来研究。

title: True to Tone? Quantifying Skin Tone Fidelity and Bias in Photographic-to-Virtual Human Pipelines
summary: Accurate reproduction of facial skin tone is essential for realism, identity preservation, and fairness in Virtual Human (VH) rendering. However, most accessible avatar creation pipelines rely on photographic inputs that lack colorimetric calibration, which can introduce inconsistencies and bias. We propose a fully automatic and scalable methodology to systematically evaluate skin tone fidelity across the VH generation pipeline. Our approach defines a full workflow that integrates skin color and illumination extraction, texture recolorization, real-time rendering, and quantitative color analysis. Using facial images from the Chicago Face Database (CFD), we compare skin tone extraction strategies based on cheek-region sampling, following the literature, and multidimensional masking derived from full-face analysis. Additionally, we test both strategies with lighting isolation, using the pre-trained TRUST framework, employed without any training or optimization within our pipeline. Extracted skin tones are applied to MetaHuman textures and rendered under multiple lighting configurations. Skin tone consistency is evaluated objectively in the CIELAB color space using the $ΔE$ metric and the Individual Typology Angle (ITA). The proposed methodology operates without manual intervention and, with the exception of pre-trained illumination compensation modules, the pipeline does not include learning or training stages, enabling low computational cost and large-scale evaluation. Using this framework, we generate and analyze approximately 19,848 rendered instances. Our results show phenotype-dependent behavior of extraction strategies and consistently higher colorimetric errors for darker skin tones.

AI.tldr: 提出了一种全自动、可扩展的方法来系统评估虚拟人渲染中肤色保真度，通过肤色提取、纹理重着色、实时渲染和定量色彩分析，发现肤色提取策略存在表型依赖性，且深色肤色的色度误差更高。
AI.motivation: 虚拟人渲染中准确再现面部肤色对于真实感、身份保持和公平性至关重要，但大多数可访问的虚拟人创建流程依赖未经色彩校准的摄影输入，可能引入不一致性和偏见。
AI.method: 提出全自动工作流程，整合肤色和光照提取、纹理重着色、实时渲染和定量色彩分析。使用芝加哥面部数据库图像，比较基于脸颊区域采样和全脸分析的多维掩码两种肤色提取策略，并测试结合TRUST框架的光照隔离。提取的肤色应用于MetaHuman纹理并在多种光照配置下渲染，在CIELAB色彩空间中使用ΔE度量和个体类型学角度进行客观评估。
AI.result: 分析了约19,848个渲染实例，结果显示提取策略存在表型依赖性行为，深色肤色的色度误差始终更高。
AI.conclusion: 提出的方法无需人工干预，计算成本低，支持大规模评估，揭示了肤色提取策略的系统性偏差，为虚拟人渲染中的肤色保真度评估提供了标准化框架。

title: COMPASS: Complete Multimodal Fusion via Proxy Tokens and Shared Spaces for Ubiquitous Sensing
summary: Missing modalities remain a major challenge for multimodal sensing, because most existing methods adapt the fusion process to the observed subset by dropping absent branches, using subset-specific fusion, or reconstructing missing features. As a result, the fusion head often receives an input structure different from the one seen during training, leading to incomplete fusion and degraded cross-modal interaction. We propose COMPASS, a missing-modality fusion framework built on the principle of fusion completeness: the fusion head always receives a fixed N-slot multimodal input, with one token per modality slot. For each missing modality, COMPASS synthesizes a target-specific proxy token from the observed modalities using pairwise source-to-target generators in a shared latent space, and aggregates them into a single replacement token. To make these proxies both representation-compatible and task-informative, we combine proxy alignment, shared-space regularization, and per-proxy discriminative supervision. Experiments on XRF55, MM-Fi, and OctoNet under diverse single- and multiple-missing settings show that COMPASS outperforms prior methods on the large majority of scenarios. Our results suggest that preserving a modality-complete fusion interface is a simple and effective design principle for robust multimodal sensing.

AI.tldr: COMPASS是一个处理缺失模态的多模态融合框架，通过为每个缺失模态生成代理token来保持固定的N槽多模态输入结构，确保融合头始终接收完整的模态输入。
AI.motivation: 现有方法在模态缺失时通常通过丢弃缺失分支、使用子集特定融合或重建缺失特征来适应，导致融合头接收与训练时不同的输入结构，造成不完全融合和跨模态交互退化。
AI.method: 基于融合完整性原则，COMPASS为每个缺失模态在共享潜在空间中使用成对源到目标生成器合成目标特定代理token，然后聚合为单个替换token，结合代理对齐、共享空间正则化和每个代理判别监督来确保代理的表示兼容性和任务信息性。
AI.result: 在XRF55、MM-Fi和OctoNet数据集上的实验表明，在多种单模态和多模态缺失设置下，COMPASS在大多数场景中优于先前方法。
AI.conclusion: 保持模态完整的融合接口是构建鲁棒多模态感知的简单有效设计原则，COMPASS通过为缺失模态生成代理token实现了这一目标。

title: Network Structure in UK Payment Flows: Evidence on Economic Interdependencies and Implications for Real-Time Measurement
comment: Accepted for Poster presentation at the ESCoE Conference on Economic Measurement 2026
summary: Network analysis of inter-industry payment flows reveals structural economic relationships invisible to traditional bilateral measurement approaches, with significant implications for real-time economic monitoring. Analysing 532,346 UK payment records (2017--2024) across 89 industry sectors, we demonstrate that graph-theoretic features which include centrality measures and clustering coefficients improve payment flow forecasting by 8.8 percentage points beyond traditional time-series methods. Critically, network features prove most valuable during economic disruptions: during the COVID-19 pandemic, when traditional forecasting accuracy collapsed (R2} falling from 0.38 to 0.19), network-enhanced models maintained substantially better performance, with network contributions reaching +13.8 percentage points. The analysis identifies Financial Services, Wholesale Trade, and Professional Services as structurally central industries whose network positions indicate systemic importance beyond their transaction volumes. Network density increased 12.5\% over the sample period, with visible disruption during 2020 followed by recovery exceeding pre-pandemic integration levels. These findings suggest payment network monitoring could enhance official statistics production by providing leading indicators of structural economic change and improving nowcasting accuracy during periods when traditional temporal patterns prove unreliable.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过分析英国53万+行业支付记录，发现网络分析方法（图论特征）能显著提升支付流预测精度，尤其在疫情期间传统方法失效时，网络增强模型表现更稳定。
AI.motivation: 传统双边测量方法无法揭示行业间支付流的结构性经济关系，而网络分析方法能提供更全面的经济监测视角，特别是在经济动荡时期。
AI.method: 分析2017-2024年英国532,346条支付记录，涵盖89个行业部门，使用图论特征（中心性指标和聚类系数）增强传统时间序列预测模型。
AI.result: 网络特征使支付流预测精度提升8.8个百分点；疫情期间传统方法R²从0.38降至0.19，而网络增强模型表现稳定，网络贡献达+13.8个百分点；识别出金融服务、批发贸易和专业服务为结构中心行业；网络密度在样本期间增长12.5%。
AI.conclusion: 支付网络监测可作为官方统计的补充，提供结构性经济变化的领先指标，并在传统时间模式不可靠时提高即时预测准确性。

title: PLUME: Latent Reasoning Based Universal Multimodal Embedding
summary: Universal multimodal embedding (UME) maps heterogeneous inputs into a shared retrieval space with a single model. Recent approaches improve UME by generating explicit chain-of-thought (CoT) rationales before extracting embeddings, enabling multimodal large language models to better infer complex query intent. However, explicit CoT incurs substantial inference overhead and can compress rich multimodal evidence into a narrow textual bottleneck. We propose PLUME, a latent reasoning framework that advances UME by replacing verbalized CoT with a short autoregressive rollout of continuous latent states. To support diverse multimodal queries, PLUME further introduces a semantic-anchor-guided transition adapter that steers latent rollout along different reasoning trajectories under the same fixed computation budget. To stabilize training, PLUME adopts a progressive explicit-to-latent curriculum that uses verbalized reasoning only as a temporary training scaffold and gradually transfers this behavior into hidden-state computation, eliminating explicit CoT at inference. On the 78-task MMEB-v2 benchmark, PLUME outperforms strong explicit-CoT UME baselines while reducing reasoning from hundreds of generated tokens to fewer than 10 latent steps, delivering over 30x faster inference. PLUME is especially well suited to retrieval settings where relevant evidence is dense, structurally complex, and difficult to organize through verbalized intermediate rationales, such as video and visual document retrieval. These results show that structured latent computation can preserve the benefits of intermediate reasoning without the overhead of explicit rationale generation, providing a stronger and more efficient paradigm for practical retrieval systems.

AI.tldr: PLUME提出了一种潜在推理框架，用连续潜在状态的自回归展开替代显式思维链，显著提升多模态嵌入模型的推理效率和性能。
AI.motivation: 现有通用多模态嵌入方法使用显式思维链推理存在两个主要问题：1) 推理开销大，需要生成大量文本token；2) 将丰富的多模态证据压缩到狭窄的文本瓶颈中，可能丢失重要信息。需要一种更高效且能保留多模态丰富性的推理方法。
AI.method: PLUME采用潜在推理框架：1) 用短自回归展开的连续潜在状态替代显式思维链；2) 引入语义锚点引导的转换适配器，在固定计算预算下引导不同推理轨迹；3) 采用渐进式显式到潜在课程学习，使用显式推理作为训练支架，逐步将推理行为转移到隐藏状态计算中。
AI.result: 在78个任务的MMEB-v2基准测试中，PLUME优于强显式思维链基线，同时将推理从数百个生成token减少到少于10个潜在步骤，推理速度提升超过30倍。特别适用于证据密集、结构复杂且难以通过显式中介推理组织的检索场景，如视频和视觉文档检索。
AI.conclusion: 结构化潜在计算可以保留中介推理的好处，同时避免显式推理生成的开销，为实际检索系统提供了更强、更高效的范式。

title: FlowSlider: Training-Free Continuous Image Editing via Fidelity-Steering Decomposition
